raw.description:
Not all heroes wear capes – but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We are a leading planet-conscious household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we've contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we're really good at making it easy to do good.

We operate scaling businesses in the UK, US, Australia and Canada. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we're hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

We're looking for a Junior Copywriter based remotely in the Philippines to join our creative team and dig into the world of growth and paid advertising. This is a role for someone who loves writing, is curious about what makes an ad actually work and wants to get hands-on with briefs that are driven by real performance data. You'll be writing scripts and copy for paid social (still and video), collaborating with our local creative strategists and video team, and doing the kind of fast-paced, purposeful work that puts more planet-conscious toilet paper in the world. Which is, it turns out, a great thing to put in the world.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Joining a creative workshop with the AU creative strategist to brainstorm ideas for a new paid video campaign – and walking out with three concepts you're actually excited to write
  • Reviewing performance data on a batch of still ads and rewriting three hooks to test new angles based on what the numbers were telling you
  • Writing and submitting five paid social scripts (still and video) hitting the brief deadline with a day to spare
  • Attending a prioritisation call to align on which ad concepts to develop next, and flagging a hooky idea you'd been thinking about
  • Sitting in on a video review round with the video team, adjusting a script line that wasn't landing in the edit

Let's talk about you

You can write.

This sounds obvious, but it matters. You have a feel for language, rhythm and tone – you know when a sentence is working and when it isn't. You've got some real copywriting experience (even if it's not a lot), and you're already good at matching your voice to a brand's. Crucially, you can write with humour and lightness without it feeling forced. Our tone is a lot of fun to write in, but it takes genuine instinct to pull off.

You're curious about what makes ads work.

You don't need a deep background in performance marketing – we'll teach you the things you don't know. But you need to be genuinely interested in learning. When someone shows you an ad that performed well and explains why, your instinct is to lean in, not tune out. You're the kind of person who thinks about why something catches your eye, why it works, and what might make it land differently.

You're fast-paced and collaborative.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving team. You're comfortable working across multiple briefs, responding to feedback quickly, and jumping into a workshop or prioritisation call and actually contributing. You don't need every detail spelled out before you start, and you communicate proactively when things aren't clear or capacity is getting tight.

You give a crap.

Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence – us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the high standards of social and environmental impact. We're in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that's why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (over 90%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn't be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you're still reading, we think there's a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here's the thing, though – research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don't check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger – and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

raw.description:
Senior AI Video Editor — Performance Creative & Social Commerce

About STERRY

STERRY is a high-growth, cross-border women's intimates brand and e-commerce group scaling rapidly across the US, APAC, and global marketplaces (Shopify DTC, Amazon Worldwide, and TikTok Shop). We combine high-performance digital acquisition with lean, high-velocity global execution — and video is a core growth lever across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, and social commerce.

We are hiring a Senior AI Video Editor to own AI-accelerated video production for performance and brand: short-form ads, listing/lifestyle cuts, UGC polish, and disciplined creative testing. We care more about tighter, higher-converting cuts than raw volume.

Due to the nature of the brand (women's intimates), we seek someone with visual taste and real empathy for the modern consumer — fit, comfort, body-positive storytelling, and the aesthetic precision required to build authentic brand trust on camera.

The Role

You will own end-to-end video editing and AI-assisted production for STERRY’s global growth engine. You will turn briefs, raw footage, UGC, product shoots, and motion assets into high-converting ads and marketplace video — then systematically test hooks, cuts, and formats so winning creative scales across channels.

This is an edit-only seat: you will not be required to shoot or direct talent. You will be both a craft editor and an AI power user — obsessive about timing, typography, color, and brand consistency, and relentless about using AI to multiply quality output without lowering the bar.

You will report to STERRY’s marketing / creative leadership (Head of Marketing or Creative Lead).

What You'll Own

  • Performance Video Production: Cut short-form and mid-form video for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and TikTok Shop — hooks in the first 1–3 seconds, tight pacing, captions, and platform-native formats. We want fewer, sharper versions that are ready to test and scale, not a flood of average cuts.

  • AI-Accelerated Workflows: Champion and operationalize AI video tools (e.g. Runway, Kling, Pika, CapCut/Jianying AI, ElevenLabs, Midjourney/image-to-video, Claude/ChatGPT for scripts and iterations) to generate smart variants, clean footage, localize, and raise quality and speed — with human QA on every ship.

  • Marketplace & Listing Video: Produce and refresh Amazon A+/storefront video, Shopify PDP and lifestyle cuts, and channel-specific assets that stay on-brand and conversion-focused.

  • Creative Testing System: Build a documented testing cadence (hooks, offers, testimonials, fit/comfort claims, CTAs). Tag, version, and hand off winners to media buyers with clear naming and brief notes on what changed.

  • Brand Taste & Intimates Standards: Protect visual quality, model portrayal, and compliance for women's intimates (tasteful framing, hygiene/fit sensitivity, region-specific ad policies).

  • Cross-Functional Rhythm: Partner with marketing leadership, media buyers, designers, and copywriters during Shenzhen hours; take briefs, flag what’s missing, and turn around revisions fast.

What You Bring

Required (Must-Haves):

  • 5+ years of professional video editing, with 2+ years in performance creative, e-commerce, or social ads (DTC or marketplaces).

  • AI Champion & Power User: Hands-on, current experience with modern AI video/image/audio tools and automated edit workflows — not “curious,” but shipping with them weekly.

  • Craft Mastery: Expert in at least one professional NLE (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut/Jianying at a professional standard), plus motion typography, color, sound design, and captioning.

  • Portfolio of shipped ads or social/video work with clear before/after or performance context (hook tests, CTR/thumb-stop, iterative versions). We will judge taste and conversion-mindedness, not reel length.

  • Obsessive attention to detail: frame-accurate cuts, clean audio, typo-free on-screen text, consistent brand kits, and zero broken exports or wrong aspect ratios.

  • Fluent English (Mandatory): Full professional proficiency in spoken and written English to join Shenzhen-hours standups, take global briefs, mark up versions, and work with a distributed marketing team.

  • Comfort editing women's fashion, beauty, or intimates/body-close product content with taste and respect.

  • Ability to work full-time as a contractor, with reliable internet, your own edit setup, and consistent overlap with Shenzhen (UTC+8).

Strongly Preferred (Pluses):

  • Based in the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, or a closely aligned time zone.

  • Direct experience supporting Amazon, Shopify DTC, and TikTok Shop creative in the same org.

  • Motion design (After Effects / equivalent).

  • Experience building SOPs, templates, and AI prompt libraries other editors can run.

Who You Are

  • AI-Forward Editor: You use AI to raise quality and kill grunt work — then you personally protect taste and brand.

  • Detail-Obsessed: You catch a bad crop, a mistimed caption, or an off-brand color grade before it hits ads manager.

  • Performance-Minded: You edit for hooks, retention, and conversion, not only for a beautiful timeline.

  • High-Velocity Collaborator: You take feedback without drama and turn around the next cut the same day when the test calendar demands it.

What We Offer

  • $2,000-3,000 USD per month + performance bonus, as a full-time contractor.

  • Direct partnership with marketing / creative leadership, and a clear path to Creative Lead for the right operator.

  • Opportunity to define STERRY’s AI video production system, with global creative scope, from a remote SEA base.

Job Description: Full Stack Developer

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front‑end and back‑end environments. Beyond traditional development expertise, the candidate must demonstrate advanced proficiency in navigating and leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools and frameworks to enhance productivity, optimize workflows, and integrate intelligent solutions into our systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications using modern frameworks and technologies.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to gather requirements and deliver high‑quality solutions.
  • Build and optimize APIs, databases, and server‑side logic for performance and scalability.
  • Implement secure coding practices and ensure compliance with industry standards.
  • Integrate AI‑driven tools, APIs, and platforms into applications to improve automation and user experience.
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies, particularly in AI, machine learning, and cloud computing.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Strong knowledge of databases (SQL, NoSQL) and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate AI tools like a pro, including experience with AI APIs, machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and productivity platforms powered by AI.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Excellent problem‑solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team environment.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and innovation in AI and software development.

Atuamos com clientes de diferentes segmentos e portes, desenvolvendo soluções inovadoras que geram impacto real nos negócios.

Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Product Owner para maximizar o valor entregue pela plataforma Salesforce, traduzindo objetivos de negócio em um backlog priorizado e pronto para o time de desenvolvimento. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:

• Acompanhar a adoção e as métricas de uso após o go-live.

• 3+ anos como PO, Business Analyst ou Consultor Funcional, sendo 2+ em Salesforce.

• Domínio funcional de Sales Cloud, Service Cloud ou Experience Cloud.

• Experiência com user stories, critérios de aceite e técnicas de priorização (MoSCoW, WSJF).

• Conhecimento de modelagem de processos e do modelo de dados Salesforce.

• Vivência com Scrum e ferramentas como Jira ou Azure DevOps.

• Certificações Salesforce (Administrator, Consultant ou Business Analyst).

• Certificação CSPO ou PSPO.

• Conhecimento prático de Flows, relatórios e dashboards.

• Experiência com Agentforce, Data Cloud ou Marketing Cloud.

Security Analytics Engineer

Role Overview

The Security Analytics Engineer designs, operates, and continuously improves the organization's security telemetry, analytics, detection engineering, and observability capabilities. The role provides the data and analytics foundation used by Security Operations while extending traditional SIEM capabilities through behavioral analytics, automation, AI-assisted correlation, and observability for autonomous and agentic systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and operate scalable security analytics platforms and telemetry pipelines.
  • Integrate, normalize, enrich, and correlate telemetry from endpoint, identity, cloud, application, infrastructure, network, and AI-enabled systems.
  • Develop and tune behavioral detections, correlation logic, dashboards, and alerting strategies.
  • Translate threat intelligence, incidents, vulnerability findings, and offensive-security results into improved detection content.
  • Build observability for AI agents and autonomous workflows, including identity, tool usage, execution activity, and security-relevant behavior.
  • Apply AI-assisted techniques to log analysis, correlation, anomaly detection, enrichment, and investigation support.
  • Automate telemetry management and security workflows while maintaining appropriate human oversight and explainability.
  • Optimize SIEM and related systems platform reliability, data quality, performance, retention, and cost.

Qualifications

  • Experience engineering SIEM, security analytics, detection, observability, or large-scale telemetry systems.
  • Strong knowledge of logging, event correlation, normalization, enrichment, and security data pipelines.
  • Experience developing detections, behavioral analytics, or correlation logic.
  • Experience integrating security telemetry from diverse enterprise and cloud environments.
  • Scripting or software-development experience and familiarity with APIs and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Understanding of modern cloud and distributed architectures.
  • Familiarity with security telemetry standards, MITRE ATT&CK, AI-assisted analytics, or observability of AI/agentic systems is preferred.

raw.description:
About Remote People

At Remote People, we're building the infrastructure to power borderless teams. By handling global payroll, benefits, taxes, and compliance, our technology enables businesses to hire anyone anywhere compliantly at the push of a button.

If you're interested in adding to our vision of enabling people to work in dream jobs, for every company, and from anywhere in the world, apply now!

We're committed to building a global, diverse team representing different and varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, or disability. Being part of Remote People means being part of a growing, international family.

Position Overview:

As an Onboarding Specialist at RemotePeople, you will be a trusted partner to our clients as they hire talent around the world. You will guide clients and their new employees through every step of the onboarding journey, making international employment feel simple, clear, and well supported from day one.

You will manage multiple onboarding cases at the same time, reviewing employee information and documentation with great attention to detail, preparing employment contracts, and coordinating amendments when needed. You will also coordinate medical check-ups where required and partner with internal teams to ensure payroll and benefits are set up on time. Before each employee’s start date, you will make sure everything is in place for a smooth and compliant first day.

More than an administrator, you will act as a consultant: helping clients understand country-specific onboarding requirements, setting clear expectations, anticipating potential blockers, and offering practical solutions. You will bring a solid understanding of employee onboarding processes across different countries, as well as the local employment requirements and practices that shape each case.

Working closely with our Legal, Payroll, Finance, Sales, and Client Success teams, you will help deliver the seamless, high-quality experience RemotePeople is known for.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage end-to-end onboarding for employees across multiple countries, from receiving the case through the employee’s first day.
  • Guide clients and employees through onboarding requirements, timelines, documents, and next steps.
  • Review and verify employee information and documentation, ensuring all records are accurate, complete, and compliant before the start date.
  • Prepare employment contracts using internal templates and coordinate contract reviews, signatures, and amendments when needed.
  • Coordinate country-specific onboarding requirements, including medical check-ups, right-to-work documentation, visas, tax forms, and other local requirements where applicable.
  • Partner with Payroll, Benefits, Legal, Finance, and Client Success to ensure payroll and benefits are activated on time and all onboarding requirements are in place.
  • Manage multiple active cases at once, prioritising effectively while maintaining a high level of accuracy and service.
  • Proactively follow up on outstanding actions and signatures; flag potential blockers or risks early, including contracts that remain unsigned after 24 hours.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients by explaining country-specific processes, setting expectations, and helping find practical solutions.
  • Support employee onboarding and manage contract amendments throughout the employee lifecycle.
  • Keep client and employee data accurate and up to date across internal platforms and CRM systems.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, documentation, and the overall onboarding experience.

Key Qualifications:

  • Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken.
  • 2+ years of experience in employee onboarding, HR administration, global mobility, payroll operations, or a similar client-facing role.
  • Experience supporting onboarding in multiple countries; experience in EOR, PEO, global employment, payroll, or HR tech is strongly preferred.
  • Good understanding of employment onboarding processes and country-specific requirements, including employee documentation, benefits enrolment, contracts, and compliance.
  • Familiarity with employment contracts and contract amendments, including working from established templates.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage several cases, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • A consultative and customer-focused approach, with confidence guiding clients through complex processes.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to identify and escalate risks early.
  • Comfortable collaborating with Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, Sales, and Client Success teams.
  • Experience using HRIS, CRM, ticketing, and collaboration tools; HubSpot and Confluence experience is a plus.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote, global environment and handling confidential information with care.

What it's like working at Remote People

Our service & product. We're a technology company, not an accountancy, payroll provider, recruitment firm or similar. We build a workforce management platform that allows our customers to hire the best talent in minutes, without worrying about compliance, payroll, or HR admin.

Our amazing team and environment. Working at Remote People means you're working on something very exciting: Allowing every person on the planet to have access to equal opportunities in living a fulfilled work and personal life. We believe in hiring from within and going the extra mile to retain top talent. As the company continues to grow extremely fast, you will be given the opportunity to develop and grow alongside.

Our benefits and perks. Being part of Remote People means that you get the benefit of:

  • A competitive salary
  • An asynchronous working environment
  • A "Remote-First" company environment (or Hybrid) - based on the nature of the job
  • The ability to work from abroad for a short period of time
  • Growth opportunities within the company
  • We provide all new joiners with the necessary hardware to ensure you have the tools you need to succeed from day one

How to apply

Please fill out the form and upload your CV in a PDF format.

If you don’t have an up-to-date CV but you are still keen to reaching out, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

Role Title: English Language Expert (United States)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging English Language Experts (United States) to contribute to a specialized audio annotation project focused on American English. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Contributors will work with diverse conversational audio, focusing on the rich variety of American English dialects and accents. Backgrounds in teaching, transcription, editing, translation, journalism, or other language-focused domains are especially valued. A passion for both written and verbal communication is essential as you'll be working to ensure accuracy, clarity, and authenticity in all audio and transcript data.

Scope of Work

  1. Listen to multi-speaker conversational audio and assess linguistic content for annotation purposes.
  2. Tag audio samples and speakers with relevant metadata, including dialect, accent, speaking style, age, quality, and background noise.
  3. Review and correct automated speech recognition (ASR) transcripts, ensuring alignment with American English spelling and usage.
  4. Identify and annotate regional and cultural language variants, such as Southern English, AAVE, New York City English, Midwestern English and others.
  5. Leverage your familiarity with American idioms, slang, and vocabulary to validate and enrich transcript data.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Fluency in American English, with a strong grasp of US dialects and pronunciation subtleties.
  2. Experience in linguistics, language teaching, transcription, editing, translation, or journalism.
  3. Keen ear for differentiating and describing regional American accents and cultural language variations.
  4. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
  5. Comfort working remotely and independently on digital platforms.
  6. Familiarity with American English spelling conventions, idioms, and informal expressions.
  7. Previous experience with audio annotation or transcription projects is a plus.

Become a part of our caring community

The Medical Director relies on medical background and reviews health claims. The Medical Director work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

Work Schedule 8am-5pm Central Standard Time

The Medical Director actively uses their medical background, experience, and judgement to make determinations whether requested services, requested level of care, and/or requested site of service should be authorized. All work occurs with a context of regulatory compliance, and work is assisted by diverse resources which may include national clinical guidelines, CMS policies and determinations, clinical reference materials, internal teaching conferences, and other sources of expertise. Medical Directors will learn Medicare and Medicare Advantage requirements, and will understand how to operationalize this knowledge in their daily work.


The Medical Director’s work includes computer based review of moderately complex to complex clinical scenarios, review of all submitted clinical records, prioritization of daily work, communication of decisions to internal associates, and possible participation in care management. The clinical scenarios predominantly arise from inpatient or post-acute care environments. Has discussions with external physicians by phone to gather additional clinical information or discuss determinations regularly, and in some instances these may require conflict resolution skills. Some roles include an overview of coding practices and clinical documentation, grievance and appeals processes, and outpatient services and equipment, within their scope.


The Medical Director may speak with contracted external physicians, physician groups, facilities, or community groups to support regional market priorities, which may include an understanding of Humana processes, as well as a focus on collaborative business relationships, value based care, population health, or disease or care management. Medical Directors support Humana values, and Humana’s Bold Goal mission, throughout all activites.


Use your skills to make an impact

Responsibilities
The Medical Director provides medical interpretation and determinations whether services provided by other healthcare professionals are in agreement with national guidelines, CMS requirements, Humana policies, clinical standards, and (in some cases) contracts. The ideal candidate supports and collaborates with other team members, other departments, Humana colleagues and the Regional VP Health Services. After completion of mentored training, daily work is performed with minimal direction. Enjoys working in a structured environment with expectations for consistency in thinking and authorship. Exercises independence in meeting departmental expectations and meets compliance timelines. Supports the assigned work with respect to market-wide objectives (e.g. Bold Goal) and community relations as directed.

Required Qualifications

  • Current Louisiana and Oklahoma licenses, and/or ability to obtain additional licenses without conditions
  • No current sanction from Federal or State Governmental organizations, and able to pass credentialing requirements.
  • This position is open to all US Territory, with the requirement of working 8am-5pm Central Standard Time
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Evidence of analytic and interpretation skills, with prior experience participating in teams focusing on quality management, utilization management, case management, discharge planning and/or home health or post-acute services such as inpatient rehabilitation.
  • The Medical Director conducts Utilization Management of the care received by members in an assigned market, member population, or condition type.
  • May also engage in grievance and appeals reviews.

Preferred Qualifications

Location: Remote (Canada) or (U.S.)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 35 hours per week, with shifts scheduled between 8:00 am and 8:00 pm EST

Duration: 6-month, part-time internship (December 1, 2026 – May 31, 2027)

Start Date: December 1, 2026

About Numa

Numa is building the platform to power AI-native dealerships, rearchitecting automotive service and sales with advanced AI agents that automate customer interactions, streamline operations, and reimagine how dealerships work. Numa integrates AI into every aspect of dealership functions—from rescuing customer calls and voicemails that generate more revenue, to reducing customer resolution times that drive overall customer satisfaction (CSI), to improving dealership team productivity and accountability. Numa has raised $50 million from leading investors (Google, Threshold, Costanoa, Mitsui, and Touring Capital).

The Role

We’re looking for a Support Engineer Intern to help deliver reliable, responsive technical support for our dealership customers. In this hands-on role, you’ll own assigned support tickets from start to finish, following detailed procedures to manage user access, address caller ID and texting issues, and investigate automated system health alerts.

You’ll work primarily in HubSpot, Numa’s admin tools, and our telephony platform, with little to no phone support. As you ramp, an experienced Support Engineer will review your work and help you build the technical knowledge needed to troubleshoot issues, document findings, and know when to escalate. This internship is an opportunity to gain practical experience in technical operations, B2B SaaS support, and customer success.

What You’ll Do

  • Own tickets end to end. Pick up assigned tickets in HubSpot, follow the documented procedure, update the requester through approved templates, and close each ticket with clear internal notes
  • Manage dealership users. Add, update, and remove users; set roles and permissions; assign teams; and handle password reset requests
  • Improve caller trust. Submit CNAM (caller ID name) registrations and apply outbound “Spam Likely” fixes in Twilio
  • Make routine configuration changes. Update business and holiday hours and other pre-approved account settings
  • Investigate system health alerts. Work automated “Check Engine Light” tickets, including drops in inbound call volume, failed text messages, DMS integration errors, and integrations left active on cancelled accounts. Diagnose the cause, resolve issues covered by the procedure, and hand off clear findings when another team is needed
  • Keep data clean. Categorize every ticket you touch so the team can report accurately on volume and trends
  • Improve documentation. Flag gaps in our Notion procedures and draft new step-by-step guides for review

What You’ll Learn

  • How a B2B SaaS support team operates, including ticket workflows, SLAs, escalation paths, and handoffs to Engineering
  • Telephony and messaging fundamentals, including caller ID (CNAM), call authentication (STIR/SHAKEN), 10DLC texting registration, and SMS hosting
  • How dealership software, including DMS and scheduler integrations, connects to an AI platform
  • How to use HubSpot, Twilio, and AI assistants to investigate and resolve technical issues

What You Bring

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on technical experience
  • Curiosity about how systems work and comfort asking questions when something is unclear
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to follow written technical procedures carefully and notice when a step does not match what you see
  • Clear, concise written communication for both customer-facing replies and internal notes
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage a steady queue of tickets accurately

Nice to Have

  • Experience with a ticketing or CRM tool such as HubSpot, Zendesk, or Salesforce
  • Basic knowledge of VoIP, phone systems, or SMS messaging
  • Experience using AI assistants such as Claude or ChatGPT for research or troubleshooting
  • An interest in the automotive industry

What Success Looks Like

  • Assigned tickets are handled accurately and consistently, following the documented procedures
  • Customer updates are clear, timely, and sent using the approved templates
  • Issues outside the documented procedures are escalated with useful troubleshooting notes and findings
  • Tickets are categorized correctly, supporting accurate reporting on support volume and trends
  • Gaps in existing procedures are identified and useful documentation improvements are drafted for review

How We’ll Set You Up for Success

  • A dedicated Support Engineer buddy who reviews your work during your first 30 days
  • A structured 90-day ramp: you’ll start with user management and password resets, then add caller ID, CNAM, and system health alerts as you gain confidence
  • Detailed, step-by-step procedures for every ticket type you’ll own
  • A clear escalation path for anything outside a documented procedure. You’re never left guessing

Why Join Numa

  • We believe in everyone’s growth
  • Be part of an industry leader named the #1 fastest-growing AI Automotive company by Inc. 5000

At Numa, you’ll have the chance to work with game-changing technology in an industry that’s ready for innovation. If you’re curious about how systems work, enjoy solving problems, and want to build practical experience at a high-growth company, we’d love to hear from you.

Solvd US

Our organization is redefining claims management across the auto and property space through a blend of AI innovation, proprietary technology, and expert-led services that deliver measurable results for insurers, fleets, rental, TPAs/MGAs, and adjacent industries. Our US team combines automation, intelligence, and human expertise to simplify complex processes — accelerating cycle times, reducing costs, and improving outcomes across appraisal, repair, subrogation response, and auto/property estimating. Our solutions help customers move beyond digital claims to a model that’s faster, smarter, and simpler — grounded in data accuracy, transparency, and customer experience.

As part of the Solvd Group, operating in 46+ countries, our mission is to drive results today while shaping the future of claims. From FNOL to final settlement, we connect technology and expertise to deliver precision, performance, and confidence at every stage.

Position Overview

This role configures and supports two platforms: Gateway, our claims and vehicle repair management platform, and Hubcap, our repair shop and contractor network management tool. You will also support other Solvd US applications and teams as needed. You will work directly with a product manager to turn client requirements into working configuration, test it, take it live, and support it after launch.

Both platforms are highly configurable. Most client needs are met by setting it up correctly, not by writing new code. You are the person who sets it up correctly and makes that setup repeatable.

Applicants within a commutable distance to Lenexa, Kansas are preferred, though remote candidates will be considered. At this time, we are offering employment in the following states: AL, AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, LA, MD, MA, MI, MN, MO, MT, NV, NJ, NY state, NC, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA, WI.

Key Responsibilities

Configuration

  • Configure Gateway and Hubcap to onboard new clients: workflows, business rules, user roles, templates, notifications, and data mappings.
  • Build and maintain configuration standards and checklists so each client setup takes less time than the last.
  • Keep an accurate record of each client's configuration.

Support

  • Serve as second-level application support. Troubleshoot issues, reproduce defects, and determine whether the cause is configuration or not.
  • Fix configuration issues directly. Route code defects to engineering with clear steps to reproduce.
  • Track open issues to closure and keep the product manager and operations informed.

Delivery

  • Work with the product manager to clarify requirements and confirm the configuration meets them.
  • Write test cases and build test files. Run testing and support user acceptance testing with clients and operations.
  • Prepare release notes and configuration documentation for each go-live.
  • Monitor new clients after go-live and resolve issues quickly.

Improvement

  • Identify manual, repeated steps in setup and support. Propose fixes through templates, scripts, automation, or AI tools.
  • Use AI tools for documentation, test cases, and analysis. Check the output and protect client data.

Required Qualifications

  • 2–4 years in application support, implementation, configuration, or technical support for a software product. SaaS preferred.
  • Hands-on experience configuring a business application, such as a workflow tool, rules engine, CRM, or claims system.
  • Methodical troubleshooting. You can read an error message, isolate a problem, and write a clear defect report.
  • Experience with software testing and user acceptance testing.
  • Experience working in Jira, including creating, updating, and tracking tickets.
  • Clear written communication with technical and non-technical people.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in insurance claims, auto physical damage, fleet, or property.

· Basic SQL or strong Excel skills.

  • Familiarity with APIs, file formats (CSV, JSON, XML), and data mapping.

· Experience working on an Agile team.

  • Regular, practical use of AI tools in daily work.

Values

We hire for drive and for fit with how we work.

  • Built around people. You make the platform easier for clients and our operations team to use. You explain what you configured in plain terms.
  • Progress through partnership. You work side by side with the product manager, engineering, and operations. You ask instead of assuming. You welcome review of your work and review others' work in return.
  • Innovation that drives real results. You look for ways to make setup faster and support tickets fewer. You do not settle for a workaround that will break next month.
  • Own the outcome. You stay with an issue until it is closed.

What we offer

  • Comprehensive benefits, including health, dental, vision insurance, and more.

· 401(k) plan options

  • Paid time off, sick time, and paid holidays.
  • The opportunity to grow with a dynamic, innovative team in a startup-like culture.
Salary: $62,000-72,000

Role Title: English Language Expert (Great Britain)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Great Britain, Remote

micro1 is engaging English Language Experts (Great Britain) to contribute to a customer's innovative audio annotation initiative focused on British English. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. This opportunity emphasizes the importance of written and verbal communication, aiming for those with a passion for language and a keen ear for the diversity of British dialects and accents. Whether you have experience in teaching, transcription, editing, translation, or journalism, your insights into the nuances of British English will directly influence linguistic technology advancements.

Scope of Work

  1. Listen to multi-speaker conversational audio recordings, identifying and tagging key speaker and audio metadata such as dialect, accent, audio quality, background noise, age, and speaking style.
  2. Annotate and correct first-pass ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) transcripts, ensuring precise application of British English spelling, usage, and conventions.
  3. Utilize your knowledge of British regional accents—from Received Pronunciation and Estuary English to Scouse, Geordie, Yorkshire, Mancunian, West Country, Welsh English, and Scottish English—to accurately identify and categorize dialectal features.
  4. Apply your knowledge of British vocabulary, idioms, slang, and spelling to enhance the linguistic accuracy of project data.
  5. Maintain detailed and consistent annotation standards throughout all assigned project tasks.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Fluent proficiency in British English, with demonstrated familiarity across multiple dialects and regional accents.
  2. Background in language teaching, linguistics, transcription, editing, translation, journalism, or a related discipline.
  3. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a meticulous approach to language variation and usage.
  4. Ability to distinguish subtle differences in British English pronunciation and vocabulary.
  5. Experience working with audio data, metadata tagging, or transcription practices is beneficial.
  6. Adaptable, detail-oriented, and able to manage complex annotation guidelines independently.
  7. Interest in linguistic technology, AI training, or language data projects is a plus.

Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Minimum qualifications

  • 1+ years of experience on a Customer Assurance, Security Trust, or Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) team, including prior work on 100+ security questionnaires. You already have strong opinions about data portals.
  • 3+ years of other experience in relevant security roles, such as Security Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Risk Management, Compliance, or Technical Account Management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, especially when customer-facing. Ability to collaborate and communicate with technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • Conversational familiarity with cloud-native security controls in AWS or GCP.
  • Experience working in organizations that develop software and/or operate managed infrastructure and technology services for their own customers.
  • A keen eye for detail, ensuring accuracy in customer responses and compliance documentation. You’ve got a lot of patience for conversations about careful word choice.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience creating and iteratively improving AI technologies.
  • Familiarity with an Agile methodology.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth tech environment, such as at a Security startup or B2B SaaS firm, ideally on a remote and globally distributed team.
  • Hands-on experience building, administering, or using enterprise cloud security tools, such as CNAPP, CSPM, or CIEM solutions.
  • Strong meme game.

About the job

Want to help Wiz adopt AI responsibly, scale internationally, and sustain customer trust?

Reporting to the Customer Assurance Manager within Wiz’s Information Security organization, you will ensure customer security and compliance needs are met with subject matter expertise, transparency, and a growth mindset. Focusing initially on customer questionnaires, you will help the team use tools and technologies to scale its capacity, especially AI-driven automations. You will join customer-facing discussions about Wiz’s security and compliance posture, describe security controls with varied audiences, and support our team’s strategy to anticipate customer expectations and industry trends. You’ll join a high-performing global team that balances speed and quality under pressure, with the option to walk into any Wiz or Google office if desired.

Responsibilities

  • Use AI tools to lead and support the timely completion of customer security questionnaires within daily SLAs, balancing speed with strict technical accuracy.
  • Communicate across global teams with thoughtfulness – especially humble self-awareness about your strengths and weaknesses, sensitivity to others’ perspectives and priorities, and contextual understanding of business relationships.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Wiz’s products, controls, documentation, and IT environment.
  • Support customer audits, live calls with customers, contract questions, and sales enablement activities as needed.
  • Use and improve tools and technologies to manage increased demand. This includes supporting change management of our FAQ knowledge base and AI tools.
  • Help maintain the Wiz Trust Center as well as other internal and external security resources, including team procedures.
  • Build strong partnerships while collaborating cross-functionally.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Legal, Sales, Data Privacy, and Compliance to unblock enterprise deals and advance company-wide security initiatives.

Candidates must meet EAR part 772 and ITAR 120.15 definition of a U.S. person (Any individual who is granted U.S. citizenship; or any individual who is granted U.S. permanent residence (green card holder); or any individual who is granted status as a “protected person”) and that they reside in the contiguous United States.

Compensation + Benefits

  • Serves as the lead oncology strategist as assigned for potential awards and/or supports the other oncology-focused operational strategists as appropriate.
  • Co-leads bid defense preparations with Business Development for assigned opportunities and participate in other client meetings as needed in collaboration with Business Development, the SVP, SSPC, and other Senior Operational staff.
  • Develops strong relations with clients’ key decision makers by leveraging knowledge and expertise to drive repeat business for oncology and oncology-related opportunities and awards.
  • Collaborates closely with other global functions, such as Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, Statistics, Regulatory and Safety as per the scope of the opportunity.
  • Supports functional teams to enhance client relations and ensure high customer satisfaction.
  • Support business development and marketing activities by participating in conferences and meetings and generating marketing content such as webinars and white papers as part of Ergomed Group’s overall marketing strategy.
  • Degree in a life science or another related field, or equivalent education and experience. Advanced degree preferred.
  • Extensive experience in clinical research within a CRO with strong oncology experience
  • Demonstrated experience at a senior level contributing to project oversight and delivery
  • Proven track-record in maintaining, developing and strengthening customer relations
  • Previous experience in an oncology strategy position preferred

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.

  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.

  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.

  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

The Security Analytics Engineer designs, operates, and continuously improves the organization's security telemetry, analytics, detection engineering, and observability capabilities.   • Build observability for AI agents and autonomous workflows, including identity, tool usage, execution activity, and security-relevant behavior.

raw.description:
About Remote People

At Remote People, we're building the infrastructure to power borderless teams. By handling global payroll, benefits, taxes, and compliance, our technology enables businesses to hire anyone anywhere compliantly at the push of a button.

If you're interested in adding to our vision of enabling people to work in dream jobs, for every company, and from anywhere in the world, apply now!

We're committed to building a global, diverse team representing different and varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, or disability. Being part of Remote People means being part of a growing, international family.

Position Overview:

As an Onboarding Specialist at RemotePeople, you will be a trusted partner to our clients as they hire talent around the world. You will guide clients and their new employees through every step of the onboarding journey, making international employment feel simple, clear, and well supported from day one.

You will manage multiple onboarding cases at the same time, reviewing employee information and documentation with great attention to detail, preparing employment contracts, and coordinating amendments when needed. You will also coordinate medical check-ups where required and partner with internal teams to ensure payroll and benefits are set up on time. Before each employee’s start date, you will make sure everything is in place for a smooth and compliant first day.

More than an administrator, you will act as a consultant: helping clients understand country-specific onboarding requirements, setting clear expectations, anticipating potential blockers, and offering practical solutions. You will bring a solid understanding of employee onboarding processes across different countries, as well as the local employment requirements and practices that shape each case.

Working closely with our Legal, Payroll, Finance, Sales, and Client Success teams, you will help deliver the seamless, high-quality experience RemotePeople is known for.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage end-to-end onboarding for employees across multiple countries, from receiving the case through the employee’s first day.
  • Guide clients and employees through onboarding requirements, timelines, documents, and next steps.
  • Review and verify employee information and documentation, ensuring all records are accurate, complete, and compliant before the start date.
  • Prepare employment contracts using internal templates and coordinate contract reviews, signatures, and amendments when needed.
  • Coordinate country-specific onboarding requirements, including medical check-ups, right-to-work documentation, visas, tax forms, and other local requirements where applicable.
  • Partner with Payroll, Benefits, Legal, Finance, and Client Success to ensure payroll and benefits are activated on time and all onboarding requirements are in place.
  • Manage multiple active cases at once, prioritising effectively while maintaining a high level of accuracy and service.
  • Proactively follow up on outstanding actions and signatures; flag potential blockers or risks early, including contracts that remain unsigned after 24 hours.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients by explaining country-specific processes, setting expectations, and helping find practical solutions.
  • Support employee onboarding and manage contract amendments throughout the employee lifecycle.
  • Keep client and employee data accurate and up to date across internal platforms and CRM systems.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, documentation, and the overall onboarding experience.

Key Qualifications:

  • Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken.
  • 2+ years of experience in employee onboarding, HR administration, global mobility, payroll operations, or a similar client-facing role.
  • Experience supporting onboarding in multiple countries; experience in EOR, PEO, global employment, payroll, or HR tech is strongly preferred.
  • Good understanding of employment onboarding processes and country-specific requirements, including employee documentation, benefits enrolment, contracts, and compliance.
  • Familiarity with employment contracts and contract amendments, including working from established templates.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage several cases, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • A consultative and customer-focused approach, with confidence guiding clients through complex processes.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to identify and escalate risks early.
  • Comfortable collaborating with Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, Sales, and Client Success teams.
  • Experience using HRIS, CRM, ticketing, and collaboration tools; HubSpot and Confluence experience is a plus.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote, global environment and handling confidential information with care.

What it's like working at Remote People

Our service & product. We're a technology company, not an accountancy, payroll provider, recruitment firm or similar. We build a workforce management platform that allows our customers to hire the best talent in minutes, without worrying about compliance, payroll, or HR admin.

Our amazing team and environment. Working at Remote People means you're working on something very exciting: Allowing every person on the planet to have access to equal opportunities in living a fulfilled work and personal life. We believe in hiring from within and going the extra mile to retain top talent. As the company continues to grow extremely fast, you will be given the opportunity to develop and grow alongside.

Our benefits and perks. Being part of Remote People means that you get the benefit of:

  • A competitive salary
  • An asynchronous working environment
  • A "Remote-First" company environment (or Hybrid) - based on the nature of the job
  • The ability to work from abroad for a short period of time
  • Growth opportunities within the company
  • We provide all new joiners with the necessary hardware to ensure you have the tools you need to succeed from day one

How to apply

Please fill out the form and upload your CV in a PDF format.

If you don’t have an up-to-date CV but you are still keen to reaching out, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

Role Title: English Language Expert (United States)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging English Language Experts (United States) to contribute to a specialized audio annotation project focused on American English. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Contributors will work with diverse conversational audio, focusing on the rich variety of American English dialects and accents. Backgrounds in teaching, transcription, editing, translation, journalism, or other language-focused domains are especially valued. A passion for both written and verbal communication is essential as you'll be working to ensure accuracy, clarity, and authenticity in all audio and transcript data.

Scope of Work

  1. Listen to multi-speaker conversational audio and assess linguistic content for annotation purposes.
  2. Tag audio samples and speakers with relevant metadata, including dialect, accent, speaking style, age, quality, and background noise.
  3. Review and correct automated speech recognition (ASR) transcripts, ensuring alignment with American English spelling and usage.
  4. Identify and annotate regional and cultural language variants, such as Southern English, AAVE, New York City English, Midwestern English and others.
  5. Leverage your familiarity with American idioms, slang, and vocabulary to validate and enrich transcript data.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Fluency in American English, with a strong grasp of US dialects and pronunciation subtleties.
  2. Experience in linguistics, language teaching, transcription, editing, translation, or journalism.
  3. Keen ear for differentiating and describing regional American accents and cultural language variations.
  4. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
  5. Comfort working remotely and independently on digital platforms.
  6. Familiarity with American English spelling conventions, idioms, and informal expressions.
  7. Previous experience with audio annotation or transcription projects is a plus.

The Medical Director relies on medical background and reviews health claims. The Medical Director work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

Work Schedule 8am-5pm Central Standard Time

The Medical Director actively uses their medical background, experience, and judgement to make determinations whether requested services, requested level of care, and/or requested site of service should be authorized. All work occurs with a context of regulatory compliance, and work is assisted by diverse resources which may include national clinical guidelines, CMS policies and determinations, clinical reference materials, internal teaching conferences, and other sources of expertise. Medical Directors will learn Medicare and Medicare Advantage requirements, and will understand how to operationalize this knowledge in their daily work.


The Medical Director’s work includes computer based review of moderately complex to complex clinical scenarios, review of all submitted clinical records, prioritization of daily work, communication of decisions to internal associates, and possible participation in care management. The clinical scenarios predominantly arise from inpatient or post-acute care environments. Has discussions with external physicians by phone to gather additional clinical information or discuss determinations regularly, and in some instances these may require conflict resolution skills. Some roles include an overview of coding practices and clinical documentation, grievance and appeals processes, and outpatient services and equipment, within their scope.


The Medical Director may speak with contracted external physicians, physician groups, facilities, or community groups to support regional market priorities, which may include an understanding of Humana processes, as well as a focus on collaborative business relationships, value based care, population health, or disease or care management. Medical Directors support Humana values, and Humana’s Bold Goal mission, throughout all activites.


Use your skills to make an impact

Responsibilities
The Medical Director provides medical interpretation and determinations whether services provided by other healthcare professionals are in agreement with national guidelines, CMS requirements, Humana policies, clinical standards, and (in some cases) contracts. The ideal candidate supports and collaborates with other team members, other departments, Humana colleagues and the Regional VP Health Services. After completion of mentored training, daily work is performed with minimal direction. Enjoys working in a structured environment with expectations for consistency in thinking and authorship. Exercises independence in meeting departmental expectations and meets compliance timelines. Supports the assigned work with respect to market-wide objectives (e.g. Bold Goal) and community relations as directed.

  • 5+ years of direct clinical patient care experience post residency or fellowship, which preferably includes some experience in an inpatient environment and/or related to care of a Medicaid type population .

  • Current Louisiana and Oklahoma licenses, and/or ability to obtain additional licenses without conditions
  • No current sanction from Federal or State Governmental organizations, and able to pass credentialing requirements.
  • This position is open to all US Territory, with the requirement of working 8am-5pm Central Standard Time
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Evidence of analytic and interpretation skills, with prior experience participating in teams focusing on quality management, utilization management, case management, discharge planning and/or home health or post-acute services such as inpatient rehabilitation.
  • The Medical Director conducts Utilization Management of the care received by members in an assigned market, member population, or condition type.

Start Date: December 1, 2026

About Numa

Numa is building the platform to power AI-native dealerships, rearchitecting automotive service and sales with advanced AI agents that automate customer interactions, streamline operations, and reimagine how dealerships work. Numa integrates AI into every aspect of dealership functions—from rescuing customer calls and voicemails that generate more revenue, to reducing customer resolution times that drive overall customer satisfaction (CSI), to improving dealership team productivity and accountability. Numa has raised $50 million from leading investors (Google, Threshold, Costanoa, Mitsui, and Touring Capital).

The Role

We’re looking for a Support Engineer Intern to help deliver reliable, responsive technical support for our dealership customers. In this hands-on role, you’ll own assigned support tickets from start to finish, following detailed procedures to manage user access, address caller ID and texting issues, and investigate automated system health alerts.

You’ll work primarily in HubSpot, Numa’s admin tools, and our telephony platform, with little to no phone support. As you ramp, an experienced Support Engineer will review your work and help you build the technical knowledge needed to troubleshoot issues, document findings, and know when to escalate. This internship is an opportunity to gain practical experience in technical operations, B2B SaaS support, and customer success.

What You’ll Do

  • Own tickets end to end. Pick up assigned tickets in HubSpot, follow the documented procedure, update the requester through approved templates, and close each ticket with clear internal notes
  • Manage dealership users. Add, update, and remove users; set roles and permissions; assign teams; and handle password reset requests
  • Improve caller trust. Submit CNAM (caller ID name) registrations and apply outbound “Spam Likely” fixes in Twilio
  • Make routine configuration changes. Update business and holiday hours and other pre-approved account settings
  • Investigate system health alerts. Work automated “Check Engine Light” tickets, including drops in inbound call volume, failed text messages, DMS integration errors, and integrations left active on cancelled accounts. Diagnose the cause, resolve issues covered by the procedure, and hand off clear findings when another team is needed
  • Keep data clean. Categorize every ticket you touch so the team can report accurately on volume and trends
  • Improve documentation. Flag gaps in our Notion procedures and draft new step-by-step guides for review

What You’ll Learn

  • How a B2B SaaS support team operates, including ticket workflows, SLAs, escalation paths, and handoffs to Engineering
  • Telephony and messaging fundamentals, including caller ID (CNAM), call authentication (STIR/SHAKEN), 10DLC texting registration, and SMS hosting
  • How dealership software, including DMS and scheduler integrations, connects to an AI platform
  • How to use HubSpot, Twilio, and AI assistants to investigate and resolve technical issues

What You Bring

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on technical experience
  • Curiosity about how systems work and comfort asking questions when something is unclear
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to follow written technical procedures carefully and notice when a step does not match what you see
  • Clear, concise written communication for both customer-facing replies and internal notes

Role Title: English Language Expert (Ireland)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Ireland, Remote

micro1 is engaging English Language Experts (Ireland) to participate in a specialized audio annotation project centered on Irish English for a customer initiative. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. Generalists with strong language backgrounds—such as in language teaching, transcription, editing, translation, or journalism—are encouraged to express interest. A background in linguistics is not required, but familiarity with a range of Irish English varieties, from Dublin to Munster, Connacht, Ulster, and beyond, is valued.

  1. Listen to and analyze multi-speaker conversational audio with diverse Irish English dialects and accents.

  3. Review and correct automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcript outputs using Irish English spelling, syntax, and idioms.

  5. Provide detailed feedback and insights to enhance the accuracy of language models and annotation guidelines..

  1. Fluency in Irish English, with comprehensive exposure to various Irish dialects and accents.
  2. Background in language teaching, transcription, editing, translation, journalism, or similar language-centric work.
  3. Keen ear for phonetic distinctions, regional pronunciation, and Hiberno-English grammatical structures.
  4. Experience with transcription or annotation tools is advantageous but not mandatory.
  5. Strong command of Irish English vocabulary, idioms, and spelling conventions, including regional slang.
  6. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
  7. Interest in contributing to projects that advance AI and language technology using authentic linguistic expertise.

As part of the Solvd Group, operating in 46+ countries, our mission is to drive results today while shaping the future of claims. From FNOL to final settlement, we connect technology and expertise to deliver precision, performance, and confidence at every stage.

Position Overview

This role configures and supports two platforms: Gateway, our claims and vehicle repair management platform, and Hubcap, our repair shop and contractor network management tool. You will also support other Solvd US applications and teams as needed. You will work directly with a product manager to turn client requirements into working configuration, test it, take it live, and support it after launch.

Both platforms are highly configurable. Most client needs are met by setting it up correctly, not by writing new code. You are the person who sets it up correctly and makes that setup repeatable.

Applicants within a commutable distance to Lenexa, Kansas are preferred, though remote candidates will be considered. At this time, we are offering employment in the following states: AL, AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, LA, MD, MA, MI, MN, MO, MT, NV, NJ, NY state, NC, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA, WI.

Key Responsibilities

Configuration

  • Configure Gateway and Hubcap to onboard new clients: workflows, business rules, user roles, templates, notifications, and data mappings.
  • Build and maintain configuration standards and checklists so each client setup takes less time than the last.
  • Keep an accurate record of each client's configuration.

Support

  • Serve as second-level application support. Troubleshoot issues, reproduce defects, and determine whether the cause is configuration or not.
  • Fix configuration issues directly. Route code defects to engineering with clear steps to reproduce.
  • Track open issues to closure and keep the product manager and operations informed.

Delivery

  • Work with the product manager to clarify requirements and confirm the configuration meets them.
  • Write test cases and build test files. Run testing and support user acceptance testing with clients and operations.
  • Prepare release notes and configuration documentation for each go-live.
  • Monitor new clients after go-live and resolve issues quickly.

Improvement

  • Identify manual, repeated steps in setup and support. Propose fixes through templates, scripts, automation, or AI tools.
  • Use AI tools for documentation, test cases, and analysis. Check the output and protect client data.

Required Qualifications

  • 2–4 years in application support, implementation, configuration, or technical support for a software product. SaaS preferred.
  • Hands-on experience configuring a business application, such as a workflow tool, rules engine, CRM, or claims system.
  • Methodical troubleshooting. You can read an error message, isolate a problem, and write a clear defect report.
  • Experience with software testing and user acceptance testing.
  • Experience working in Jira, including creating, updating, and tracking tickets.
  • Clear written communication with technical and non-technical people.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in insurance claims, auto physical damage, fleet, or property.

· Basic SQL or strong Excel skills.

  • Familiarity with APIs, file formats (CSV, JSON, XML), and data mapping.

· Experience working on an Agile team.

  • Regular, practical use of AI tools in daily work.

Values

We hire for drive and for fit with how we work.

  • Built around people. You make the platform easier for clients and our operations team to use. You explain what you configured in plain terms.
  • Progress through partnership. You work side by side with the product manager, engineering, and operations. You ask instead of assuming. You welcome review of your work and review others' work in return.

Department:
