Be a part of a global team that is inspired to make a difference in the lives of people living with rare disease.

At Travere Therapeutics, we recognize that our exceptional employees are vital to our success. We are a dedicated team focused on meeting the unique needs of rare patients. Our work is rewarding – both professionally and personally – because we are making a difference. We are passionate about what we do.

We are seeking talented individuals who will thrive in our collaborative, diverse, fast-paced environment and share in our mission – to identify, develop and deliver life-changing therapies to people living with rare disease. We stick by our values centered on patients, courage, community, and collaboration to pursue our vision of becoming a leading biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the delivery of innovation and hope to patients in the global rare disease community.

At Travere Therapeutics, we are in rare for life. We continue to courageously forge new paths as we move toward a common goal of elevating science and service for rare patients.

Position Summary

The Specialist, Community Advocacy builds and sustains trusted relationships with patients, families, caregivers, patient advocacy organizations, and other community stakeholders while supporting the delivery of meaningful community programs. Initially focused on rare kidney disease, the role combines external engagement, field insight gathering, and program coordination to help inform Travere’s patient engagement strategy and educational priorities.

Reporting to the Director, Community Advocacy, the Specialist independently manages assigned relationships, outreach activities, and program responsibilities within approved plans and established guidelines. Through responsive engagement and reliable follow-through, this role strengthens Travere’s reputation as a trusted community partner and supports its growth as a multi-asset company and rare disease leader.


Primary Responsibilities

Community Relationships and Field Engagement

  • Cultivate and steward assigned relationships with patient advocacy organizations, community-based organizations, patients, families, caregivers, and other community stakeholders; serve as a day-to-day contact and follow through on agreed actions.
  • Identify opportunities to broaden engagement with local organizations and expand reach to less-connected populations.
  • Represent Travere at patient meetings, educational programs, conferences, and community events; engage stakeholders with empathy, cultural humility, and respect for their priorities and independence.
  • Interact professionally with healthcare professionals and community leaders to understand local needs and support approved community education and engagement activities.
  • Use independent judgment to prioritize routine outreach, respond to partner needs, and recommend next steps; escalate sensitive matters, new commitments, or issues requiring strategic, medical, or compliance guidance.

Community Insights and External Landscape

  • Gather insights through field interactions and approved listening activities, including patient and caregiver experiences, educational gaps, barriers to engagement, and unmet community needs.
  • Document and synthesize observations into concise summaries, and recommend opportunities to inform patient engagement strategy, educational priorities, and future programs.
  • Share insights with Community Advocacy leadership and relevant Patient Advocacy colleagues; support appropriate follow-up so community perspectives inform planning and program improvements.
  • Maintain working knowledge of the rare kidney disease advocacy landscape, emerging scientific advancements, and evolving patient education needs through approved resources and internal learning.

Community Programs and RKD and Me

  • Coordinate assigned local and virtual programs, listening sessions, educational events, and grassroots activities from planning through follow-up, with accountability for timelines and assigned deliverables.
  • Support RKD and Me programming and patient and caregiver ambassador activities, including participant engagement, onboarding coordination, scheduling, communications, and approved storytelling activities.
  • Coordinate venues, invitations, registration, vendors, travel, accessibility, materials, and on-site needs; resolve routine execution issues and elevate material risks with proposed solutions.
  • Gather participant feedback and assess attendance, reach, participant experience, and lessons learned to recommend practical program improvements.

Operational Accountability and Collaboration

  • Maintain accurate relationship records, engagement histories, commitments, project plans, budgets, expenses, and program metrics; manage assigned work with limited day-to-day supervision.
  • Prepare meeting briefs, presentations, outreach communications, and program summaries; coordinate required internal reviews and use approved materials.
  • Collaborate with therapeutic advocacy leads, Rare Kidney Educators, Corporate Communications, Patient Marketing, Medical Affairs, and other colleagues as appropriate to assigned initiatives and established functional boundaries.
  • Operate within approved budgets, plans, and decision authority; protect patient privacy, follow applicable policies, and preserve the independence of patient organizations. Route requests outside Community Advocacy priorities to the Director for alignment.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in public health, communications, healthcare, nonprofit management, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • At least four years of experience in patient advocacy, including community engagement, patient or caregiver programs, or external stakeholder relationships.
  • Demonstrated experience cultivating relationships with patients, caregivers, advocacy organizations, or community partners and independently managing assigned projects or programs.
  • Working knowledge of the external rare kidney disease landscape, including patient organizations, community needs, and relevant scientific and treatment advancements.
  • Experience interacting with healthcare professionals and communicating effectively with varied external audiences.
  • Experience with public speaking, presentations, or group facilitation, with the ability to communicate clearly and adapt to audience needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in rare kidney disease or another rare disease community, particularly in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or nonprofit setting.
  • Experience with ambassador programs, community education, grassroots outreach, or culturally responsive engagement. Bilingual proficiency, including Spanish, is a plus.

Knowledge Skills and Competencies

  • Sound independent judgment, initiative, and accountability, including recognition of when to seek guidance or escalate an issue.
  • Strong listening, relationship-building, written communication, and public speaking skills; empathy and discretion when engaging patients and families.
  • Ability to translate community observations into clear insights and practical recommendations while respecting the limits of available information.
  • Strong organization, project coordination, attention to detail, and proficiency with Microsoft Office and relationship or project tracking systems.
  • Ability to understand and accurately communicate approved disease education within role boundaries; familiarity with privacy, compliance, and ethical principles affecting patient advocacy.

Travel Requirements

Ability to travel up to approximately 50 percent domestically for community events, patient programs, conferences, and internal meetings, including occasional evening and weekend commitments.

Travere provides comprehensive total rewards offerings that demonstrate our commitment as a diverse, equitable, people-centric, and pay-for-performance organization.

Benefits: Our benefits include premium health, financial, work-life and well-being offerings for eligible employees and dependents, wellness and employee support programs, life insurance, disability, retirement plans with employer match and generous paid time off.

Compensation: Our competitive compensation package includes a combination of both cash compensation (base pay and short-term incentive) and long-term incentive compensation (company stock), designed to recognize, retain, and reward employees.

Target Base Pay Range:

$85,000.00 - $105,000.00

raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. In many cases work may be cross-platform or have a cross-platform component. This role will include maintenance and development of the installer and updater of Firefox. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do:

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.
  • Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of overall software engineering experience
  • Strong knowledge of C and C++
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows, macOS, or Linux with C++.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript and HTML.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Play to win
    • Build for People first
    • Engage Evidence over Ego
    • Decide and Deliver
    • Ship, learn and repeat

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Installer and/or Updater development on any OS
  • Windows internals like the BITS server or MSIX packages
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Job Description: Low Voltage Engineer / Estimator

Position Overview

The Low Voltage Engineer / Estimator is responsible for reviewing construction drawings, performing accurate quantity takeoffs, preparing estimates, and producing clear documentation for field technicians. This role requires strong technical expertise in low voltage systems, plan reading, and drawing markups—not just administrative support. The engineer/estimator will collaborate with project managers, clients, and field teams to ensure precise scope definition, cost control, and successful project execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and interpret architectural, electrical, MEP, and low voltage/security drawings.
  • Perform detailed quantity takeoffs for devices, cable runs, cameras, data drops, and related scope.
  • Prepare cost estimates, proposals, and supporting documentation.
  • Create floor plan markups, system diagrams, and installation drawings for field technicians.
  • Utilize digital takeoff and markup software (Bluebeam, PlanSwift, AutoCAD, Visio, Excel).
  • Coordinate with field teams, installers, subcontractors, and site engineers to resolve questions and site condition changes.
  • Update drawings and estimates based on change orders, RFIs, addenda, or field modifications.
  • Communicate directly with clients to clarify project scope and requirements.
  • Organize tasks, drawings, estimates, and open questions independently in a remote work environment.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Construction Management, or related field (preferred).
  • 3+ years of experience in low voltage estimating, plan reading, and technical project coordination.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Bluebeam, PlanSwift, AutoCAD, Visio, and Excel.
  • Strong knowledge of low voltage, electrical, MEP, and auxiliary systems (CCTV, access control, intercom, structured cabling, AV, Wi-Fi, automation).
  • Ability to prepare clear floor plan markups, system diagrams, and installation drawings.
  • Competence in performing accurate quantity takeoffs and organizing estimates.

raw.description:
The ADA & LOA Specialist manages the interactive accommodation process and employee leaves of absence for employees and job applicants. The role applies the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), ADAAA, Pregnant Workers Fairness Act (PWFA), Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), and applicable state and local leave and accommodation laws.

This role works with employees, people managers, HR business partners, legal counsel, healthcare providers, and third-party leave administrators. The goal is to administer leaves accurately and identify reasonable accommodations that remove workplace barriers while maintaining business operations.

Key responsibilities

  • Interactive process management
    • Facilitate the interactive accommodation dialogue from initial request through case resolution.
    • Conduct intake interviews with employees to understand functional limitations, job tasks, and specific accommodation needs.
  • Leave of absence administration
    • Manage a caseload of FMLA, state leave, short- and long-term disability, military, and personal leaves from request through return-to-work.
    • Determine eligibility and issue eligibility, rights and responsibilities, and designation notices within required timelines.
    • Track intermittent leave usage and reconcile it against attendance and timekeeping records.
    • Coordinate with third-party leave administrators, payroll, and benefits so pay and benefits continue correctly during leave.
    • Manage return-to-work, including fitness-for-duty documentation and the transition to accommodation when restrictions remain or leave is exhausted.
  • Medical review and analysis
    • Review and evaluate medical documentation from healthcare providers to verify coverage under ADA guidelines and assess functional restrictions.
    • Review leave medical certifications for completeness and follow up on missing or unclear information.
    • Maintain strict confidentiality of employee health information in compliance with ADA, FMLA, and HIPAA standards, keeping medical files separate from personnel files.
  • Cross-functional collaboration
    • Partner with department leaders and HR to assess essential job functions and evaluate accommodation feasibility (e.g., adaptive equipment, flexible scheduling, remote work, duty modifications).
    • Advise managers on appropriate support techniques, compliance standards, and non-discriminatory practices.
    • Advise managers on attendance, job protection, and return-to-work questions tied to leave.
  • Case tracking and compliance
    • Maintain accurate, centralized records for accommodation and leave cases, tracking outcomes, temporary accommodations, leave dates, and review dates in the HR case management system.
    • Ensure consistent, timely processing of requests in accordance with federal and state statutory timelines.
    • Flag compliance risks and escalate complex cases to leadership.
    • Prepare regular reports on leave volume, case aging, and accommodation trends.
  • Program support and education
    • Help update disability accommodation and leave policies, employee handbooks, and standard operating procedures.
    • Assist in delivering training to managers and HR teams on disability inclusion, leave requirements, and interactive process best practices.
  • Experience: 2 to 4 years of experience in HR operations, leave management, or disability services, with direct experience handling ADA accommodation and leave of absence cases.
  • Knowledge: Deep working knowledge of federal and state disability and leave laws (ADA/ADAAA, FMLA, PWFA, and state-specific regulations such as California FEHA and CFRA, and state paid family and medical leave programs).
  • Skills:
    • Excellent empathetic communication, intake interviewing, and conflict resolution skills.
    • Strong analytical skills to evaluate complex medical notes against job descriptions.
    • Ability to manage a high-volume caseload with competing statutory deadlines.
    • Proficiency in HRIS and case management tools and experience working with third-party leave administrators.

raw.excerpt: About the RoleSection helps organizations build AI-powered workforces.
raw.description:
About the Role

Section helps organizations build AI-powered workforces. Our software (Section HQ and Section Coach) coaches employees to become AI-powered and measures the progress and ROI of employee AI use. Alongside the platform, our consultants work directly with client leadership teams to change how work gets done.

Most large companies have bought AI tools. Very few have changed how their people actually work, and that gap is where we spend our time. We believe AI transformation is mostly a people problem: leaders have to set a clear direction, managers have to change how their teams operate, and success should be measured in business results, not logins. We've now worked with more than 150 organizations on this, including Nike, MetLife, Adobe, Okta and Gap.

We are looking for a senior consultant to own a set of our largest client accounts. You'll be the client's main partner at Section, working directly with their senior leaders on what is, for most of them, the biggest change to how their company works in a generation. You'll set the strategy for each account, deliver the work yourself, and grow the partnership over time.

The playbook for this work is still being written, at Section and everywhere else. If you've led client engagements at a strong consulting firm and want to work on problems no one has solved yet, this is a good place to do it.

What the Work Looks Like

On any given account, you might be:

  • Working with a CEO and executive team to define their AI ambition and turn it into a manifesto the whole company can rally behind

  • Building a transformation plan: where AI should change the business first, what the 90-day roadmap looks like, and how progress will be measured

  • Running Lighthouse Teams, where we work with a single team to redesign how it does its core work with AI, then use the results to scale across the company

  • Designing programs that equip managers to lead their teams through the change, since managers are where adoption succeeds or stalls

  • Embedding with a client for six to twelve months as part of their operating team, working through priorities with them as they shift

  • Using our platform data to show leaders where their workforce stands and what's moving the business

What You'll Own

Your strategic accounts (~75%)

  • Own a book of our largest client accounts, typically enterprises with 10,000 or more knowledge workers. You're accountable for the relationship, the account strategy, and the results.

  • Deliver the work and write the strategy and deliverables yourself. Clients should be able to take what you hand them straight into their own leadership meetings.

  • Meet weekly with clients during active delivery and monthly otherwise, and run quarterly business reviews with each client's executive sponsor.

  • Work with an engagement team that handles logistics, scheduling and platform setup, so your time goes to the work that changes how the client operates.

Account growth (~15%)

  • Own the growth number on your accounts. Understand where each client needs to go next, build the case for it, and partner with sales to close it.

  • Build relationships with new sponsors and teams inside each account, so the partnership doesn't depend on a single contact.

The team and the practice (~10%)

  • Work with an analyst or junior consultant on your accounts and help them develop.

  • Join a small number of core accounts quarterly, or when a growth opportunity comes up.

  • Write down what works on your accounts so the rest of the team can use it.

What Success Looks Like

  • Your accounts renew and your clients can point to specific business outcomes from our work together.

  • Your accounts grow, and are on a path to becoming a $1M+ partnership.

  • Client executives see you as their partner and bring you into decisions before they're made.

  • Your deliverables go to clients with minimal rework.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience leading strategy or transformation engagements with senior executives at large companies, including owning the storyline, the final deliverable, and the client relationship. Engagement manager or senior consultant at a top consulting firm, or equivalent experience at a boutique firm or AI company.

  • Confidence with senior clients. You lead the conversation, ask hard questions, and push back when it's warranted.

  • Experience growing client accounts beyond their original scope.

  • Strong writing. You can turn a messy problem into a clear recommendation an executive will act on.

  • A real interest in how people and organizations change, not only in the technology.

  • Comfort working without a set playbook, on a lean team where you'll do a lot of the work yourself.

  • Daily use of AI in your own work, with concrete examples of how it has changed the way you work.

Details

  • Full-time, remote-first, with travel to client sites (approx 1x/month)

  • Reports to the Head of Enablement Consulting

raw.description:
At EverCommerce [Nasdaq: EVCM], we are on a mission to digitally transform the service economy with tailored, end-to-end SaaS solutions that simplify and empower the lives of our 745,000+ customers. As a leading service commerce platform, our modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals in the areas of Home & Field Services, Health Services, and Wellness industries.


We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:


EverHealth, a business within EverCommerce, provides modern end-to-end solutions for healthcare providers. Our open, connected ecosystem of solutions and services helps providers engage patients, increase revenue, improve business efficiency, and remain market competitive. We serve 72,000 healthcare practices and counting. EverHealth consists of five SaaS products; DrChrono, iSalus, CollaborateMD, Updox, and MDTec, combined these products offer end to end solutions for the health care industry.


About the Role

We are looking for a Manager, RCM Operations & Analytics to lead performance intelligence, operational analytics, and continuous improvement for our Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Services organization. Reporting to the Head of Professional Services, this role partners closely with RCM Operations, Service Management, the Vendor Manager, Finance, Clearinghouse, Product, and Engineering to translate reliable data into measurable operational and financial results.


This position owns the RCM performance measurement framework, strengthens independent visibility into internal and outsourced workflows, and drives cross-functional improvement initiatives across the revenue cycle. RCM Operations and Service Management remain accountable for day-to-day service execution and client outcomes; this role provides the measurement, insights, improvement plans, and follow-through that help those teams succeed.


The ideal candidate can develop a trusted dashboard, investigate a performance gap, build a financial model, facilitate corrective action, and verify that a process change delivers results.


What You'll Do

Performance Intelligence & Reporting

  • Own standardized RCM KPI definitions, data sources, targets, controls, and reporting for days in AR, AR aging, clean claim rate, first-pass resolution, denial and rejection rates, net collection rate, charge lag, posting timeliness, and other core measures.
  • Establish independent, timely visibility into transaction volumes, work queues, processing status, productivity, quality, and backlog across internal teams and BPO partners; reduce dependence on vendor-prepared data.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Clearinghouse, and vendors to improve data access, reconciliation, accuracy, and reporting automation.
  • Deliver actionable client-, portfolio-, and vendor-level dashboards, operating reviews, trend analysis, root-cause findings, and recommended actions.
  • Identify at-risk clients, revenue leakage, denial patterns, and operational bottlenecks; track corrective actions, owners, due dates, and verified outcomes.

Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

  • Lead prioritized, cross-functional process improvement initiatives across charge capture, claims, denials, AR follow-up, payment posting, onboarding, and credentialing/enrollment handoffs.
  • Map current- and future-state workflows, identify rework and delays, and partner with accountable operations leaders to standardize scalable processes and SOPs.
  • Develop quality measurement and audit frameworks with operational leaders; analyze results and recommend training or workflow changes.
  • Measure onboarding performance and time-to-value for new RCM clients, including readiness, early production performance, and stabilization.
  • Manage improvement initiatives from business cases through implementation, adoption, and post-launch benefit validation.

Vendor & BPO Performance Accountability

  • Partner with the Vendor Manager to define, validate, and report vendor SLAs, transaction volumes, productivity, turnaround time, accuracy, and quality measures.
  • Develop consistent vendor scorecards for weekly reviews and quarterly business reviews, using reconciled source data wherever available.
  • Quantify performance gaps, recommend corrective actions, and monitor resolution with vendor and operations owners.
  • Support transaction forecasting, work allocation, staffing assumptions, vendor transitions, and contract negotiations through fact-based analysis.
  • Reconcile vendor invoices to contracted rates, eligible transaction types, and verified volumes; flag discrepancies and savings opportunities.

Unit Economics, Capacity & Financial Performance

  • Build and maintain transaction-level cost models and unit economics by client, service, function, and BPO partner.
  • Track actual versus modeled vendor savings, cost-to-collect, service margin, and productivity; partner with Finance to validate assumptions and explain variances.
  • Develop capacity and throughput models that inform vendor allocation, staffing decisions, and backlog recovery plans.
  • Recommend opportunities to improve gross margin without compromising cash collections, quality, or client experience.

Technology, Automation & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Identify and prioritize automation, AI, workflow, and reporting opportunities that reduce manual work, improve first-pass yield, and increase operational visibility.
  • Translate operational needs into business requirements, support UAT, and quantify benefits after deployment.
  • Analyze payer and clearinghouse edit performance and recommend enhancements; technical rule ownership remains with Product and Clearinghouse teams.
  • Partner with Service Management on client-facing insights, Finance on forecasts, and Sales and Implementation on demand and onboarding capacity.
  • Monitor payer policy and compliance-related trends, flag operational risks, and support appropriate process updates with responsible subject-matter experts.

How Success Is Measured

  • Trusted KPI definitions and reliable reporting adopted by RCM leadership, Service Management, Finance, and vendor partners.
  • Improved independent visibility into BPO transactions, queue status, productivity, and quality, with fewer data gaps and manual reconciliations.
  • Measurable improvements in revenue-cycle performance, including AR aging, denial rates, first-pass resolution, and client time-to-value.
  • Timely identification and closure of vendor performance gaps through documented corrective action plans.
  • Validated improvements in unit cost, vendor savings realization, cost-to-collect, and RCM gross margin.
  • Completed improvement initiatives with documented operational, financial, or client experience impact.

What You'll Bring

Required

  • 5+ years of healthcare revenue cycle management experience, including substantial experience with end-to-end ambulatory RCM workflows.
  • 3+ years in RCM analytics, performance management, or operational improvement, with evidence of implementing measurable change.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in SQL and/or a business intelligence platform such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker, plus advanced Excel and data validation skills.
  • Experience assessing outsourced or offshore BPO performance, SLAs, quality, and transaction-level productivity.
  • Ability to reconcile multiple data sources, build actionable financial and operational models, and communicate findings to senior leaders.
  • Working knowledge of payer reimbursement, claims processing, denials, AR management, and relevant billing requirements.
  • Strong cross-functional influence, project execution, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred

  • Experience in a multi-client RCM services organization, ideally supporting ambulatory or multi-specialty practices.
  • Familiarity with EHR/PM systems, clearinghouses, and DrChrono.
  • Experience with vendor transaction-based pricing, invoice reconciliation, margin analysis, and capacity planning.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted analytics, reporting automation, or RCM workflow automation.
  • Lean, Six Sigma, CRCR, CRCS, CPC, CPB, or related training/certification.

Where

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.


Benefits and Perks

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Continued investment in your professional development
  • Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits package, including an annual wellness stipend.
  • 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

Compensation

The target base compensation for this position is $80,000 to $90,000 USD year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.


EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!


EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Employees remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work.

raw.description:
Location: 100% Remote (Global)
Job Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor
Department: Wholesale

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced, systems-driven Wholesale Operations Manager to take full leadership of our Wholesale and Order Capturing operations. In this role, you will directly manage, mentor, and govern distributed teams while owning the end-to-end operational pipeline for all wholesale and retail partner orders—from initial inquiry and order capture to invoice generation, payment tracking, and global warehouse dispatch.
You will serve as the operational bridge connecting internal teams, international retail buyers, global 3PL/warehouse hubs, and finance stakeholders. If you excel at managing remote personnel, driving daily accountability, building rock-solid Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), eliminating fulfillment bottlenecks, and steering teams toward zero-error order accuracy, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
1. End-to-End People & Team Management
  • Directly manage, develop, and supervise the Wholesale and Capturing Team across multiple shifts and international time zones.
  • Establish clear daily operational expectations, individual task allocations, and attendance/output benchmarks across all team members.
  • Lead structured weekly 1-on-1s, pod standups, performance calibrations, and hands-on coaching sessions to ensure high accountability and engagement.
  • Monitor pod capacity, balance workloads during peak retail cycles, and oversee onboarding, training, and continuous skills development for new and existing team hires.
  • Track individual and pod-level KPIs, holding team members accountable for order accuracy rate (>99%), first-response turnaround time (TAT), and SLA adherence.
2. Buyer Communication & Warehouse Alignment
  • Supervise team interactions with all B2B retail buyers, guaranteeing timely, professional, and accurate responses regarding order statuses, inventory availability, shipping updates, and custom account requirements.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for buyer inquiries, resolving complex logistics issues and maintaining high buyer satisfaction.
  • Serve as the primary operational liaison with global warehouse and 3PL teams to coordinate stock allocations, pack-and-ship timelines, and custom dispatch schedules.
  • Rapidly troubleshoot and direct team resolution on shipment discrepancies, backorders, damages, or transit delays with logistics partners.
3. SOP Architecture & Process Optimization
  • Author, maintain, and continuously refine detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) spanning order capture, verification, buyer communication, warehouse dispatch, and returns/claims.
  • Enforce strict team compliance with documented SOPs, ensuring workflow standardization across all account coordinators.
  • Continuously audit workflows to identify manual bottlenecks, streamline communication loops, and implement process improvements that shorten order fulfillment cycles as volume scales.
4. Invoicing, Payment Tracking & Reconciliation
  • Ensure all wholesale and retail commercial invoices, credit memos, and packing lists are accurately generated, logged, and organized by the capturing team.
  • Supervise the recording and tracking of incoming buyer payments, matching settlements against open purchase orders to prevent documentation gaps.
  • Partner directly with internal Bookkeeping and Accounting teams to facilitate timely payment reconciliations and resolve billing disputes promptly.
  • Identify, audit, and escalate payment or credit anomalies directly to executive leadership.
Qualifications & Requirements
  • 5+ Years of Operations Experience: Proven background in B2B wholesale operations, retail order management, or e-commerce supply chain operations.
  • Direct People Management Track Record: Minimum 2–3 years of proven experience directly managing, supervising, and coaching distributed remote teams (customer support, order capturing, or operations coordinators).
  • Performance & Accountability Driven: Demonstrated experience running performance evaluations, conducting 1-on-1s, managing team SLAs, and handling corrective action or workload reallocations.

The Scaled Customer Engagement Manager drives adoption, retention, and value realization for a large customer base through scalable, data-informed, one-to-many programs. Applying solid knowledge of PCC solutions and the industry, the SCE Manager customizes established strategies into digital journeys, communications, and events, and partners cross-functionally to execute them. The role exists so that every PointClickCare customer receives proactive, consistent engagement—extending the reach of the CSM team and contributing to NRR and controllable-churn goals.

Deliver scaled programs end to end: Owns the build and delivery of assigned digital programs (e.g., segment-specific Customer Success Monthly Digests, onboarding/adoption journeys, renewal, risk-mitigation campaigns, and Digital Customer Success Reviews) using Gainsight Journey Orchestrator and Pendo Orchestrate; adapts content to customer segment, maturity, and use case.

Minimum

  1. 3+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, Customer Marketing, Customer Education, or a related customer-facing SaaS role
  2. Experience designing or executing one-to-many programs (email campaigns, webinars, in-app messaging, or community)
  3. Strong written communication; able to tailor messages to different audiences and roles
  4. Working proficiency with CRM / CS platforms (Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar) and Excel-based data analysis
  5. Ability to interpret product usage and engagement data to drive action
  6. Strong organization and project management across multiple concurrent programs and deadlines
  7. Excellent presentation skills

Preferred

  1. Hands-on experience with Gainsight Journey Orchestrator, Pendo Orchestrate, or similar digital engagement tools
  2. Experience in healthcare technology, post-acute, senior living, or acute/payer markets
  3. Experience using AI tools to personalize communications and scale engagement
  4. Basic HTML/email-builder or design skills

Title: Partnership Manager

About CoinPoker

Welcome to CoinPoker, the innovative crypto-poker platform where advanced blockchain technology meets the thrilling world of online poker. At CoinPoker, we are revolutionizing the poker experience by offering fast, secure, and transparent gameplay. With recent substantial investment, we are poised to take over the online crypto-poker space and are expanding our team to support our growth.

The Opportunity

The Partnership Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management, optimization, and performance of assigned ambassador, influencer, streamer, and creator partnerships.

The role is focused on ensuring partners deliver what has been agreed, partner content is reviewed and improved in real time, promotional campaigns are executed properly, performance issues are identified and addressed quickly, and the partner roster grows through the sourcing and onboarding of new ambassadors, streamers, and creators.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for assigned ambassadors, influencers, streamers, and creator partners, managing communication, feedback, and performance-focused partner management.

  • Source and evaluate new ambassador, streamer, and creator opportunities, supporting negotiation and onboarding through to launch.

  • Track partner deliverables, campaign activity, and posting schedules, ensuring partners meet contractual obligations, and review partner content in real time across relevant platforms.

  • Develop and coordinate promotional campaigns for partner audiences, working closely with the CRM, marketing, PRM, and affiliate teams.

  • Coordinate with partners to brief and collect content assets required for campaigns and promotional activity.

  • Submit monthly partner performance reports and end-of-month invoice reviews, flagging missed or incomplete deliverables to management.

  • Support partner renewals and new ambassador launches, and mentor Junior Ambassador Managers.

  • Monitor high-performing creator content and engagement trends across the industry, sharing findings with the team.

Highly Desired Knowledge and Experience:

  • Strong understanding of poker rules, terminology, and community dynamics.

  • Proven experience managing influencer, streamer, ambassador, or creator relationships from onboarding to monthly execution.

  • Exceptional project management and organisational skills, with a track record of tracking complex deliverables, schedules, and campaign activity simultaneously.

  • High level of accuracy when auditing partner content, verifying promotional compliance, tracking deliverables, and reviewing monthly invoices.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

  • Natural ability or experience in guiding, mentoring, and supporting junior team members.

  • Ability to analyse campaign activity and audience engagement metrics to optimise partner content and evaluate campaign effectiveness.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in the blockchain and online gaming industry.

  • Flexible working hours and the ability to work fully remotely.

  • A collaborative and inclusive team culture.

  • Professional development opportunities and career growth within a rapidly evolving company.

At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.

We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation.

We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do.

Job Description

Proactively generate new business sales within Elavon’s SMB segment through self‑sourced opportunities and partner‑led referrals.Self‑generate pipeline through prospecting, outbound sales activity, and leveraging existing professional networks.Build and maintain relationships with lead and referral partners to consistently source new business opportunities.Manage the full sales lifecycle, from initial engagement through to deal closure, selling a range of acquiring services and payment solutions.Achieve agreed new customer acquisition and revenue targets, which are the primary measures of success for this role.Maintain accurate pipeline activity and forecasting in line with internal sales processes.Act as a self‑starter with strong ownership of personal performance, continuously identifying new opportunities and routes to market.


Drive for Results

Pursues goals with energy and perseverance; rarely gives up before succeeding; works to overcome barriers and challenges in order to produce desired results; can be counted on to achieve or surpass goals; consistently a top performer among peer group.

Collaboration

Develops good working relationships with others; recognizes and values differences; encourages an inclusive collaborative environment and open dialogue; puts team’s goals ahead of personal agendas; shares information openly and transparently; openly supports team members and their efforts.

Agility & Innovation

Demonstrate flexibility in dealing with fast-changing priorities, and different or challenging situations. Help others to continuously improve and achieve results. Explore multiple solutions to overcome obstacles. Anticipate future needs that may affect the team or organization.

Inclusion

Build a culture of equity and inclusion in which diverse ideas, talent and perspectives are welcomed and encouraged.

Risk Management

Appropriately identify and manage risks, in compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, and with Company Policy.

Ethics and Trust

Maintain high ethical standards; gain the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity and authenticity. Conducts him or herself honestly and ethically; adheres to a core set of values and standards appropriate to the situation and acts; accordingly, is consistent in own words and actions; inspires trust and respect by dealing openly with people; keeps confidences and admits mistakes.


Technical Competencies for your Role - what are you expected to know?

  • Minimum 1 year Experience in Merchant Services (or Financial Services sector).
  • Experience of Self-Generating sales/prospects.
  • Hold a valid driver’s license.

Qualifications Required to perform your Role?

  • Excellent time management and organisational skills.
  • An influential and highly effective communicator (verbal/non-verbal/written) with strong interpersonal skills.
  • A willingness to accept change and the ability to maintain effectiveness in a changing environment.
  • Strong relationship building and influencing skills.
  • Interested in learning about the Elavon business and has a general ‘can-do’ attitude.

Control Function Disclosure

This role has been identified as Controlled Function (“CF 4”) under the CBI Regulations. Accordingly, the Company must be satisfied on reasonable grounds that the role holder complies at all times with the requirements of:

a) the CBI’s Fitness and Probity Regime and the Conduct Standards (as applicable to the role).

Applicants (and upon joining the Company, employees) agree to permit the Company (or its agents) to conduct such due diligence as it deems necessary to satisfy itself on reasonable grounds that you comply with the aforementioned requirements (as applicable to the role) and that you will provide the Company with all information and/or documentation relating to your qualifications, experience, employment history, financial soundness and other interests that the Company requests for that purpose.

It is the individual responsibility of every employee to maintain a current awareness and understanding of and to fully comply with U.S. Bank’s “Code of Ethics”. Each employee is also expected to maintain an awareness of the laws, regulations, internal policies and procedures that are appropriate for her position.


Location expectations
This role is designated as home-based remote.

Accessibility

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need adjustments at any stage of the application or hiring process, please contact your recruiter for guidance and support.

Total Rewards

U.S. Bank is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices in line with local regulatory and legal requirements. Our total rewards approach is designed to attract, retain, and support top talent while ensuring equal pay for work of equal value.

We offer a market-competitive compensation package that includes:

  • Inclusive equitable benefits that are accessible to all employees and focused around our 3 main pillars of financial wellbeing, health & wellness).

  • Continuous development opportunities including training, education support, and career progression pathways based on inclusive and transparent criteria.

  • Employee recognition programs that celebrate achievements and milestones for all.

We regularly review our compensation and benefits to ensure they remain competitive, inclusive, and responsive to employee needs and market trends. Further details of the compensation package will be provided upon application.

Manager, Financial Reporting & Analysis Terms: Full-time (37.5 hours/week), Permanent Location: Remote in Canada, with hybrid or in-office options for cities with an office Salary: $100,000 MakeWay is looking for a Manager, Financial Reporting & Analysis to provide timely financial reporting, analysis, budgeting and forecasting to inform strategic, financial and operational decisions across the organization. Reporting to the Director of Finance, this role partners with cross-functional teams including Executive Leadership, Strategic Programs, Philanthropic Services, Operations, and Shared Platform to strengthen financial understanding and accountability. Responsibilities include coordinating key reporting deliverables, supporting external regulatory reporting and year-end audit activities, and contributing to the continuous improvement of financial systems and processes.

About MakeWay:

MakeWay is made up of two legal entities – MakeWay Foundation and MakeWay Charitable Society. MakeWay Charitable Society is an operating charity that houses 50+ environmental and social change projects across the country, also known as the Shared Platform. MakeWay Foundation is a national charity and public foundation with a goal to enable nature and communities to thrive together. We do this by building partnerships, providing solutions, grants, and services for the charitable sector across the country. If our values align with yours and you want to learn, grow, and develop within a supportive team that shares knowledge and cares, then we want to hear from you! Join us and make a difference.

What You’ll Do:

Financial Reporting & Analysis

Lead the accurate and timely monthly and quarterly financial reporting and analysis for internal teams, committees, board and external stakeholders. Analyze financial results, investigate variances and identify risks, opportunities and practical recommendations. Prepare regular and ad hoc financial reports, dashboards and key performance measures to support strategic and operational decisions. Coordinate quarterly Shared Platform revenue reporting for consolidation. Improve report design, consistency, quality assurance and efficiency in collaboration with Finance and Information Systems.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Business Partnering

Prepare the annual consolidated organizational budget and quarterly forecasts, including materials for senior management, the Finance & Audit Committee and Board. Partner with department managers through regular financial reviews, budget-to-actual analysis and forecasting discussions. Develop financial models to support planning and decision-making.

Compliance, Audit & Year-End

Support preparation of audit working papers and combined year-end financial statements. Support annual regulatory filings, including T3010 and IRS Form 990, for MakeWay Foundation and MakeWay Charitable Society, as applicable. Maintain reliable reporting practices aligned with applicable accounting standards and MakeWay policies. Coordinate year-in-review financial datasets and visualizations related to revenues and expenditures.

Process Improvement & Capacity Building

Work with Finance and Information Systems colleagues to identify reporting, accounting process and system integration improvements. Provide clear financial guidance to non-finance colleagues and help build financial literacy across business units. Develop or facilitate training on financial reporting, analysis, expense coding and related processes. Contribute to cross-functional initiatives and other finance priorities as required.

Who You Are:

Analytical Thinking: You excel at evaluating complex financial data, identifying trends and variances, optimizing reports, and using key metrics to support informed decision-making. Communication: You confidently present financial insights, explain complex concepts, and communicate effectively with cross-functional teams to support understanding and alignment. Collaboration: You work effectively with internal and external stakeholders, partnering across teams to coordinate financial reporting, support regulatory requirements, and advance organizational priorities. Problem Solving: You identify and address financial reporting and system challenges, improve accounting processes and systems, and develop practical, actionable solutions. Detail-oriented: You demonstrate a high level of precision and accountability, proactively identifying errors and inconsistencies to ensure accurate and reliable financial information.

Experience You Bring:

A minimum of 5 years of progressive responsibility with financial reporting, analysis, budgeting or related experience; non-profit or charitable sector experience preferred. A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. Knowledge of accounting principles relevant to not-for-profit and charitable organizations. Experience preparing financial statements, audit support, regulatory reporting and management reporting. Strong Excel and financial modelling skills; experience with reporting software and financial systems. Full-cycle accounting processing experience in a complex reporting environment. Experience providing financial information and reporting services to a diverse portfolio of internal and external clients, including experience in writing ad hoc reports. Hands-on experience with regulatory filings (e.g., T3010, IRS 990) and audit processes, including preparing working papers and year-end financial statements. Demonstrated ability to produce concise and complex financial reports; must be able to interpret, explain, report on, and provide advice on a variety of accounting, budgetary, and financial management issues. Proven ability to quickly learn complex business structures and accompanying system of coding and classification of financial transactions. Experience working with a remote team.

It Would Be a Bonus if You Have:

Accounting designation (CPA) or progress toward designation. Prior experience working in a mission-driven or non-profit organization. A solid understanding of compliance requirements for charitable organizations.

If you are interested in this role but are unsure if you qualify, send us your application anyway and tell us about why you can be a good fit for this position. We’d love to hear from you!

What We Offer:

The opportunity to have an impact on communities from coast to coast to coast. Full-time annual salary of $100,000. Comprehensive employer-paid extended health, vision, and dental benefits package, including an annual $300 Health Spending Account starting on your first day of employment. Year-end RRSP contribution. Pregnancy and Parental/Adoption Leave top up (subject to eligibility). Three weeks’ paid vacation (that increases with tenure) plus statutory holidays. MakeWay has implemented a Substitution Statutory Holiday policy which allows employees the flexibility to substitute another day for a statutory holiday. Winter office closure and 9-day summer fortnight program. 10 annual sick and personal days. Flexible work environment with remote working. An Indigenous Employees Network. Committed colleagues and a culture of collaboration, caring, and learning. High level of responsibility and autonomy. Opportunities and support for professional learning and development.

How to Apply:

Please submit a resume and cover letter through Dayforce. In your cover letter, please share a little bit about what inspired you to apply, why you’re interested in joining MakeWay, and how your experiences and skills could contribute to the team. We encourage candidates to apply as early as possible as applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Thank you!

Hiring Process:

Application Review: Our Manager of People, Engagement, and Learning reviews all applications as they are submitted and works with the Hiring Manager to shortlist candidates to invite to the phone screen stage. Phone Screen: Our Manager of People, Engagement, and Learning will conduct a 30-minute phone call with the candidate. Interview 1: Candidates selected to move forward from the phone screen will participate in a first-round panel interview through Microsoft Teams. Interview 2: Candidates selected to move forward will participate in a second-round interview panel through Microsoft Teams. Offer and References: 2–3 professional references will be conducted, and the selected candidate will be extended a verbal and written offer letter.

Supporting Equity in Our Hiring Process:

In an effort to recognize the time and energy that it takes to participate in a hiring process, MakeWay offers a $75 compensation for each panel interview. Interview questions will be provided 24 hours in advance.

MakeWay is strongly committed to equity and creating a diverse workplace community. We recognize that our recruiting and hiring processes are key to this commitment. We strive to reflect the diversity of our society on our teams and to provide a respectful workplace and equal working opportunities for all employees and applicants. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply. If you require accommodations at any point during the application or hiring process, please contact us at . This role is for a current vacancy, and MakeWay does not use artificial intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, or select applicants. Our sincerest appreciation to all those expressing interest in the position, however, only those applicants invited for an interview will be contacted. Thank you!

The ideal candidate combines strong customer service skills with attention to detail, professionalism, and a genuine commitment to helping others. raw.description:
ABOUT SITELINE

Siteline is a fast-growing Series A startup transforming how construction companies get paid, headquartered in San Francisco.

Specialty trade contractors build the infrastructure America runs on, from data centers and schools to highways and hospitals. Yet most are still managing millions of dollars in billing and payments through spreadsheets and manual processes.

We’re changing that.

WHAT PROBLEMS ARE WE SOLVING
Construction is the slowest paid industry, with contractors waiting around 96 days to get paid. For those 96 days, subcontractors are funding payroll, materials, equipment, and the cost of actually doing the work - all before seeing a single payment. It’s little wonder they describe themselves as “America’s largest bank”.

Our mission is simple: get subcontractors paid faster. And we’re damn good at it. Siteline customers average just 55 days to payment, and that number keeps falling.

We’re building in a massive, underserved market with no true direct competitor. And while AI is reshaping industries everywhere, the physical infrastructure our customers build isn’t going anywhere. Data centers, hospitals, schools, roads, and power infrastructure still have to be built -and the contractors building them need a radically better way to manage their receivables.

WHY ARE WE BUILDING THIS?

Construction software has historically been built for General Contractors. We’re building for the subcontractors actually doing the work.

These businesses are managing millions of dollars on spreadsheets, printouts, ERP reports, and a whole lot of manual work to get paid.

Every project has different billing requirements, different deadlines, and different paperwork. Miss something, and payment can get pushed out another 30 days.

Subcontractors deserve software built specifically for them. That’s why we built Siteline.

ABOUT THE ROLE
We’re looking for an Account Executive to join us at a pivotal stage of our growth. We’ve built a sales playbook that works, now we’re looking for great sellers to execute it and help us scale. The entire US is your territory. You’ll own deals end-to-end, work directly with our Head of Sales, and have close access to Marketing and Product as we continue to grow.

This is a role for someone who loves to sell; competitive, curious, coachable, and hungry to win. You love the hunt: prospecting, cold calling, creating your own pipeline, and turning a cold account into a closed deal.

You know how to create urgency, run a tight process, and close. You’ll get the upside and impact of an early-stage startup, with a proven playbook ready to execute.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 6+ years of closing experience as an AE in tech with a consistent track record of achieving sales targets (bonus: experience in construction technology)
  • Experience selling $70k+ ACV deals in a quick sales cycle (45-90 days) to $200M revenue+ companies
  • Experience selling to finance functions (CFOs, Controllers, AR Managers) and/or tech laggard industries (AEC, manufacturing, agriculture, real estate, healthcare, etc.)
  • Experience selling against the status quo - creating urgency and convincing customers to move away from spreadsheets, manual processes, or legacy systems.
  • Ability to own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through demo, negotiation, and close.
  • You’re a hunter. This is an outbound-first role, and you’ll self-source 50%+ of your pipeline through cold outreach, referrals, and creative prospecting. You have a track record of building and closing pipeline you generated yourself, and genuinely enjoy doing it.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, startup environment where cross-functional collaboration is key.
  • Willingness to travel 10% for on-site demos and trade shows
  • Bonus: Experience selling a product that integrates with ERPs

WHAT WE OFFER
Competitive Salary: We provide a salary that reflects your skills and experience, along with opportunities for performance-based bonuses. The range for this role is $110k-120k base / $220k-$240k OTE based on experience.

Health & Wellness Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance to support your well-being, along with wellness programs and resources.

Professional Development: Annual $1K learning stipend to use toward classes, certifications, conferences, or other meaningful career development.

Collaborative Culture: Join a supportive team that values creativity, innovation, and open communication, where your ideas are encouraged and celebrated.

Equity Options: As a startup, we offer equity options to ensure that you share in our success as we grow together.

Paid Time Off: Unlimited PTO policy with an encouraged three-week annual minimum.

Team Events: We regularly host team social activities and happy hours, and travel for company wide offs-sites once per year

INTERVIEW PROCESS

We value a transparent and straightforward process, and hope that providing this context up front gives you useful insight into what to expect.

  1. Application Review
  2. Head of Sales Interview | 45 min (Online)
  3. Take Home Assignment
  4. Take Home Assignment Presentation w/ Head of Sales + Head of Marketing | 45 min (in person)
  5. CEO Interview | 30 min (In Person)
SF Pay Range
$220—$240 USD

Company values

Move Quickly, Together

Speed is our advantage, but alignment is our path to victory. We will go farthest, fastest if we work in unison. Prioritize the mission, establish clear owners and deliverables, and execute with confidence.

Reach for the Sky

We are curious, open-minded, and courageous. We challenge ourselves and each other to ask more questions, push boundaries, and deliver excellence every day.

Run Lean

Construction is a scrappy industry where companies must do more with less. Same here. Operate efficiently, optimize strategically, and always get the most bang for our buck.

Be the Steel

Builds fail when the foundation is faulty. The same is true for us. Exercise good judgment, deliver on your commitments, and know your capacity—every base has its threshold, after all. Most importantly, back your teammates. We’re stronger than reinforced concrete when we support each other.

Build Our Fanbase

Our mission is to grow the size of the pie for everyone in construction. We only achieve that audacious goal if we keep our customers front and center. Work tenaciously to build smarter systems that solve real problems for our customers, positively impact their businesses and lives, and make them loyal fans.

Shoot Straight

We speak directly, candidly, and respectfully. We prioritize transparency, err on over-communicating, and understand that differing opinions and perspectives are part of a healthy company. Ultimately, it’s okay to disagree with—but still commit to—the chosen direction.
At Siteline, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. We know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Join us!

raw.description:
Who we are:

EverTrue is the leading advancement intelligence and donor engagement platform, empowering educational institutions and non-profit organizations to build stronger relationships and achieve outstanding fundraising results. Our platform continuously evolves, integrating innovative solutions to help advancement professionals effectively identify, prioritize, and manage prospects, engage supporters, and track progress. Hundreds of organizations rely on EverTrue to grow giving. We are a fun, smart, mission-driven team passionate about the work we do.

What truly drives us? It's our mission: to equip fundraising teams with the insights and tools to turn every donor interaction into a lasting relationship—leading to stronger connections and greater giving. And our vision? It's to create a world where every fundraiser has the tools to engage, retain, and grow generosity at every level, ensuring no donor is overlooked. When you join EverTrue, you're not just taking a job; you're becoming part of a movement to empower fundraisers and make a real difference in the world.

We believe in your potential. We know that no candidate perfectly matches every qualification. If you're excited about this role and meet most of our requirements, please apply! We're eager to support your growth and development within our team.

EverTrue is an equal opportunity employer. We're deeply committed to building a workplace that celebrates diversity, equity, and inclusion for all, ensuring every applicant and employee is treated fairly. We embrace DEI because we know it enhances engagement, satisfaction, and partnerships, making us all stronger together.

What You’ll Do:

Agentic development

  • Build and operate the claude-ops stack: Claude Code environments, skills, subagents, MCP servers, and guardrails.
  • Define human checkpoints and approval gates for agent actions in production.

CloudOps

  • Run and harden our AWS environment: availability, performance, cost, security.
  • Lead incident response: on-call, root cause analysis, blameless postmortems, runbooks. Automate repeat fixes so they stop being incidents.
  • Own infrastructure as code: Terraform, with some CloudFormation.
  • Build observability for systems and agents in Datadog, Grafana, and PagerDuty: alerting, agent-run tracing, token and cost tracking.
  • Maintain shared AWS services (MSK, RDS, networking) and manage DNS records.
  • Triage infrastructure issues for product development, platform, and support teams.
  • Find and cut cloud and LLM spend. Report savings in dollars.

Developer experience

  • Build the paved roads: reusable Terraform modules, GitHub Actions, base container images.
  • Unblock engineers with hands-on infrastructure support.
  • Shift left: document standard CI/CD and IaC patterns, run lunch-and-learns.

How you’ll contribute to the team:

You’ll be expected to:

  • Build the paved roads. Own the core developer platform: reusable Terraform modules, CI/CD actions, and base container images.
  • Make Claude the default way to work. Package our infrastructure patterns as Claude Code skills, subagents, and MCP servers, so developers can ship infrastructure changes through Claude within our guardrails. Teach the team how to use them.

Required

  • 5+ years in platform engineering, SRE, DevOps, or cloud operations running production SaaS.
  • AWS depth: multi-account setup, IAM, networking, managed databases, compute (EKS/ECS/Lambda).
  • Production Terraform (or equivalent IaC) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions).

Bonus

  • 1+ year running AI/LLM workflows in production
  • Hands-on experience with the agentic development lifecycle (ADLC): building agent-assisted workflows for engineering teams, such as Claude Code skills, subagents, MCP servers, and approval guardrails.
  • Fluency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, or Go.
  • Interest in the education or nonprofit sector.

Why you’ll love to join our team:
