raw.description:
The Principal Product Manager, Clinical Data Analytics, will play a pivotal role in shaping Tendo’s data-driven solutions by translating clinical and financial-focused activities into actionable insights that support patients, providers, and health systems. This individual will help define product strategy and functional requirements for analytics offerings, leveraging deep expertise with healthcare coding systems (ICD-10, DRG, CPT) and payer/provider data workflows. Specifically, this role will help define data requirements and business logic to:

  • Measure provider-level clinical quality from claims data.

  • Analyze the relationship between quality, price, and market share for health procedures.

  • Identify missing comorbidities from EHR patient records.

This role requires a strong balance of technical acumen, healthcare domain knowledge, and product management experience. This person will work closely with engineering, clinical informatics, and customer-facing teams to deliver data solutions that improve decision-making, enhance operational efficiency, and support Tendo’s marketplace growth. Under Tendo’s AI-First R&D model, this role operates as a Product Engineer with domain strength, owning features end-to-end from discovery through release, with AI as the first author at every stage.


About TendoMake an impact—join our team!

We’re a fast-growing, mission-driven company building a culture that enables teams and individuals to thrive. Our team-driven culture and rapid growth have earned us recognition as one of Forbes’ Top Startup Employers for 2024, 2025, and 2026. Led by an experienced and proven team, we live by our values and are always on the hunt for motivated people with diverse experiences and backgrounds to help us improve the care journey for patients, clinicians, and caregivers by creating software that provides seamless, intuitive, and user-friendly experiences.

If you like working with innovative technologies and want to be part of a growing team that will help transform the healthcare experience, we encourage you to apply today!

Job LocationSan Francisco Bay Area, CA

Tendo has hubs in San Francisco, CA; Salt Lake City, UT; Chicago, IL; Nashville, TN; and Philadelphia, PA. Candidates may be located in any one of our hub locations.

Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Roadmap: Help define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for clinical data analytics, aligning with company priorities, customer needs, and market opportunities.

  • Healthcare Data Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert on EHR, claims, pricing, payment, and healthcare coding data to ensure accurate, compliant, and valuable use of clinical and financial information in products.

  • Quality Measurement & Methodology: Define and maintain the business logic, measurement specifications, risk adjustment methodologies, scoring algorithms, and forecasting models that power Tendo’s quality analytics products, ensuring alignment with evolving CMS, commercial payer, and industry quality programs.

  • Clinical Analytics Leadership: Partner with quality measurement experts, clinical informatics, data science, and engineering teams to design methodologies that accurately measure provider performance, identify opportunities for quality improvement, and produce transparent and explainable analytics.

  • Customer Engagement: Collaborate with health systems, employers, payers, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, validate use cases, and ensure products deliver measurable value.

  • Execution & Delivery: Own assigned features end-to-end, from opportunity statement through specification, design input, build, documentation, and release, advancing work through the four PLA gate reviews with no handoffs between stages.

  • Analytics & Insights: Partner with data science and engineering to build tools that surface actionable insights for users, ensuring outputs are accurate, meaningful, accessible, and aligned with defined methodologies.

  • Market & Internal Collaboration: Monitor industry trends, competitive offerings, and regulatory developments to inform product direction, and work closely with Sales, Customer Engagement, and Operations to support go-to-market, adoption, and customer satisfaction.

  • AI-Directed Delivery & Knowledge Sharing: Use AI as the first author for specifications, acceptance criteria, documentation, and analysis; critically evaluate and refine AI-generated output, and contribute prompt patterns, quality examples, and design and decision standards to the shared team library.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, Data Science, Health Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 7+ years of product management experience in healthcare technology, healthcare analytics, data products, or a related field.

  • Deep expertise in U.S. healthcare quality measurement and performance frameworks, including nationally recognized programs such as CMS Star Ratings, Hospital Compare/Overall Hospital Quality Star Ratings, U.S. News Best Hospitals, Leapfrog Hospital Safety Grade, HEDIS, MIPS, ACO quality measures, and other value-based care models.

  • Demonstrated expertise in healthcare quality measurement science, including measure development, risk adjustment, provider attribution, benchmarking, statistical validation, and quality reporting. Ability to critically evaluate published quality methodologies and translate them into production-grade product functionality.

  • Experience translating complex clinical and quality measurement methodologies into product requirements, business rules, data models, and analytics solutions, partnering with engineering and data science teams to deliver scalable healthcare products.

  • Ability to translate complex quality measurement methodologies into scalable product requirements, analytics, AI-driven insights, and decision-support capabilities for healthcare organizations.

  • Strong working knowledge of healthcare coding systems, including ICD-10, DRG, and CPT, as well as claims, payment, and payer/provider data workflows.

  • Experience working with healthcare data standards and interoperability technologies, including HL7, FHIR, EHR data models, provider directories, and clinical terminology standards such as LOINC, SNOMED CT, and RxNorm, strongly preferred.

  • Experience working with large, complex healthcare datasets and translating data into meaningful products, insights, or analytics.

  • Working familiarity with SQL, Python, relational data concepts, or similar technical tools and concepts.

  • Demonstrated ability to define product strategy, requirements, business logic, and roadmaps for complex data-driven products.

  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical, clinical, and business teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to own product initiatives from discovery through delivery and post-release learning.

  • Demonstrated fluency with AI tools as a first author, with the ability to direct, evaluate, and refine AI-generated product specifications, documentation, and analysis using strong independent judgment.

Nice to Have

  • Advanced degree (MBA, MPH, MS in Health Informatics, MS in Data Science, or related field).

  • Experience with SaaS platforms, digital health solutions, or healthcare marketplaces.

  • Experience developing products that support provider quality reporting, value-based care, population health, care management, or healthcare transparency initiatives.

  • Experience with CMS quality programs, HRRP, HCC, Leapfrog, U.S. News, commercial quality scorecards, or other healthcare performance measurement frameworks.

  • Experience applying predictive analytics or machine learning to healthcare quality measurement, risk prediction, or forecasting.

  • Familiarity with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial claims data structures and reimbursement methodologies.

  • Familiarity with payer, provider, and employer data integration and reporting needs.

  • Understanding of value-based care, reimbursement models, and healthcare economics.

  • Experience working with EHR systems and clinical informatics teams in a product capacity.

raw.excerpt: K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit.
raw.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior ASIC Physical Design Engineer to help implement advanced SoCs that power next-generation satellite and space systems. In this role, you will contribute to the full physical design flow—from synthesis to GDSII—working closely with architecture, RTL, verification, and packaging teams. You’ll be a key contributor in achieving timing closure, optimizing PPA, and supporting design integration with external partners. You will be part of a collaborative design team developing state-of-the-art mixed-signal SoCs to be hosted on some of the largest, most powerful, rapidly designed and rapidly manufactured satellites ever deployed in space. In your first 6 months, you will develop and implement new SoC sub-systems for satellite communications and beyond. In your first two years, you will have contributed to developing cutting-edge SoCs that will fly in space. 

Responsibilities

  • Execute the complete physical design flow for complex SoC blocks and top-level integration, including synthesis, floorplanning, place & route, CTS, STA, and physical verification.
  • Perform timing closure and optimization across multiple corners and modes using industry-standard tools.
  • Collaborate with front-end, verification, and DFT teams to ensure clean handoff and predictable convergence.
  • Work with external physical design service providers and internal leads to review deliverables, resolve issues, and ensure schedule alignment.
  • Develop and maintain scripts and automation to improve flow efficiency and consistency.
  • Support physical sign-off activities including DRC/LVS, IR drop, EM, and power analysis.
  • Assist in chip-level integration, ECOs, and tapeout preparation.
  • Contribute to methodology development, tool evaluation, and flow documentation.
  • Support your product through production and spaceflight.

Required Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • 5–10 years of experience in ASIC physical design for complex SoCs.
  • Hands-on experience with industry-standard tools (Synopsys ICC2/Fusion Compiler, Cadence Innovus, or equivalent).
  • Strong understanding of timing analysis, power optimization, and physical verification flows.
  • Experience with hierarchical or flat SoC design methodologies.
  • Familiarity with FinFET technologies.
  • Working knowledge of DFT, UPF/CPF power intent, and ECO implementation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work cross-functionally in fast-paced environments.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Exposure to radiation-hardened or space-qualified ASICs.
  • Experience with chip-package co-design or advanced packaging (2.5D/3D).
  • Familiarity with physical design service vendor management or offshore collaboration.
  • Experience with sign-off through TSMC.
  • Experience with Gate-All-Around technologies.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, geographically distributed teams.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Base salary range for this role is $170,000 – $250,000 + equity in the company
  • Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
  • Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision/ coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Export Compliance

As defined in the ITAR, “U.S. Persons” include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (i.e., Green Card holders), and certain protected individuals (e.g., refugees/asylees, American Samoans). Please consult with a knowledgeable advisor if you are unsure whether you are a “U.S. Person.”

The person hired for this role will have access to information and items controlled by U.S. export control regulations, including the export control regulations outlined in the International Traffic in Arms Regulation (ITAR). The person hired for this role must therefore either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.15 or otherwise eligible for a federally issued export control license.

Equal Opportunity

K2 Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with K2 Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Go-to-Market (GTM) and Revenue Operations (RevOps) Specialists to contribute to a customer project focused on improving next-generation AI systems.

In this role, you will apply your professional expertise to evaluate GTM strategies, sales processes, and revenue operations workflows. You will provide practical insights, develop operational documentation, and assess business scenarios to help train and improve AI systems.

No prior AI experience is required. Your domain knowledge and professional judgment are what matter most.

  4. Proven experience developing or implementing sales enablement tools, CRM systems, or reporting solutions.
  5. Familiarity with modern GTM technology stacks and cross-functional collaboration best practices.

Bring more to life.


At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life. 

 

Our 60,000+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology.  

 

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference? At Danaher, you can build an incredible career at a leading science and technology company, where we’re committed to hiring and developing from within. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. 


Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.


The Senior Cybersecurity Culture Specialist is responsible for helping strengthen cybersecurity culture by translating cyber risk into practical, engaging experiences that influence employee behavior and reinforce secure ways of working. The role will develop and execute global awareness campaigns, role-based learning, phishing and social-engineering resilience activities, and communications that connect cybersecurity expectations to business, customer, and operational outcomes.

This position reports to the Director, Cybersecurity Culture and Awareness and is part of the Cybersecurity organization. The role will be based in Europe and will support a global audience while partnering across functions and operating businesses. The specific European location and work arrangement will be defined in the requisition.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Develop and execute enterprise cybersecurity culture and awareness campaigns, including audience-specific communications, learning experiences, toolkits, leadership materials, newsletters, SharePoint resources, and role-based learning for higher-risk populations and emerging topics.
  • Manage the enterprise phishing resilience program, including recurring enterprise-wide and role-based simulations, campaign planning, user communications and education, metrics, results analysis, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage and optimize security awareness platforms, phishing simulation tools, and learning management systems, including operations, enterprise integrations, vendor coordination, content, events, and program deliverables.
  • Partner with cybersecurity, HR, communications, legal/privacy, IT, and business stakeholders to identify human-risk priorities, integrate secure behaviors into business processes, and align awareness and training with internal requirements and frameworks and regulations such as NIST, ISO 27001, GDPR, and CMMC.
  • Use program data, employee feedback, phishing metrics, and human-risk indicators to measure effectiveness, identify trends and opportunities, and recommend improvements that strengthen security behaviors and reduce business risk.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Multiple years of professional experience spanning cybersecurity awareness or culture, human risk management, phishing simulation, security awareness platforms, learning technologies, instructional design, project management, information technology, organizational change, learning and development, communications, or closely related disciplines, including experience using the Abnormal Security platform.
  • Demonstrated experience in technical writing, instructional design, course development, and creating enterprise communications, awareness campaigns, learning content, or behavior-change initiatives for diverse employee audiences.
  • Experience using metrics, survey results, phishing or learning data, or other program measures to evaluate effectiveness and guide program improvements.
  • Experience working with cybersecurity concepts and translating technical or risk topics into clear, actionable guidance for non-technical audiences, together with experience managing cybersecurity culture or awareness programs and implementing security awareness and training strategies.
  • Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, communications, organizational change, learning, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience, together with relevant industry certification or professional development in cybersecurity, change management, communications, or learning (for example, Security+, CISSP, SANS Security Awareness Professional, or Prosci).

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

- Experience supporting global, matrixed organizations or regulated life sciences, diagnostics, biotechnology, healthcare, or technology environments

- Experience with policy governance and risk management; and content or web-management tools such as Synthesia, Adobe Captivate, and SharePoint.

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

JOB SUMMARY:

Spectrum Control is seeking a Senior Contracts Manager to support customer contract review, negotiation, and administration across all U.S. businesses. This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. The Contracts Manager partners with Sales and cross-functional teams to evaluate contractual requirements, identify risks, and develop practical solutions that protect the company’s interests and support business objectives.

The role supports domestic and international customer agreements across government and commercial markets, including aerospace, defense, medical, and oil and gas. Working in partnership with Sales, which serves as the primary customer contact, the Contracts Manager provides guidance throughout the contract lifecycle, from new product development through sustaining production.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of customer agreements; review, draft, redline, negotiate, and administer customer terms and conditions, nondisclosure agreements, and product agreements.
  • Evaluate contractual requirements, obligations, liabilities, and business risks; recommend language and negotiation approaches, and advise cross-functional teams on proposed commitments.
  • Review government and prime-contractor terms, including applicable FAR and DFARS provisions; identify potential issues and coordinate with Legal as appropriate.
  • Address terms for commercial and noncommercial product agreements during development and sustaining production, including information disclosures, intellectual property, confidentiality, and data rights.
  • Support resolution of customer-contract changes, disputes, and settlements in coordination with the Director of Contracts Administration and relevant stakeholders.
  • Maintain contract records and communicate key obligations, negotiated exceptions, and required approvals.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field required; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience reviewing and negotiating contractual terms and conditions and advising cross-functional business teams.
  • Experience supporting customer contracts and balancing contractual protections with commercial and operational objectives.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. government contracting requirements, including FAR and DFARS, with experience reviewing government or prime-contractor contract terms.
  • Experience evaluating contract provisions involving intellectual property, confidentiality, liability, warranties, termination, and dispute resolution.
  • Ability to translate complex contract language into clear guidance and practical recommendations.
  • Strong negotiation, written communication, analytical, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and collaborate independently with teams across multiple locations.
  • Experience with domestic and international customer agreements preferred.
  • Experience negotiating agreements across commercial industries, such as medical, oil and gas, or electronics manufacturing, preferred.
  • Familiarity with commercial and noncommercial product contracting and agreements spanning development through production preferred.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

About Team / Role

The Senior Pricing Operations Analyst is a high-impact, hybrid leader serving as the strategic architect of WEX’s most strategic and complex pricing networks. Operating at the intersection of Commercial Risk Operations, Product, and Technology, this role acts as the primary subject matter expert to ensure pricing functionality is scalable, technically sound, and aligned with enterprise-wide objectives.


As a trusted advisor and escalation point, you will move beyond traditional analysis to drive operational excellence by proactively identifying technical gaps and advocating for automated, data-driven solutions. In an environment where pricing functions may be siloed, you will serve as a critical bridge builder—translating complex business needs into actionable insights for internal stakeholders while mitigating financial risk and enhancing the merchant experience. Success in this role requires a "systems-thinking" approach to identify recurring themes, influence cross-functional roadmaps, and lead continuous improvement initiatives that deliver measurable economic gain.


Work Location: This role is flexible to be based remotely within the United States.


How You'll Make an Impact


INNOVATION & SYSTEMS ADVOCACY


  • Proactively identify and embrace opportunities to integrate AI and automation technologies into operational processes.
  • Act as a strategic consultant to Product and Technology teams, ensuring that new platform enhancements align with complex pricing logic and long-term scalability.
  • Drive initiatives to drive scale, reduce reliance on manual processes, and mitigate operational risks.
  • Advocate for enterprise-wide pricing functionality by translating operational gaps into technical requirements for cross-functional roadmaps.

ISSUE INVESTIGATION + RESOLUTION


  • Lead complex issue investigation and resolution across technical, product, and billing workstreams.
  • Manage communications of such issues across broad internal stakeholder groups and external constituencies.
  • Analyze recurring themes and red flags to drive systemic improvements, shifting from manual fixes to performance technical or process re-engineering.
  • Own, develop and implement creative solutions to improve internal and external client satisfaction.
  • Serve as a change agent for continuous improvement, applying strategic thinking, innovation and process re-engineering, to day to day activities.

AUDITING


  • Ensures compliance with established internal control and develop new controls if gaps are identified
  • Mitigate levels of financial risk as it relates to service levels and compliance
  • Identify if and where technical or processes are failing and advise on systemic changes to be made.
  • Ensure procedures, policies, and contracts are correctly followed and complied with.
  • Work with staff to ensure they are operating within SOX/SSAE Audit compliance.

RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT


  • Provide world class customer service to cornerstone clients.
  • Identify and exceed the needs of the organization and clients through collaboration, strategic outreach.
  • Partner with the Sales, Marketing and Relationship Divisions to maximize and grow pricing networks in a manner that is cost-effective and scalable.
  • Collaborate with internal parties to ensure solutions are designed to the maximum benefit of WEX’s technical ecosystem.
  • Demonstrate well-polished and proficient presentation, verbal and written communication skills.

REPORTING & ACTIONABLE INSIGHTS

PROJECT MANAGEMENT & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP

TRAINING & MENTORSHIP

raw.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

About the Role:

Forbes Advisor is hiring a Creative Strategist to develop and scale direct-response advertising across paid social for our home categories, including Home Security, Roofing, Windows, Showers, among others.

The role reports to the Creative Director of the home vertical and works closely with Editors, the production team, and our growth and media teams. You take an idea from research and angle through script, hook, and visual direction, and you execute it. That means directing talent on set or remotely, briefing Editors and creators, and giving creative notes through final delivery. A production team supports you with logistics and casting. When results come in, you read them and turn them into the next round.

You are a direct-response thinker with real creative taste. You can write a script that converts and direct a creator to deliver it. You know why an ad worked, not just that it did, and you use that to build the next winner. You understand hooks, awareness levels, objections, mechanisms, offers, and proof, and you know what feels native on Meta and TikTok.

We produce from three content sources: in-person shoots, remote UGC, and AI-generated video. You will concept for all three. We are a human-led shop that uses AI to work faster without lowering the bar. AI fluency is a baseline expectation, not a bonus.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver at least 2 net-new concepts a week across video and statics. Each includes a distinct strategic angle with supporting research, hooks and scripts or copy, visual direction and references, production and editing instructions, and recommended variations for testing.
  • Optimize existing creative every week. Use performance data to build iterations on winners, such as new hooks, angles, formats, and static variations, and retire what has stopped working.
  • Own each concept end to end through the pipeline, from idea through final delivery, including directing talent and creators on set and remotely.
  • Research audiences, competitors, customer reviews, and cultural conversations to find new angles.
  • Write scripts, hooks, headlines, CTAs, and ad copy for different formats and stages of customer awareness.
  • Brief Editors, the production team, and creators, and give specific, constructive creative notes through final delivery. Align with the Creative Director on concepts and direction.
  • Analyze creative performance to find winning concepts, messaging, hooks, and formats, and turn those learnings into iterations and new tests.
  • Partner with growth and media teams so creative work lines up with business goals.
  • Use AI tools for research, ideation, scripting, visualization, and production, and know where they help and where they don’t.
  • Make sure concepts meet legal, platform, and brand guidelines before production.
  • Help build repeatable processes that raise testing velocity and output.

Requirements:

  • A portfolio of 3–5 direct-response examples you personally developed, concepted, or wrote, preferably video, with a clear account of your individual contribution.
  • Measurable results behind that work (ROAS, CPA, CAC, CTR, conversion rate, or spend scaled), and examples of iterations you built from performance insights.
  • 3+ years in direct-response creative strategy for paid social.
  • Strong direct-response fundamentals: hooks, consumer psychology, awareness levels, objections, mechanisms, offers, and proof.
  • Exceptional copywriting across formats and audiences.
  • Strong visual taste: composition, styling, pacing, editing, and social-first creative, in video and statics.
  • Experience directing talent and UGC creators, including remotely.
  • Experience handing work to editors, creators, and a production team with briefs and notes they can act on.
  • Ability to read performance metrics and use them to inform creative decisions.
  • Comfort with AI tools and a point of view on where they help.
  • Comfort working at high volume and pace, managing creative end to end through a pipeline, and shipping many concepts, variations, and optimizations a week without dropping the bar.
  • A self-starter who is comfortable in a fast, start-up style environment.

Strong Pulses:

  • Performance creative in home categories like Home Security, Roofing, Windows, Showers, etc.
  • Journalism or documentary-style storytelling in addition to UGC.
  • Experience concepting for AI-generated video.

raw.excerpt: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster.
raw.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

This position is open to candidates with existing work authorization in the location where the position is advertised.


JOB OVERVIEW

The Program Manager, Housing Counseling provides technical and administrative support for the development of network-wide Housing Counseling toolkits, curricula, guidelines, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that build IRC’s capacity to deliver and sustain housing counseling services under IRC’s Housing and Urban Development (HUD) Housing Counseling Multi-State Organization (MSO). The role will support local offices in expanding housing counseling activities that strengthen client housing stabilization and homelessness prevention. This role will also support IRC’s housing programs and services in collaboration with the HQ Resettlement Team, Economic Empowerment Team, and other teams across RAI US. The position sits within the HQ Resettlement Housing Team and reports to the Director, Initial Resettlement.


MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Draft and update Housing Counseling curricula, toolkits, and SOPs aligned with HUD regulations and guidance (e.g., Handbook 7610.1 and 24 CFR part 214) and IRC’s Strategy 100, for use by housing counseling staff across IRC’s U.S. network and those preparing to take the HUD Housing Counselor Certification exam.
  • Prepare client-facing housing counseling curriculum materials for in-person counseling and workshop, plus online LMS platforms.
  • Maintain and update Resource Navigation tools that map available local, state, and federal housing stabilization, homelessness prevention, and rental assistance resources across the network.
  • Help plan and facilitate Housing Counseling and counselor certification training, as well as other IRC housing training, peer learning, and knowledge-sharing opportunities across the network, including through the Monthly Housing Call, Communities of Practice, Switchboard, and similar forums.
  • Serve as a first point of contact for day-to-day operational questions, providing technical assistance to support offices in launching, expanding, and sustaining housing counseling programming and other IRC housing programs and their requirements.
  • Respond to office requests for guidance on housing counseling program design, documentation, and compliance, applying established HUD requirements and IRC guidance, and escalating complex or ambiguous cases as needed.
  • Collaborate with the HQ Housing Team, HQ Economic Empowerment Team, Resettlement colleagues, and other HQ departments (e.g., Preferred Communities and Policy) to support the alignment of housing counseling programming with IRC’s broader housing and resettlement strategy.
  • Support data collection, outcome tracking, and HUD-required reporting (e.g., HUD Form 9902), compile and summarize program data to flag trends and gaps for program improvements, and contribute to housing related grant proposals, donor reports and applications, including mapping local funding opportunities in collaboration with field offices and HQ staff.
  • Draft standardized practices and quality assurance protocols (e.g., case file review guidance, supervisory monitoring templates) that align affiliate housing counseling practice with HUD Housing Counseling Program requirements, for review and approval.
  • Monitor changes to HUD Housing Counseling Program regulations and guidance, flag their implications for the network, and update network tools, curricula, and training materials as directed.
  • Attend HUD, intermediary, and national housing counseling meetings or forums, as assigned, and share key updates with the team.
  • Other duties as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree in Social Work, Urban Planning, Public Policy and Administration, or a related field preferred.
  • HUD Housing Counselor Certification strongly preferred, or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire; demonstrated working knowledge of HUD Housing Counseling Program requirements (24 CFR part 214, HUD Handbook 7610.1) required. Experience supporting HUD-approved housing counseling agency in compliance, technical assistance and capacity-building support preferred.
  • Minimum of 2–3 years of relevant professional experience in housing counseling, affordable housing programs, or housing case management, including experience contributing to curricula, SOPs, or training materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to draft, adapt, and facilitate curricula, toolkits, and training materials for adult learners across diverse organizational contexts.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with experience supporting multi-site or multi-state initiatives, and the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Experience working with refugee, immigrant, or other underserved populations preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to promote an organizational culture that reflects IRC’s core values of integrity, service, equality, and accountability.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office required; familiarity with types of AI solutions for operational productivity and accuracy required; experience with the HUD Housing Counseling System (HCS), client management systems (CMS), reporting, and other software used for counseling and IRC housing services is a plus.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time to visit IRC field offices and affiliates as required. Preference for candidates living within reasonable proximity of an IRC Housing Counseling location, to perform housing counseling activities as needed.

Compensation: (Pay Rate: $60,000-75,000/yr). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.


Cookies:


Benefits: IRC offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package. Highlights include 10 paid sick leave, 10 U.S. holidays, 20-25 generous paid time off based on role and tenure, medical insurance starting at $163/month, dental starting at $6.50/month, and vision starting at $5/month, flexible spending accounts (healthcare, dependent care, and commuter), a 403(b) retirement savings plan with employer match (immediate vesting) along with a non-elective employer contribution based on age and years of service (3-year vesting), disability and life insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering confidential counseling and support services for employees and their families.


Equal Opportunity Employer: IRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. raw.excerpt: The Work We DoTeciem designs, builds, and delivers treasury and capital markets software solutions for financial institutions worldwide.
raw.description:
The Work We Do

Teciem designs, builds, and delivers treasury and capital markets software solutions for financial institutions worldwide. We serve banks of every size and geography, offering the right setup for the right need.

Our solutions are designed to replace multiple disconnected systems with one complete, front-to-back platform, helping customers to capture trading and business opportunities quickly, clearly and with control. We cover the entire trading lifecycle, ensuring that everything - from execution to position keeping, to risk management – runs smoothly.

With decades of experience and one of the largest, most diverse client bases in the industry, we turn deep industry knowledge into software that covers most asset classes, meets complex real-world treasury and capital market's needs, and adapts as markets evolve.

What will you contribute?

The Global Solution Consulting team works with Sales, Product, Professional Services, Managed Services, Customer Support, Security, Commercial, and partners to shape and win customer opportunities. Teciem is seeking a senior, customer-focused Solutions Consultant with strong bank treasury knowledge and Kondor expertise for the Americas.

The Senior Solutions Consultant leads discovery, qualification, solution design, demonstrations, RFI/RFP responses, workshops, fit-gap analysis, proofs of concept, and customer-facing value articulation, translating complex requirements into clear Kondor solutions that Teciem can support and deliver.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Partner with Account Executives from qualification and discovery through proposal, commercial support, and transition to delivery.
  • Lead discovery with business, risk, operations, finance, architecture, security, and technology stakeholders to understand current state, priorities, constraints, and decision criteria.
  • Assess solution fit across client segment, product and asset-class coverage, deployment model, integrations, data residency, managed operations, implementation approach, and organizational readiness.
  • Design and position front-to-back Kondor solutions across trading, position keeping, pricing, limits, risk, operations, accounting, settlement, reporting, and integration.
  • Position Kondor Up, cloud deployment, managed services, APIs, Blueprints, modernization, and evergreening options where these align with the client’s target operating model and business objectives.
  • Own the demonstration strategy, storyline, environment readiness, delivery, question management, and follow-up for business, technical, and executive audiences.
  • Lead the Kondor functional workstream for RFIs, RFPs, proposals, due diligence, oral defenses, clarification sessions, and proofs of concept.
  • Coordinate Product, Services, Managed Services, Security, Commercial, Support, and partners so proposed solutions are coherent, supportable, and aligned across scope, architecture, implementation, and commercial assumptions.
  • Maintain current demonstration scripts, datasets, environments, discovery guides, response content, competitive positioning, and reusable solution assets.
  • Mentor GSC colleagues and contribute to internal enablement, product-readiness activities, demo excellence, and knowledge transfer to reduce dependency on individual product experts.
  • Travel across the Americas based on customer and opportunity requirements.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Deep knowledge of bank treasury and capital markets operations across front, middle, and back office, including several of: FX and money markets, fixed income, interest-rate products, derivatives, funding and liquidity, position management, P&L, risk, limits, settlement, accounting, and reporting.
  • Ability to discuss how treasury and trading platforms integrate with market data, execution venues, core banking, payments, general ledger, enterprise risk, data, and reporting ecosystems.
  • Demonstrable knowledge of Kondor, K+TP, or a comparable enterprise treasury and capital markets platform, with sufficient breadth to design and position a front-to-back solution.
  • Understanding of solution architecture, integrations, APIs, data flows, enterprise deployment models, cloud and SaaS concepts, managed services, non-functional requirements, and implementation dependencies.
  • Strong consultative discovery, presentation, demonstration, executive storytelling, written communication, and RFI/RFP response skills.
  • Commercial judgment to balance customer value, differentiation, solution integrity, delivery feasibility, risk, and deal momentum.
  • Fluent English and Spanish.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and lead virtual cross-functional teams across regions and time zones.

Experience

  • Typically 10 or more years of relevant experience in treasury and capital markets technology, banking, consulting, implementation, product management, solution architecture, or solution consulting.
  • Hands-on experience with Kondor, K+TP, or a comparable bank treasury platform in pre-sales, consulting, implementation, upgrade, migration, support, product, or a senior business-user role.
  • Experience leading complex enterprise software sales cycles, including discovery, demonstrations, fit-gap assessments, solution design, RFI/RFP responses, customer presentations, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Proven experience supporting complex enterprise software sales cycles within banking, financial services, fintech, treasury, or capital markets technology.

Education and Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, mathematics, engineering, computer science, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Formal training or certification in presentation skills, value selling, solution architecture, cloud technology, risk, treasury, or financial markets is preferred.

Success in the Role

  • Creates customer confidence by connecting treasury workflows, technology, and business outcomes to a coherent Kondor solution.
  • Builds reusable Kondor assets and transfers knowledge across GSC to improve scalability and coverage.

Role Boundaries

  • The Senior Solutions Consultant owns solution quality and customer-facing pre-sales leadership for assigned opportunities, but does not replace Product ownership, formal Services estimation, security approval, legal review, or Commercial pricing authority.
  • Roadmap items, delivery dates, implementation estimates, security commitments, customer references, and commercial figures must be validated by the appropriate owner before being represented externally.
  • When Kondor is not the best fit, the Senior Solutions Consultant is expected to recommend an adjacent Teciem solution, a partner-supported approach, or a qualify-out decision based on evidence.

Diverse Minds, Shared Ambition

At Teciem, we believe that our strength comes from the diversity of our people. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fuel our innovation and help us build solutions that truly make a difference in the world of financial technology.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, heard, and empowered to grow. Here, you can bring your whole self to work, contribute your unique ideas, and be part of a team driven by shared ambition.

We welcome talent from all walks of life and encourage applications from individuals of all genders, races, ages, abilities, identities, and beliefs. Together, we’re shaping a culture where diversity isn’t just celebrated — it’s essential to our success.

About the COOL company

At the COOL company, we believe in creating a win-win environment where everyone benefits. We are committed to ensuring users, publishers, franchisees, and advertisers have a better experience and achieve more through our innovation, advanced AI, groundbreaking advertising technology, and teams of inspired experts.

Brands under the COOL company include ADventori, a data-driven creative ad server; Balihoo, an advertising management platform for franchise and network businesses; COOL Media, a managed service solution for agencies and brands; Insticator, an SSP and engagement platform for publishers; and OKO Digital, which helps website and app publishers maximize their ad revenue.

Collectively, the COOL company reaches over 350 million consumers monthly across its network of premium publishers and advertisers, including Disney, Hyundai, Air France, Kohler, Suzuki, Acer, Pearle Vision, Trek, Brita, Viking Cruises, MLB, Playmaker, Blitz, Evolve Media, and more.

Our Core Values

At the COOL company, we believe in being C.O.O.L.:

  • Creative: We look for solutions that are smarter, faster, better, and more efficient.

  • Open-minded:We remain open to new ideas, solutions, and processes.

  • Optimistic: We approach challenges as opportunities to learn and improve.

  • Leaders: We value initiative, impact, accountability, and setting high standards.

We also believe in three guiding principles:

  • SleevesUp: Take ownership of your role and drive meaningful impact.

  • 100% Viewability: Embrace open feedback, transparency, and continuous improvement.

  • Be Defiantly Great: Challenge the status quo and pursue better outcomes.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Manager, Paid Media to drive strong client performance through the strategy, execution, and optimization of digital media campaigns across Paid Search, Paid Social, and Programmatic channels, including CTV, OLV, Display, Native, Audio, and more.

This senior individual contributor will own digital media strategy and performance across key accounts and serve as a trusted strategic advisor to C-suite and VP-level clients. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise across digital media channels with strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. They can translate complex performance data into strategic business recommendations and independently drive measurable client outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Digital Media Strategy & Execution

  • Develop, implement, and continuously refine digital media strategies across multiple clients, accounts, and industries.

  • Own channel performance outcomes, including ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, and other client-specific KPIs, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Use performance data, audience insights, competitive context, and market trends to inform optimization plans, testing strategies, and future media planning.

  • Provide hands-on strategic oversight of campaign planning, budget allocation, channel mix, forecasting, and measurement across Paid Search, Paid Social, and Programmatic.

  • Manage and optimize significant digital media budgets, making data-informed recommendations to improve performance and return on investment.

Senior Client Advisory & Communication

  • Serve as a strategic media advisor to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, VPs of Marketing, and other executive decision-makers.

  • Build and maintain trusted client relationships through proactive communication, business-focused reporting, and actionable strategic recommendations.

  • Lead client presentations and executive-level discussions on campaign performance, media strategy, testing plans, and future opportunities.

  • Translate channel-level metrics into business KPIs and clearly communicate campaign performance, trade-offs, and ROI.

  • Anticipate client needs and identify opportunities to improve campaign outcomes, measurement, and media effectiveness.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Expertise

  • Partner with Sales and Client Service teams to align media recommendations with client objectives and account priorities.

  • Collaborate with Analytics, Creative, Paid Social, and Account Services on campaign strategy, measurement, creative testing, and performance improvements.

  • Serve as a subject-matter expert on digital media platforms, industry developments, and emerging performance marketing practices.

  • Identify practical ways to apply AI tools and new technologies to improve campaign effectiveness, analysis, and workflow efficiency.

  • Share media insights, effective practices, and technical knowledge with colleagues when useful, without formal responsibility for managing or evaluating team members.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on digital paid media experience, ideally in an agency or similarly fast-paced environment.

  • Demonstrated success building and maintaining strategic relationships with senior-level clients.

  • Proven experience managing multimillion-dollar digital media budgets with a focus on performance and ROI.

  • Deep knowledge of platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, DSPs, SSPs, and business intelligence tools such as Looker.

  • Strong analytical skills and experience with attribution models, forecasting, measurement, and performance analysis.

  • Exceptional presentation, communication, and storytelling skills, including the ability to make complex data understandable to executive audiences.

  • Experience using AI tools to improve campaign performance, analysis, or workflow efficiency is a plus.

  • Ability to independently prioritize complex work, make data-informed decisions, and manage multiple accounts and deadlines.

Cultural Competencies

  • Must be able to work primarily between the hours of 9:30 AM–6:30 PM ET.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and meet deadlines.

  • Skilled at receiving and providing direct feedback.

  • Collaborative mindset and strong teamwork skills.

  • Entrepreneurial, adaptable, and eager to learn.

  • Curious, research-minded, and data-informed.

  • Able to investigate possible solutions and apply them.

  • Creative confidence and proactive communication.

  • A sense of humor and a love of online culture.

  • Thrives in a start-up culture.

Benefits

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Annual performance bonus

  • Paid time off

  • Company holidays

  • Flexible work schedule

  • 401(k)

Senior Digital Marketing Manager (B2B Growth, Demand Generation & Performance Marketing) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Pakistan
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Digital Marketing Manager to own and scale their B2B growth engine.

This is a high-impact, revenue-focused role for someone who understands that marketing is about driving qualified pipeline—not just running campaigns. You’ll lead demand generation across paid, organic, and outbound channels while building scalable systems that consistently generate leads, improve conversion rates, and contribute directly to revenue growth.

You’ll work closely with leadership and sales to optimize the entire marketing funnel—from awareness to customer acquisition—using data, experimentation, and automation.

If you think in terms of pipeline, CAC, CPL, conversion rates, and revenue, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

B2B Growth & Demand Generation

  • Develop and execute full-funnel B2B marketing strategies that drive qualified pipeline and revenue.
  • Build scalable inbound and outbound demand generation programs across multiple channels.
  • Increase Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs), Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs), and overall pipeline contribution.
  • Optimize lead quality and conversion throughout the customer journey.
  • Continuously identify new growth opportunities through testing and experimentation.

Paid Advertising & Performance Marketing

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across:
    • LinkedIn Ads
    • Google Ads
    • Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)
  • Monitor and improve:
    • Cost per Lead (CPL)
    • Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
    • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
    • Conversion Rates
  • Conduct ongoing A/B testing of audiences, creatives, messaging, and landing pages.
  • Scale high-performing campaigns while maintaining profitability.

Content, SEO & Organic Growth

  • Support SEO strategy through keyword research, content planning, and search intent optimization.
  • Improve organic traffic and inbound lead generation.
  • Ensure consistent messaging across paid, organic, and outbound marketing channels.
  • Optimize landing pages and website content to improve conversion performance.

CRM, Marketing Automation & Email Marketing

  • Manage marketing operations using HubSpot or similar CRM platforms.
  • Build and optimize:
    • Lead nurturing workflows
    • Lead scoring models
    • Email automation sequences
    • Marketing automation campaigns
  • Improve attribution reporting, campaign visibility, and marketing analytics.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.
  • Present campaign performance, pipeline insights, and growth recommendations to leadership.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to execute marketing initiatives.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement process improvements.
  • Help scale marketing systems, workflows, and best practices.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You think beyond marketing metrics and focus on business growth.
  • You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • You’re highly analytical and comfortable making decisions based on performance data.
  • You take ownership and continuously optimize for better results.
  • You thrive in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments.
  • You understand long B2B sales cycles and revenue attribution.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B digital marketing, growth marketing, or demand generation.
  • Proven success driving:
    • Pipeline growth
    • Qualified leads (MQLs & SQLs)
    • Revenue impact
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • LinkedIn Ads
    • Google Ads
    • Meta Ads
    • HubSpot or similar CRM platforms
  • Experience managing multi-channel demand generation campaigns.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience measuring campaign performance and ROI.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in SaaS, agency, or service-based businesses.
  • Experience with outbound marketing and sales enablement initiatives.
  • Previous leadership or team mentoring experience.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • B2B attribution
    • Funnel optimization
    • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
    • Marketing analytics and reporting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent growth in qualified MQLs and SQLs.
  • Lower customer acquisition costs and improved marketing ROI.
  • Increased marketing contribution to revenue and sales pipeline.
  • Higher conversion rates throughout the marketing funnel.
  • Scalable marketing systems that support long-term business growth.
  • Clear reporting and actionable insights that drive strategic decisions.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Strategy & Growth Discussion
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows hiring managers to evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re a performance-driven marketer who knows how to build scalable growth systems, optimize every stage of the B2B funnel, and turn marketing into measurable pipeline and revenue, we’d love to hear from you.

Who we are:

Unisys is a global information technology company that builds high-performance, security-centric solutions for the most digitally demanding businesses and governments on Earth. Unisys’ offerings include security software and services; digital transformation and workplace services; industry applications and services; and innovative software operating environments for high-intensity enterprise computing. Our Core Beliefs:

  • Creativity: We look past routine ways of doing things.
  • Client-Centricity: Our clients’ success is our success.
  • Integrity: We act ethically and honestly.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data and Analytics Specialist to join our team. As a Data and Analytics Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in our organization, utilizing your 4-6 years of experience in data analysis and reporting to drive insights and inform strategic decision-making. Your expertise in Visier, Workday Reporting, Advanced Excel, Power BI, SQL, Power Query, Power Pivot, and complex formulas will be essential in handling complex datasets, creating advanced data models, and delivering actionable reports and visualizations.

Responsibilities:

Data Analysis and Interpretation: Analyze large and complex datasets using advanced Excel functions, Power Query, and SQL queries to identify patterns, trends, and insights. Utilize complex formulas in Excel to manipulate and transform data as needed. Interpret the data to provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders.

Reporting and Visualization: Develop interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI, Visier, incorporating Power Query and Power Pivot, to present data-driven insights in a clear and compelling manner. Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their requirements and create customized visualizations that effectively communicate key metrics and KPIs.

Data Modeling and Manipulation: Design and implement advanced data models using Power Pivot to support reporting and analytics requirements. Utilize Power Query to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into a centralized data repository. Transform and cleanse data using complex formulas to ensure accuracy and consistency.

Performance Monitoring: Develop and implement monitoring mechanisms to track the performance and effectiveness of data analytics initiatives. Utilize Power Pivot to create advanced calculations and measures. Identify areas for improvement and proactively suggest solutions to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

Collaboration and Stakeholder Management: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including business leaders, data engineers, and IT professionals, to understand their data requirements and deliver insights that align with business goals. Communicate complex technical concepts, including Power Query, Power Pivot, and complex formulas, to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

Continuous Learning and Innovation: Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data analytics. Identify opportunities to leverage Power Query, Power Pivot, and advanced Excel functions to enhance data analysis processes and deliver more impactful insights.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

Skills, Experience & Qualifications:

BA/BS degree and 4-6 years’ relevant experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience

Proficiency in Advanced Excel, including complex formula creation, pivot tables, and data visualization.

Expertise in Visier & Power BI for creating interactive dashboards and reports, incorporating Power Query and Power Pivot. Experience with Workday Reporting is a plus.

Strong SQL skills, including data extraction, transformation, and manipulation.

Solid understanding of data modeling concepts and experience with database management systems.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen attention to detail.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Proven track record of delivering high-quality, accurate, and actionable insights from data analysis.

SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.

Job Description Summary:

The Engineer III, Energy Storage is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and optimization of BESS projects. This role provides strategic direction, technical expertise, and engineering oversight to ensure successful delivery of BESS solutions that meet performance, reliability, and safety requirements.

This role is fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Job Description:

*This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned

Position Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Serve as a technical subject matter expert (SME) for BESS engineering scopes, providing guidance and technical direction to project teams.
  • Lead and manage the design and engineering of battery energy storage systems (BESS), ensuring compliance with contracts, utilities, and AHJ requirements.
  • Review feasibility studies, site assessments, and system sizing analyses to recommend optimal BESS configurations and future augmentation provisions.
  • Serve as a senior technical contributor across electrical, civil, structural, SCADA, and HV engineering scopes on assigned projects. 
  • Manage Engineers of Record and third-party engineering partners to ensure scope clarity and timely delivery. 
  • Coordinate with fire protection engineers and local fire departments/ AHJ’s.
  • Develop and review technical specifications, drawings, and documentation for BESS components to support procurement activities.
  • Provide technical oversight during procurement including vendor recommendations and drawing reviews.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and contractors to design, procure, install, and commission BESS systems.
  • Oversee system modeling, simulation, and analysis to optimize performance, efficiency, and reliability.
  • Provide engineering support during construction, including field issue resolution, design clarifications, and minor redesigns. 
  • Provide engineering support for testing, validation, commissioning, energization, and initial synchronization.
  • Ability to mentor junior engineers and project teams, providing guidance, training and lessons learned on BESS design principles and practices.
  • Stay current with industry trends, standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Support business development through proposals, presentations, and technical consultations.
  • Represent SOLV Engineering in customer and client meetings.
  • Participate in regular team meetings/ calls.
  • Travel as required to support project execution.
  • Complete other responsibilities as assigned. 

Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field; Master's degree preferred.
  • 3+ years of electrical engineering experience with focus on BESS, renewables, or power systems.
  • Expertise in design, integration, and optimization of battery energy storage systems; including lithium-ion batteries, inverters, BMS (Battery Management Systems), and grid interconnection equipment.
  • Knowledge of BESS control strategies, algorithms, and optimization software.
  • Proficiency in power system analysis (PSS/E, PSCAD, etc.) and simulation tools.
  • Strong working knowledge of applicable codes and standards (NEC, IEEE, IBC, ASCE, NESC, NFPA, utility standards). 
  • Strong understanding of grid operations and regulatory requirements (FERC Order 841, IEEE 1547).
  • Strong understanding of fire protection requirements (UL9540, UL9540A, NFPA855).
  • Understanding of communication protocols used in SCADA and Energy Management Systems (IEC 61850).
  • Project management experience including budgeting, scheduling, and risk management.
  • Strong understanding of EPC engineering workflows, including design deliverables, submittals, document control, and coordination with engineering partners 
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and resources.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, manage multiple projects, adapt to dynamic project requirements, and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Bluebeam, with ability to maintain trackers, logs, schedules, and reports 
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and sustainability.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring employer sponsorship now or in the future.

raw.description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we help improve the quality and reliability of clinical trial data by providing specialized clinical assessment, training, and quality oversight solutions to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies around the world.

Our team partners with sponsors and research sites to support the consistent administration, scoring, and review of clinical outcome assessments across global clinical trials. Through services including central scoring, central review, image-based review, rater training and certification, calibration, and quality review and remediation, we help reduce variability, strengthen data quality, and ensure greater confidence in clinical trial endpoints.

Our work spans multiple therapeutic areas, including dermatology, where we engage experienced clinicians to bring indication-specific and scale-specific expertise to clinical trial programs. Our experts help ensure assessments are performed and evaluated consistently, from training and certifying site raters to centrally reviewing scores and images and identifying opportunities for remediation.

Our global team brings together clinical, scientific, operational, data, and technology expertise to solve complex challenges in clinical trials. At Cogstate, our goal is simple: to help sponsors generate high-quality, reliable data that supports confident decision-making throughout clinical development.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

About the Role

Cogstate is seeking experienced Dermatologists to support clinical research studies through a range of centralized assessment and quality oversight services. In this fully remote, contract-based role, clinicians may perform Central Scoring, Central Review, Image-Based Review, Site Rater Training & Certification, Calibration Activities, and Quality Review & Remediation across a variety of dermatology clinical trials.

Cogstate provides comprehensive, fully compensated training on study protocols, scoring methodologies, review processes, and operational requirements before clinicians begin study work. Ongoing calibration exercises and quality oversight activities help ensure consistency, reliability, and regulatory compliance across all study assessments.

Depending on study needs and individual expertise, consultants may contribute to one or more service areas, including:

  • Central Scoring: Independent scoring and interpretation of dermatology-specific clinician-reported and observer-reported outcome measures.
  • Central Review: Secondary review of completed assessments to ensure accuracy, consistency, and protocol adherence.
  • Image-Based Review: Evaluation of clinical photographs and imaging data to assess disease severity, treatment response, and endpoint compliance.
  • Site Rater Training & Certification: Training, certifying, and supporting site-based raters on proper scale administration and scoring procedures.
  • Calibration Activities: Participating in ongoing calibration exercises to maintain inter-rater reliability and scoring consistency across global studies.
  • Quality Review & Remediation: Identifying assessment quality issues, providing corrective feedback, and supporting remediation efforts to improve data quality and protocol compliance.

These are fully-remote, contract positions. Work is provided on an as-needed basis and scheduled according to clinician availability.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MD or DO with specialization in Dermatology.
  • Board-certified or board-eligible Dermatologist preferred.
  • Active and unrestricted medical license in a relevant jurisdiction.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of post-training clinical practice experience in dermatology.
  • Experience evaluating and managing patients with dermatologic conditions in clinical, academic, or research settings.
  • Demonstrated experience with dermatology clinical outcome assessments, disease severity scales, and clinician-reported outcome measures.
  • Experience with one or more dermatology indications such as atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, vitiligo, hidradenitis suppurativa, alopecia areata, prurigo nodularis, eczema, chronic pruritus, or other inflammatory and rare dermatologic disorders.
  • Familiarity with dermatology rating scales and assessments such as EASI, IGA, SCORAD, PASI, DLQI, VASI, PP-NRS, HiSCR, CDLQI, and other study-specific outcome measures.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to consistently apply scoring criteria and identify assessment quality issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide training, feedback, and remediation guidance to site personnel.
  • Proficiency with telehealth platforms, Microsoft Office applications, and web-based clinical trial systems.

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!
