Job Description: Computational Biology & Bioinformatics Expert (PhD)

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote (Worldwide)

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Computational Biology and Bioinformatics Experts to contribute their scientific expertise to the development and evaluation of next-generation AI systems.

In this role, you will apply your knowledge of computational biology, genomics, and bioinformatics to assess complex scientific workflows, analyze biological datasets, and evaluate AI-generated outputs. Your contributions will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and scientific reasoning capabilities of AI systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, evaluate, and critique bioinformatics and computational biology workflows for AI benchmarking initiatives.
  • Provide expert insights into genomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic data analysis pipelines.
  • Assess and optimize pipeline parameters, software configurations, and statistical methods to ensure accuracy and reproducibility.
  • Analyze biological datasets, including NGS, RNA-seq, variant analysis, and protein structure data, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Apply domain expertise to support the development and validation of biology-focused AI models and tools.
  • Communicate complex scientific concepts clearly to technical and non-technical collaborators, both verbally and in writing.
  • Document research findings, methodologies, and best practices to support knowledge sharing and collaboration.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, or a closely related field, or equivalent industry or research experience.
  • Professional written and spoken English proficiency (C1 level or higher).
  • Hands-on experience analyzing biological datasets, such as NGS, RNA-seq, and genomic variant data.
  • Proficiency in Python and/or R for scientific analysis.
  • Experience with standard bioinformatics tools such as BLAST, Samtools, GATK, Bioconductor, or Biopython.
  • Experience developing reproducible workflows using tools such as Nextflow or Snakemake.
  • Familiarity with Linux and command-line environments.
  • Strong statistical, quantitative, and analytical reasoning skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities, with the ability to clearly document and explain technical concepts.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex scientific problems in specialized biological domains.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI/ML-assisted biology workflows or benchmarking initiatives.
  • Peer-reviewed publications, patents, or contributions to open-source bioinformatics software.
  • Background in single-cell analysis, structural biology, proteomics, or drug discovery.

SPS Commerce is a leading provider of cloud-based supply chain management solutions, serving a global network of retail trading partners. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where innovation and continuous improvement are highly valued. Join SPS Commerce and be part of a dynamic team that's transforming the global retail supply chain!

Position Summary:

As a GTM Engineer, you will help build and maintain the systems and workflows that power our go-to-market engine. This is a hands-on technical role embedded in the GTM organization, focused on execution and delivery. You'll ship reliable automations and workflows that sellers and GTM teams can trust, and partner effectively on well-defined problems to improve productivity and operational effectiveness.

This role reports to the Senior Director of GTM Engineering & AI Enablement. You'll work under the direction of GTM & Engineering Leadership, with opportunities to grow your scope over time as you demonstrate strong execution and increasing ownership.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain automated workflows using tools like n8n, Clay, and Claude Code, with a focus on shipping reliable automations that sellers can trust
    -Contribute to data models, ETL pipelines, and enrichment workflows that support outbound targeting, account scoring, and growth initiatives
    -Help support the integration layer across Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, Snowflake, and Clay — the data infrastructure that GTM agents and automated workflows depend on for reliable signal ingestion, enrichment, and execution
    -Partner with Sales, RevOps, Enterprise AI Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success on scoped requests, translating clear requirements into working solutions

    Required Qualifications:

Get to Know Us — Darwoft

Founded in 2010, Darwoft is a Latin American software and AI company helping startups and global enterprises build, modernize, and scale digital products. Our work spans MVP development, enterprise applications, data engineering, AI, and product design—with a focus on secure, scalable, user-centered solutions.

Our people-first culture brings together technical expertise, curiosity, and collaboration. At Darwoft, you'll work alongside multidisciplinary teams, contribute to international projects, and keep growing through shared knowledge and continuous learning.

About the Project

We're partnering with a fast-growing fintech company making financial services more accessible to Latino communities in the United States.

Its platform combines AI-powered conversational experiences with real-time financial infrastructure, allowing users to send money internationally through familiar channels such as WhatsApp. The product ecosystem is expanding across web and mobile applications, with financial services that go beyond remittances into credit, savings, and digital wallets.

You'll help connect backend systems, conversational workflows, and user interfaces to make complex financial transactions simple and accessible.

About the Role

We're looking for two Senior Fullstack Engineers to build and evolve financial products across backend, web, and mobile.

As part of the Product Engineering team, you'll contribute to the full development lifecycle: designing backend microservices, building user interfaces, integrating APIs, and improving features based on customer feedback and product analytics.

The technology environment includes Python, React, React Native, and Google Cloud. We value engineers who can work across application layers, make thoughtful technical decisions, and take ownership of features from implementation through production.

The team welcomes diverse technical backgrounds. Familiarity with the stack is valuable, alongside strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn and adapt.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend microservices supporting financial transactions and the core conversational platform.
  • Develop and improve web interfaces with React and contribute to mobile experiences built with React Native.
  • Connect frontend applications with backend APIs to deliver consistent user journeys across web, mobile, and messaging channels.
  • Build and iterate on conversational interfaces that help users interact naturally with financial services.
  • Contribute to infrastructure capable of handling millions of daily requests and real-time messaging workloads.
  • Develop and integrate backend services using Google Cloud technologies and established engineering practices.
  • Apply architectural patterns that support maintainability, scalability, and clear separation of responsibilities.
  • Support product experimentation and controlled releases through A/B testing, feature flags, and gradual rollouts.
  • Collaborate with product managers, UX/UI designers, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate customer needs into working software.
  • Use customer feedback and analytics to improve usability, reliability, and the overall conversational experience.
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to technical discussions and shared engineering practices.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, with experience delivering fullstack applications in fast-paced environments.
  • A proven ability to build, ship, and improve production software with measurable user or business impact.
  • Experience working across backend services and frontend applications, including API integration.
  • Strong foundations in algorithms, data structures, and software design.
  • Experience with web services, including REST APIs, and familiarity with SOAP.
  • Familiarity with Hexagonal Architecture and Event-Driven Architecture.
  • Understanding of A/B testing, feature flags, and gradual rollout strategies.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Cursor, Codex, or similar technologies.
  • Strong prioritization skills and ownership of delivery and technical decisions.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, design, and business teams.
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous learning.
  • Advanced English, with the ability to communicate clearly in technical discussions and cross-functional collaboration.

Technology Environment

You don't need to have used every technology below. Relevant experience with comparable tools and the ability to adapt are also valued.

  • Backend: Python, Flask, FastAPI, REST APIs, gRPC
  • Frontend: React, JavaScript, HTML/DOM, CSS, HTTP, AJAX
  • Mobile: React Native
  • Data & Caching: SQL, Redis, Firestore
  • Google Cloud: Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Artifact Registry, BigQuery, Cloud Composer
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Terraform
  • Observability & Operations: New Relic, PagerDuty

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Python and Flask or FastAPI.
  • Experience building production web applications with React.
  • Experience developing mobile applications with React Native.
  • Experience building chatbots, conversational interfaces, or messaging integrations.
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud services, Kubernetes, or Terraform.
  • Experience working with high-volume transactional systems.
  • Experience or a strong interest in fintech, payments, remittances, or digital wallets.

What Darwoft Offers

  • 100% remote work.
  • Argentina's public holidays.
  • PTOs

  • Access to learning platforms.

raw.description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

As a Senior Renewal Manager, Public Sector at Chainguard, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the retention and long-term success of our Public Sector customers across federal, state, and local government, along with the systems integrators and partners who serve them. You will own the renewal process for a book of our largest and most complex public sector contracts, managing renewals from early planning through award while navigating government budget cycles, contract vehicles, and procurement requirements.

This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Sales, Partners, and Ops. By owning renewals, you enable Customer Success to focus on adoption and mission outcomes, and Sales to focus on expansion and new business. Your work ensures renewals are planned around fiscal year timing and funding realities, so customers keep their coverage in place without gaps, while supporting Chainguard’s broader revenue and retention goals.

You will act as a trusted partner to customers, resellers, and primes, guiding renewal conversations with clarity, patience, and confidence. Attention to detail, fluency in government contracting, and strong cross-functional collaboration are essential, as public sector renewals involve long lead times, many stakeholders, and little room for error.

What you’ll do:

  • Renewal Management: Own the end-to-end renewal process for a portfolio of public sector customers, starting renewal planning 6 to 9 months ahead of contract end to align with budget cycles, fiscal year-end, and option year exercises.
  • Contract Vehicles & Partners: Manage renewals through resellers, distributors, and contract vehicles (such as GSA Schedule, SEWP, and agency-specific vehicles), coordinating quotes, pricing, and paperwork with channel partners and primes.
  • Commercial Execution: Generate renewal quotes, lead pricing and contract discussions, and coordinate with Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, and Contracts to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely execution.
  • Funding & Procurement: Track funding status, continuing resolutions, period of performance dates, and procurement milestones, and escalate early when timing puts a renewal or coverage at risk.
  • Forecasting & CRM Hygiene: Maintain accurate renewal data in CRM, including forecasts, risks, and renewal status, to provide clear visibility and predictable outcomes.
  • Risk & Retention Strategy: Identify renewal risks early, including budget cuts, program changes, and competitive pressure, and collaborate with Customer Success, Sales, and Partners to mitigate churn and improve gross retention.
  • Process & Playbooks: Develop and refine public sector renewal playbooks, including fiscal year-end planning and vehicle-specific processes, to increase efficiency and improve on-time renewal rates.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Serve as the subject matter expert on public sector renewals, mentor other Renewal Managers, and help shape how the function scales as Chainguard grows its government business.

What we're looking for:

  • 6+ years of experience in renewals, contracts, account management, or sales supporting U.S. federal, state, or local government customers, with direct ownership of customer contracts and commercial conversations.
  • Deep knowledge of government procurement, including contract vehicles, resellers, option years, and federal fiscal year timing.
  • Track record of owning government contracts, including enterprise license agreements, and renewing them at or above value.
  • Proven ability to drive renewals with predictability and deliver against gross retention targets.
  • Experience working with channel partners, distributors, and systems integrators on quoting, pricing, and order execution while maintaining strong customer relationships.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple renewal cycles simultaneously.
  • Comfort generating quotes, preparing order forms, and maintaining CRM hygiene, ideally in Salesforce.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • High emotional intelligence, strong communication skills, and a proactive, problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to operate with full autonomy in a fast-paced, evolving environment and lead the build-out of new processes where needed.

Pay Range: Up to $195,000 70/30 OTE

If your experience is close, but doesn’t fulfill all requirements, please apply. Chainguard is on a mission to build the best team. To achieve our goal, we are focused on hiring Chainguardians with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
  • We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

  • Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
  • 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
  • ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
  • 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

Controller

Reports to: Chief Financial Officer

Job Status: Full-Time

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Location: Remote

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Controller manages the day-to-day financial operations of Grenova and its sister companies, Peak Robotics (PRI) and Peak Analysis and Automation (PAA). The role is responsible for the accuracy and timeliness of the books, the monthly and annual close, financial reporting, internal controls, and regulatory compliance. We run a lean finance function and use AI and automation wherever we can, so this is a hands-on role for someone who wants to be in the detail and to build better ways of working. The Controller is also the accounting lead for the move from three separate ERP systems to a single NetSuite environment, and partners with the CFO, who leads financial strategy and planning.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • CPA required; Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Public accounting experience, ideally Big 4 or another well-regarded firm.
  • Hands-on fluency with AI tools (for example Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot) and a track record of using them to automate close, reconciliation and reporting work, or a strong interest in learning to.
  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience; Controller or Assistant Controller experience is a plus but not required.
  • Strong working knowledge of GAAP and financial regulations.
  • Experience with month-end and year-end close for multi-entity organizations, including intercompany; international (US and UK) experience is a plus.
  • Experience with cost and inventory accounting; manufacturing, lab automation or other technology experience is a plus but not required.
  • Experience supporting or leading an ERP implementation or migration; NetSuite experience strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency with business accounting software (Dynamics 365 Business Central a plus) and advanced Excel skills.
  • Familiarity with payroll systems and HR-related financial processes.
  • Working knowledge of tax compliance requirements.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with close attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines and work with outside providers; experience supervising staff is a plus.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, comfort with direct feedback, and a high sense of ownership.
  • Experience in a small to mid-sized company is a plus. Remote; any US time zone, with some overlap with UK hours.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Accounting Operations and Financial Reporting

  • Manage accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, cost accounting, and inventory accounting.
  • Own the month-end and year-end close, including account reconciliations, accruals, and intercompany eliminations.
  • Prepare and review accurate financial statements, including income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow reports, for management, lenders, and other stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with GAAP or other applicable accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting policies and procedures and document key processes.
  • Use AI and automation to streamline the close, reconciliations and reporting, including data feeds from source systems, and keep a written runbook for each process.
  • Supervise, train, and develop accounting staff and outside providers as the team grows.

Inventory and Cost Accounting

  • Oversee inventory valuation, reconciliation, cycle count review, and related reporting.
  • Maintain standard costing, variance analysis, and cost-of-goods-sold accuracy.

Cash Management and Working Capital

  • Monitor daily and weekly cash position and prepare cash flow reports.
  • Manage collections, vendor payment timing, and other working capital processes in coordination with the CFO.

Budgeting and Forecasting Support

  • Provide actuals, variance analysis, and supporting data for the annual budget and forecasts led by the CFO.
  • Prepare budget-to-actual reporting and explain material variances to department heads.

Internal Controls, Audit, and Compliance

  • Design, implement, and monitor internal financial controls, including segregation of duties and approval workflows.
  • Coordinate external audits and tax preparation and respond to auditor requests.
  • Ensure timely and accurate local, state, and federal tax filings and other regulatory compliance, including sales and use tax and payroll tax.

ERP Management and NetSuite Migration

  • Serve as the accounting lead on the migration of three legacy ERP systems to NetSuite, working with the CFO, internal stakeholders and the implementation partner.
  • Define financial requirements, including chart of accounts, entity and subsidiary structure, dimensions, and reporting needs.
  • Lead data cleanup, mapping, migration, and validation of opening balances and historical data from each legacy system and reconcile differences in charts of accounts and processes across systems.
  • Participate in system configuration, user acceptance testing, and cutover planning.
  • Update and document accounting processes and internal controls for the new system.
  • Train finance team members on NetSuite and manage the first closes after go-live.
  • After go-live, maintain data quality and ensure the ERP is used consistently for reporting and inventory tracking.

Collaboration

  • Work with department heads to provide financial information, budget tracking, and accounting guidance.
  • Support the CFO and leadership team with accurate, timely financial data for decision making.
  • Promote continuous improvement in accounting processes, with a focus on automation.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or any other protected category.

Salary: 150-170K

The Payment Integrity team is a group of innovative thinkers sitting at the intersection of Clover's provider Network, Claims, and Tech teams. The Payment Integrity team ensures that Clover pays claims in an accurate manner, with a particular focus on reducing inappropriate medical spend.

As an DRG Validation Auditor at Clover Health, you will play a key role ensuring that Clover is able to continue to build and scale a compliant, efficient and profitable program. You will work to ensure quality assurance standards and regulatory policy are reflected in claims processing practices. You will help drive value for every member by ensuring that Clover’s medical claims are paid accurately and recovering overpayments when they are identified. The Associate - Inpatient Coder coordinates the identification of provider DRG denials and upcoding.

As an DRG Validation Auditor, you will:

  • Partner with Clinical, Claims, and Payment Integrity peers to review claims for DRG related issues on a prospective and retrospective basis that drive inaccurate payments to providers.
  • Proactively identify overpayments to ensure accurate claims payments on inpatient services.
  • Participate in collaborative discussions with MDs to verify the clinical rationale behind billed procedures.
  • Communicate effectively while building trust and lasting partnerships both laterally and vertically across multi-discipline teams.
  • Communicate effectively both internally and externally to ensure accurate claims adjudication and proper provider notification.

Success in this role looks like:

  • By the end of your initial 90-day period, you will have demonstrated a strong understanding of clinical coding practices and medical records review, while assisting our team in areas of DRG validation.
  • By 6 months, you will be working autonomously to execute within our clinical review workflows and will have developed strong interpersonal relationships across the organization.
  • Continued success in this position anchors in on developing a deep understanding of the workflows that support our clinical review life cycle, while maintaining regulatory compliance standards.

You should get in touch if:

  • You hold a CCS or CIC certification; required.
  • Knowledge of DRG pricing methodology; required.
  • You have at least 1 year of direct inpatient clinical coding experience.
  • Medicare or Medicare Advantage payment integrity or claims operations experience; preferred
  • You are technologically savvy with strong computer skills in Excel and PowerPoint.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.

  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. Job Description

What to Expect When You Apply:

We look forward to learning more about your experience! Here is a quick overview of what to expect after clicking "Apply":

  • Estimated Time: 5–7 minutes to complete.
  • Information Needed: Basic contact details, education level, and an up-to-date resume or work history details.
  • Accuracy Notice: Please ensure all resume and employment information is complete and accurate, as background and employment details will be verified during the selection process.
  • Workday Account (Optional): We encourage creating a Workday candidate account to track your application status, though it is not required to apply.
  • Next Steps & Hiring Roadmap: Our Talent Acquisition team will review your submission. The hiring process typically includes 2–3 interview rounds and a required Spanish bilingual language assessment prior to hire.

A bit about this role:

As a Bilingual Member Flex Guide at Devoted Health, you are a primary bridge for our English- and Spanish-speaking members. You will meet members where they are, eliminate language barriers, and help them navigate the complexities of healthcare with deep empathy, cultural awareness, and precision.


Guides operate across inbound service, proactive outreach, real-time digital support, and clinical administration. You will seamlessly flex across workflows—shifting from answering benefit questions in Spanish to conducting proactive clinical outreach in English—as seasonal or business needs evolve. In every interaction, you bring our mission to life by treating every member like family while utilizing our AI Guide Assistant to deliver accurate, real-time care.


You may be hired into one of the following job profiles: Inbound Member Service Guide, Outbound Member Service Guide, Care Access Guide, Digital Guide, Pharmacy Guide, or Member Outreach Specialist

Responsibilities and Impact will Include:

Bilingual Member Engagement & Support

  • Engage fluently in English and Spanish across all communication channels, including inbound/outbound calls, SMS, chat, secure messaging, email, and video.
  • Translate and simplify complex healthcare, insurance, and medical terms into clear, culturally sensitive, and actionable guidance.
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact: listen actively to member needs, build rapport, and assist them in finding language-congruent providers and scheduling appointments.
  • Conduct proactive outreach in the member's preferred language to share information on preventive screenings, clinical programs, and benefit utilization.
  • Identify situations requiring clinical escalation and collaborate with medical staff and bilingual teammates to ensure continuous care.

Operational Excellence

  • Partner with an AI Guide Assistant in real time to access complex benefit information quickly and deliver accurate answers in both languages.
  • Maintain complete, accurate documentation in internal systems for every interaction without exception.
  • Strictly adhere to HIPAA, regulatory compliance guidelines, and privacy policies to safeguard member trust.
  • Consistently meet productivity and quality standards, including resolution rates, service quality metrics, and handle times.

Flexibility & Growth

  • Flex fluidly between inbound support, outbound campaigns, and cross-functional programs based on seasonal business demands.
  • Adapt quickly to changing workflows, technology platforms, and policy updates with a positive, solutions-oriented attitude.
  • Actively incorporate real-time coaching and feedback from leadership to drive continuous professional development.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Bilingual Proficiency: Professional, native-level oral and written fluency in both English and Spanish is required.
  • Customer Experience: 1+ years of experience in a high-volume customer-facing role, contact center, or fast-paced healthcare environment.
  • Cultural Competency & Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence, with a natural ability to connect authentically across diverse communities and de-escalate sensitive situations.
  • Complex Problem-Solving: Ability to break down intricate insurance and medical concepts into clear terms in both languages.
  • Tech Adaptability: Comfort working alongside AI-powered tools and navigating multiple software platforms simultaneously while talking, typing, and translating.
  • Agility: Demonstrated ability to pivot between shifting priorities and operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Willingness to work variable hours based on operational needs and seasonal demand.

Desired Skills & Experience

  • Background in Medicare Advantage, health insurance, or HIPAA-regulated medical environments.
  • Prior experience in a dedicated bilingual customer service or medical translation role.
  • Proven stress-management techniques for maintaining composure in fast-paced or emotionally demanding settings.

raw.excerpt: Wing Assistant is a venture-backed, Silicon Valley-based startup with global operations.
raw.description:
Wing Assistant is a venture-backed, Silicon Valley-based startup with global operations. We match US businesses with dedicated, fully managed remote professionals (executive assistants, customer service reps, healthcare admins, bookkeepers, and more) and run the delivery behind them: recruiting, onboarding, management, and support. We're also building exciting AI technologies to help clients get even more done across our Wing suite and sister companies we operate in the AI space.

Our talent and delivery teams are based in the Philippines; our clients are mostly in the US; our leadership works across Hong Kong and the US. We've scaled fast. Now we're obsessed with getting every customer we win live quickly, and keeping them for the long haul.

The Role

    The biggest lever on Wing's growth is what happens after a customer signs: how quickly they get value, and how long they stay. We're hiring one person to own the entire post-sale journey (onboarding, activation, and retention) from the moment a deal closes to month 12 and beyond.

    This is not an advisory role. You won't hand off a deck and walk away. You'll diagnose where and why customers stall or leave, build the systems and tools to fix it, and hold multiple teams accountable to the numbers. If you've spent years recommending changes and want to be the person who actually makes them happen, this is that job.

What you'll own

  • The onboarding pipeline. Every new account from signed deal to fully live. You know where every account sits, where it's stuck and why, and you make sure it moves faster.
  • Activation and early-life health. The first months decide whether a client stays. Define what a healthy start looks like, spot accounts going off track and intervene early.
  • Retention and churn as numbers. Define them, measure them and break them down (logo vs. revenue, early-life vs. mature, by role, segment, acquisition channel and team). Set the targets and own the trend lines.
  • Root-cause analysis. Funnels, cohorts, survival curves, leading indicators. Go beyond the dashboard into the qualitative and raw data to find what really drives outcomes.
  • Process improvement. Map the handoffs across teams, find the friction, redesign the process, run experiments and measure the impact.
  • Building tools. Vibe-code dashboards, alerts and workflow tools using Claude and other AI coding tools. Ship useful things in days, not quarters.
  • Deep data work. Write the SQL, reconcile the sources and build the models. When two systems disagree, you find out which one is right and why.
  • Stakeholder leadership. Work with sales, recruiting, customer success, finance, product and our Philippines operations team: people from very different backgrounds, functions and time zones. Drive change through clarity and evidence often without direct authority.
  • Reporting to leadership. A crisp weekly view of pipeline, activation and retention health: what changed, and what you're doing about it.

What success looks like

    First 30 days: You've mapped the customer journey end to end, have access to every relevant data source, and have built trusted baselines for the metrics you own.

    First 60 days: You've identified the highest-impact opportunities with hard evidence, launched the first interventions, and shipped your first tools.

    First 90 days: You can show measurable improvement on at least one core metric, yourun a weekly operating cadence, and the tools you built are used daily by the teams.

Working Arrangements

  • Remote, full-time role. Occasional in-person meetings in Hong Kong.
  • Location: Hong Kong.
  • Hours: Our clients and many team members operate on US time. Your working day will generally run from the evening into the night, Hong Kong time. This is a core requirement of the role, not an occasional ask.
  • Travel: Occasional trips to our operation center in the Philippines.
  • Pace: This is an intense, high-ownership role in a fast-moving company. Expect high standards, tight feedback loops and real accountability for results. It's a great fit if you want to grow fast and see your work move the numbers, and probably not the
    right fit if you're looking for a steady 9-to-5.
  • Commitment: This is a high-ownership, full-time role, and we expect it to be your only professional commitment. If you have other employment, consulting work or business interests, please mention them when you apply so we can discuss them openly.

How to apply

  • Send your CV and a short note (no more than 200 words) about a time you found the number nobody else had noticed, and what happened next. Links to anything you've built with AI tools are a strong plus.

  • Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical case exercise using real-world style data.

Fine Print

  • Background and reference checks. Final-stage candidates may be asked to complete background and reference checks, with their consent and in line with applicable law.
  • Equal opportunity. Wing is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and welcome applicants of every background, regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.excerpt: Who We AreFlosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
  • Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
  • A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
  • The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
  • Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
  • A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy
  • Remote-first flexibility with a results-oriented work environment

Role Description

As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will lead the migration to FleetDM and build the shared platform capabilities that support dependable endpoint operations. You will combine hands-on engineering with technical planning, partnering with Windows, macOS, and Linux engineers to introduce changes safely across a distributed environment.
You will develop automation, integrations, and configuration-as-code workflows, validate platform capabilities, and guide phased adoption. Beyond migration, you will improve platform reliability, visibility, and maintainability, helping the team reduce manual work and operate the service with shared ownership.
You will partner with Security, IAM, CorpInfra, and support teams to resolve dependencies and make practical trade-offs. This is an individual-contributor position with technical leadership and mentoring responsibilities.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the FleetDM migration. Define scope, requirements, architecture, dependencies, and a phased delivery plan with OS specialists and partner teams.
  • Engineer and operate the shared platform. Maintain configuration, agent workflows, policies, queries, integrations, and operational automation.
  • Make deployment safe and repeatable. Build version-controlled configuration with automated checks, peer review, controlled rollout, drift detection, and recovery.
  • Validate capabilities and coexistence. Identify gaps, clarify management authority, and establish which responsibilities should migrate or remain with existing tools.
  • Make platform health actionable. Establish trustworthy device populations, data freshness, enrollment and agent health, and owned remediation workflows.
  • Protect service continuity. Use representative pilots, acceptance gates, employee-impact checks, and clear pause and recovery decisions.
  • Strengthen team capability. Create reusable patterns, documentation, and shared support coverage through pairing, mentoring, and operational handoffs.
  • Improve efficiency and cost. Reduce recurring manual work and recommend tooling consolidation where evidence supports it.

Requirements

  • Significant hands-on experience engineering enterprise endpoint platforms, including deep expertise in at least one of Windows, macOS, or Linux and experience working across OS boundaries.
  • Personal ownership of a multi-phase platform migration or comparable change, including discovery, pilots, rollout, recovery, and operational handover.
  • Strong practical programming or scripting skills, such as Python, Go, PowerShell, or shell, with production automation and API integration experience.
  • Demonstrated use of Git, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for configuration or infrastructure changes.
  • Ability to diagnose enrollment, agent, policy, identity, networking, and integration failures and distinguish missing data from healthy devices.
  • Experience establishing monitoring, failure handling, least-privilege access, secrets management, and maintainable operational workflows.
  • Ability to independently define priorities, align cross-functional stakeholders, communicate trade-offs, and mentor engineers.
  • Clear written and verbal communication and effective asynchronous collaboration across regions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Production experience with FleetDM configuration, policies, queries, APIs, agent operations, or deployment automation.
  • Practical osquery and SQL experience, including query validation, performance considerations, targeting, and stale or missing results.
  • Migration or coexistence experience involving Intune, Jamf, or comparable endpoint-management platforms.
  • Experience integrating endpoint platforms with identity, security, inventory, or ITSM services.
  • Experience supporting developer-heavy, distributed environments.
  • Demonstrated improvements in platform operating effort, tool consolidation, or lifecycle cost.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

  • Experience developing and executing successful marketing and promotional campaigns to meet business objectives.
  • Brand building experience in new segments or channels.
  • Ability to influence and manage multiple stakeholders both internally and externally.
  • Strong presentation skills. Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask.
  • Creativity mindset and out of the box thinking.

The Marketing Operations Direct Mail associate will be responsible for:

We are looking for a Marketing Operations Direct Mail Associate. Omada’s Marketing team is focused on the first part of Omada’s mission – to inspire people everywhere to take the first step toward lasting, healthy change. We understand our audience, know what makes Omada different, connect these two things to tell a great story, then measure and optimize its success.

About Nexcess

Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

EXPECTED COMPENSATION RANGE: $42K-$45K
Overview

The IT Compliance Analyst supports the organization’s security and compliance program through audit coordination, technical evidence review, control testing support, and remediation tracking. This role works with technical and business teams to demonstrate that controls are operating effectively, maintain reliable compliance records, and identify gaps before they become audit findings. The analyst evaluates what evidence demonstrates rather than simply collecting and organizing submissions.

Responsibilities

Audit Coordination and Readiness

  • Coordinate assigned activities supporting SOC 1, SOC 2, SOC 3, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS audits and assessments, as applicable, from preparation through evidence submission and finding closure.
  • Serve as a day-to-day contact for auditor requests and follow-up questions, escalating interpretation, policy, and risk decisions to the appropriate owners.
  • Manage evidence trackers, control mappings, recurring compliance activities, and audit deadlines.
  • Coordinate evidence requests across technical and business functions, communicating requirements, ownership, and timelines clearly.

Technical Evidence Review and Control Testing

  • Gather, review, organize, and validate evidence for relevance, completeness, accuracy, and alignment with the control and review period.
  • Evaluate technical evidence, including vulnerability scans, logging reports, access records, configuration data, change records, tickets, and system reports.
  • Assist with control testing by distinguishing documented requirements, control design, and evidence that a control operated effectively.
  • Identify evidence that does not adequately demonstrate the control being tested and work with control owners to resolve gaps or obtain clarification.
  • Translate compliance requirements into actionable evidence requests while engaging technical owners for engineering decisions and implementation.

Findings and Recurring Control Follow-Through

  • Track findings, exceptions, remediation actions, accountable owners, and deadlines through documented closure.
  • Review remediation evidence for completeness and alignment with the identified issue, escalating unresolved questions to the appropriate reviewers.
  • Identify missed recurring activities, outdated evidence, documentation gaps, and approaching deadlines.
  • Follow up consistently with stakeholders and escalate delays or unresolved gaps that could affect audit readiness.

Documentation and Compliance Records

  • Maintain policies, procedures, control narratives, diagrams, evidence guides, and supporting audit documentation in collaboration with responsible owners.
  • Maintain a traceable record of requests, responses, exceptions, remediation activity, and approvals.
  • Keep compliance records organized, current, and accessible to authorized stakeholders.
  • Recommend improvements to evidence quality, documentation consistency, and audit coordination practices.

Additional Expectations

  • Demonstrates and promotes the company's Impact Behaviors in all interactions and decision-making.
    • Design
    • Ownership
    • First Team
    • Performance
  • Maintains a professional, collaborative, and client-focused approach while supporting team and organizational objectives.
  • Performs other duties, responsibilities, and special projects as assigned to meet business needs.

Qualifications

Required

  • Working knowledge of one or more relevant compliance frameworks or requirements, such as SOC, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS.
  • Ability to interpret control requirements and determine what evidence reasonably demonstrates control design and operation.
  • Foundational understanding of Linux and Windows systems, networking, firewalls, access controls, authentication and MFA, vulnerability management, patching, logging, backups, retention, encryption, change management, incident response, and business continuity.
  • Ability to interpret technical records and explain what they demonstrate, including the relevance of terms such as syslog, CVE, subnet, TLS, root, ACL, and service account.
  • Ability to manage substantial evidence sets, simultaneous auditor requests, and recurring compliance deadlines.
  • Comfort working with ticketing systems, documentation platforms, spreadsheets, dashboards, and security or compliance tools.
  • Strong written communication, documentation, organization, and follow-through.
  • Sound judgment, attention to detail, curiosity, and professional persistence when resolving incomplete or unclear submissions.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with multiple relevant compliance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting audits or assessments in a technology or infrastructure environment.
  • Experience improving evidence guidance, control documentation, or remediation tracking practices.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Quality, completeness, and relevance of audit evidence.
  • Timely completion of evidence requests and recurring compliance activities.
  • Effective tracking and escalation of findings and remediation.
  • Accuracy, currency, and traceability of compliance documentation.
  • Clear coordination with auditors, control owners, and technical teams.

Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an individual to successfully perform the essential duties of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • While performing the essential duties of this job, the individual is regularly required to speak and hear
  • While performing the essential duties of this job, the individual is regularly required to use hands for keyboarding, gross manipulation, and fine manipulation
  • Works at a desk and computer screen for extended periods of time
  • Works in a traditional climate controlled office environment or from home
  • Works in a highly stressful environment dealing with a wide variety of challenges, deadlines and diverse employee population

raw.description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit.

About the project

Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result.

About the roles

There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience& skillsets.

  • Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.

  • Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.

Who we are looking for

  • Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.

  • Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language

  • Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role.

  • Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.

Project at a glance

  • Project duration: one week since the mid of November

  • Languages: Dutch

  • Project time commitment: 6 hours per person

  • Project compensation: varies depends on different programming language

  • Work location: fully remote

How selection works (major steps)

  1. Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.

  1. Language test: short exercises in the target language.

  1. Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.

  1. Financial Onboarding & Role placement:complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role.

  1. Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

Job Reference: #L1-CC1

Why Join Welo Data?

✨ Limitless Flexibility 

Project-based opportunities that fit your availability. Choose when and how much you want to contribute—fully remote, with complete autonomy. 
🌱 Limitless Growth 
Optional access to AI and Large Language Model workshops designed specifically for professionals like you. No coding required—just your expertise. 
🌍 Limitless Support 
Be part of a global contributor community with responsive guidance and support. 
💡 Real Impact 
Apply your expertise in the Legal field to influence the AI systems shaping the future of your industry—while collaborating with data professionals and expanding your skills.

How to Apply?

Apply now by answering a few quick questions to join our database and become part of our growing community.

About Welo Data

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.
At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

  • Proficient with technology; solid knowledge of computer operations and software

raw.description:
The Consulting Cloud Engineer – Government Cloud Managed Services is responsible for implementing, onboarding, and operationalizing Managed Services for customers operating within regulated Government Cloud environments. This role partners with customers, architects, and operations to transition customer environments into secure, supportable, and repeatable operational models.

The Engineer designs, implements and manages cloud management capabilities, automation, monitoring, operational processes, documentation, and governance across Azure Government / Azure GCC High, AWS GovCloud, and Google Cloud Assured Workloads.

This role requires strong technical expertise, customer consulting skills, operational discipline, and knowledge of Government Cloud security and compliance requirements.

What You Will Do

  • Implement Government Cloud-focused tools, processes, operational standards, and secure cloud landing zones supporting Managed Services delivery across Azure Government / Azure GCC High, AWS GovCloud, and Google Cloud Assured Workloads, aligned with CDW Managed Services standards and customer security requirements.
  • Support customer onboarding, implementation, transition readiness, operational acceptance, and production handoff activities.
  • Follow change management, security, testing, validation, and deployment processes for Government Cloud customer environments.
  • Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation supporting critical Government customer environments, including after-hours, weekends, and holidays as required.
  • Develop documentation including architecture validation, runbooks, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, observability, backup, disaster recovery, and operational management solutions to support Managed Services delivery.
  • Configure cloud governance, identity, networking, security controls, logging, and operational standards consistent with Government Cloud best practices.
  • Build repeatable automation using Infrastructure as Code, scripting, configuration management, and orchestration technologies.
  • Participate in customer design reviews, implementation workshops, technical planning sessions, and operational readiness reviews.
  • Clearly communicate technical issues, implementation risks, recommendations, and project status, and collaborate with Cloud Architects, Security Engineering, Customer Success, Managed Operations, and Sales Engineering throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Validate Managed Services operational readiness prior to production support transition.
  • Support security reviews, compliance validation, audit requests, and implementation of required Government Cloud controls.
  • Maintain relevant cloud, security, automation, and Government Cloud certifications, and adhere to time compliance, documentation standards, and project management requirements.

What We Expect of You

  • Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of IT engineering experience supporting cloud, infrastructure, systems, networking, or platform engineering OR 7+ years of equivalent professional IT engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and supporting at least one major cloud platform: Microsoft Azure (Azure Government / Azure GCC High preferred), AWS (GovCloud preferred), or Google Cloud (Assured Workloads).
  • Understanding of Government Cloud operational models, Managed Services delivery, and customer onboarding processes.
  • Working knowledge of cloud compute, storage, networking (DNS, DHCP, VPN, routing, load balancing, firewalls, segmentation), identity, backup, and disaster recovery concepts.
  • Ability to resolve customer-impacting issues while balancing project priorities, service level commitments, and operational requirements.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to technical and executive audiences and to establish customer trust through expertise and professionalism.
  • Strong customer-service orientation, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, with a self-motivated, continuous learning mindset and willingness to mentor peers.
  • Certain customer workloads (for example, those involving ITAR or CUI data) may require U.S. citizenship.
  • Experience supporting public sector (Federal, DoD, State and Local Government, or Education) cloud environments, a plus.
  • Advanced-level certifications in at least two major cloud providers (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud), a plus.
  • Experience creating implementation plans, operational runbooks, knowledge documentation, and operational handoff documentation, a plus.
  • Experience with enterprise multi-cloud environments, Managed Services environments, ITSM (e.g., ServiceNow), observability, Infrastructure as Code and scripting, and cloud management platforms, a plus.
  • Experience designing and implementing secure cloud landing zones, cloud governance, networking, identity, monitoring, automation, backup, and disaster recovery solutions, a plus.
  • Working knowledge of Government security frameworks such as FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, CMMC, CJIS, or ITAR, and how they apply to cloud environments, a plus.

Pay range: $77,725 - $108,265 depending on experience and skill set.

Quarterly bonus target of 10% subject to terms and conditions of plan.

Benefits overview:

Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials.

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

About Us

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

The Senior Consultant works collaboratively within a team of highly qualified Advisory consultants to deliver performance improvement to healthcare systems. Responsibilities include determining client needs in terms of the engagement statement of work; lead, complete and provide quality assurance over data analyses; interpret data analyses and form initial recommendations and develop potential solutions for consideration; develop deliverables and presentations materials for various audiences; assist in risk identification and mitigation; manage workstream economics and project management; and assist in the implementation of recommended improvements.

The Senior Consultant participates in all aspects of an engagement including identifying issues; forming hypotheses; planning and conducting interviews; planning, overseeing, and conducting analytics; developing recommendations and solutions for considerations; synthesizing information into cohesive presentations for various audiences and helping to implement change. The Senior Consultant will work in a team environment and provide input and support to team deliverables and presentations during each phase of a project. The Senior Consultant will also work on the project in daily management of project activities in the management of work stream activities including project management activities and project economic management.

The Senior Consultant is required to also participate in Premier internal activities including practice development, required, and approved educational opportunities throughout the year and learning the various technologies Premier offers to its clients. Additionally, the Senior Consultant should:

• Maintain utilization targets for client billable projects

growing and enriching the Practice as a whole or individual Service Lines within the Practice

  • Act as an advocate to raise awareness of the needs of children. Understand Christ’s mandate to protect children. Commit to and prioritize child protection considerations in all decision-making, tasks and activities across the ministry. Abide by all behavioral expectations in Compassion’s Statement of Commitment to Child Protection and Code of Conduct. Report concerns through Compassion’s internal reporting process and appropriately support responses to incidents if they occur.

Why work here?

raw.description:
We’re a team of friends bound together by a mission to preserve our planet for future generations through innovative energy solutions and modern infrastructure. Intersect develops, constructs, and operates the most ambitious power and data center infrastructure in the country by co-locating industrial demand with dedicated gas and renewable power generation.

Intersect was acquired by Google in March 2026 and operates as an independent subsidiary. We are developing and constructing multiple gigawatts of energy and data center projects in the U.S., enabling more data center and generation capacity to come online faster. We’re on an aggressive growth trajectory and looking for people hungry to tackle the largest energy challenges on the planet.

Location & Team Gatherings

Intersect has been a fully flexible workplace since its founding in 2016. We’ve been very intentional about the way we do things. We are not work-from-home, hybrid, or in-office - we are any and all of those options! Deepening social connections and offering shared experiences is a cornerstone of the way we work. We connect as a team at our Team Week experiences four times a year and at our recently established Hub locations - SF Bay Area, NYC Metro Area, NY; Denver, CO; Austin, TX; Calgary, AB; and Toronto, ON.

We are currently looking for candidates located within 60 miles of any of the listed hubs to foster more in-person connections while maintaining our flexible remote culture.

About this role

As a Project Manager, Solar Construction on Intersect's Construction Team, you'll lead the execution of utility-scale solar facilities exceeding 300 MW from pre-construction through commissioning and substantial completion.You'll own complex, cross-functional execution from detailed design and procurement through construction, commissioning, and commercial closeout, ensuring our storage assets are delivered safely, on schedule, and within budget.

You'll partner closely with Development, Finance, Engineering, Procurement, Legal, and Operations as well as EPC contractors, utilities, and Owner's Engineers to deliver safe, high-quality power infrastructure on time and on budget. By combining rigorous project controls with modern platforms like Terabase and AI Clearing, you'll drive predictable execution and build assets that create long-run value.

Team overview

This team plays a critical role in advancing Intersect's mission to accelerate the clean energy transition by turning ambitious development pipelines into operating utility-scale power plants. The Construction Project Management team bridges engineering design, procurement, financial governance, and field execution to build resilient infrastructure at scale. Joining this team means taking ownership of high-impact capital projects and growing alongside collaborative leaders who prioritize safety, operational excellence, and long-term asset performance.

What you'll do

What you'll bring

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in at least one government cloud platform with working knowledge of another, a strong Infrastructure as Code and automation background, hands-on experience applying Government security frameworks, and the ability to mentor and grow a team of engineers.

What You Will Do

  • Serve as the technical lead and escalation point for Government Cloud Managed Services across Microsoft Azure Government / Azure GCC High, AWS GovCloud (US), and Google Cloud.
  • Define and maintain reference architectures, secure landing zone standards, and operational patterns for regulated Government customer environments.
  • Lead the design and delivery of Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform), automation, and CI/CD pipelines that standardize customer onboarding, deployment, and day-to-day operations across clouds.
  • Translate Government compliance requirements, including FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CMMC, DISA STIGs, and CIS Benchmarks, into implementable controls, configurations, and operational procedures.

  • Participate in on-call rotation, provide escalation support for critical incidents, and lead root cause analysis and preventative actions.
  • Follow and strengthen incident, change, problem, request, and knowledge management processes within the ITSM platform (ServiceNow).
  • Drive resiliency, capacity, performance, backup and disaster recovery, and cost optimization across customer environments.
  • Maintain trusted advisor relationships with Government customers and account teams, and communicate technical strategy, risks, and solution direction to customers and CDW leadership.
  • Mentor senior and consulting engineers, guiding solution design, engineering practices, and cross-training across cloud platforms.
  • Develop practice standards, runbooks, reusable templates, architecture documentation, and training materials for customers and internal teams.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Project Management, Security, Legal and Contracts, and cloud provider partners to develop and grow Government Cloud Managed Services offerings and identify growth opportunities.
  • Research emerging government cloud, security, and automation technologies and regulatory changes, including the evolving FedRAMP program, and present recommendations.

What We Expect of You

  • Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of IT engineering experience supporting cloud, infrastructure, systems, networking, or platform engineering OR 14+ years of IT engineering experience supporting cloud, infrastructure, systems, networking, or platform engineering.

  • 3+ years of experience with large, cross-brand Managed Services projects.
  • Experience designing and operating cloud environments aligned with Government security frameworks, including FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CMMC, DISA STIGs, and CIS Benchmarks.
  • Advanced experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform), scripting, configuration management, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience aligning technical solutions to business outcomes and developing technical roadmaps, architecture documentation, project plans, and schedules for complex initiatives.
  • Strong root cause analysis and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead critical escalations.

  • Certain customer workloads (for example, those involving ITAR or CUI data) may require U.S. citizenship.
  • Experience supporting public sector (Federal, DoD, State and Local Government, or Education) cloud environments strongly preferred.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one government cloud platform (Microsoft Azure Government / Azure GCC High, AWS GovCloud (US), or Google Cloud Assured Workloads) and working knowledge of a second major cloud platform, strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting Azure GCC High or CMMC-regulated customers, a plus.
  • Professional-level certifications in two or more of Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, and published case studies, white papers, reference architectures, or technical thought leadership, a plus.
