ISI's software is specifically designed to address the unique needs of businesses, helping streamline operations, increase efficiency, and improve customer service.


Job Summary:

The position is responsible for providing timely, friendly and accurate technical assistance to customers. Acting as a customer advocate, you will provide remote support for computer hardware, software, and networking components in the industry. Key responsibilities include diagnosing and resolving problems, responding to customer inquiries via phone and written communication channels, documenting technical issues, and providing exceptional customer experience.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical assistance: Respond to user inquiries, troubleshoot issues, and guide users on resolving problems.
  • Handle customer inquiries: Take ownership of customer phone calls, emails, and other support requests in a courteous and respectful manner.
  • Case ownership and management: Effectively prioritize and manage case backlog, meet commitments and follow-up with customers in a timely manner.
  • Diagnose and Troubleshoot: Identify the root cause of technical issues and implement solutions.
  • Document and escalate: Maintain records of support interactions, research and escalate complex cases to higher-level support as needed.
  • Provide training: Assist users with understanding of using software and hardware.
  • Maintain knowledgebase: Contribute to the documentation of solutions, procedures and best practices.
  • Communicate effectively: Explain technical concepts clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical users.
  • Provide exceptional customer support: Going above and beyond to ensure customers have a positive experience.
  • Other duties: Perform other support-related duties as assigned by management.
  • Adhere to company policies and procedures: Follow established company guidelines and complete annual training requirements by due date.

  • Technical Proficiency: Strong understanding of computer hardware, software, and networking concepts to diagnose and troubleshoot issues effectively.
  • Problem-solving: Ability to identify root causes of technical problems and implement solutions efficiently.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical users.
  • Customer Service Orientation: Ability to build rapport, handle difficult situations, and prioritize customer satisfaction to provide exceptional support.
  • Documentation Skills: Skill in maintaining accurate records of support interactions, providing solutions and contributing to the knowledgebase.

  • Performance Monitoring: Ability to meet key performance metrics and identify areas for improvement in support processes.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Proficient troubleshooting experience in Linux and Windows environments.

About the Team/Role

WEX Health & Benefits Product Marketing sits between Product, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Engineering. The team improves commercial outcomes by leading go-to-market strategy, serving as the voice of the customer, and partnering with Product from discovery through build and launch. The portfolio spans Consumer Directed Healthcare (including HSA/FSA), COBRA, benefits administration, and Medicare, serving customers ranging from HR leaders and brokers to individual account holders. The team works across multiple initiatives in a lean environment and uses AI to work faster, think bigger, and improve the quality of its work.

In this role, you will own the commercial story and go-to-market strategy for a product portfolio, including positioning, messaging, launch, and commercialization. You will partner with Product on pricing and packaging decisions and bring customer and market evidence into discovery to help shape what WEX builds. You will step into critical GTM work supporting the 2027 roadmap and major launches. This is an AI-forward role for a product marketer who actively builds and improves AI-enabled workflows and can demonstrate the impact.


How you'll make an impact

  • Own portfolio GTM and commercialization. Lead positioning, messaging, and launch strategy across the portfolio using the commercialization framework, from concept through post-launch performance.
  • Partner with Product on pricing and packaging. Bring customer insight, competitive context, and field feedback to decisions, working alongside Product, RevOps, and Commercial to drive resolution.
  • Partner with Product in discovery and build. Use customer research, win/loss insights, competitive analysis, and experimentation to inform roadmap decisions and product-market fit.
  • Be the voice of the customer. Synthesize customer feedback, advisory board input, and sales insight into jobs-to-be-done messaging and positioning.
  • Equip the field. Build and lead enablement, including playbooks, battlecards, and pitch decks. Own cross-functional rollout of key initiatives for Sales and partners.
  • Align the platform story. Connect narratives across CDH, COBRA, benefits administration, and Medicare where cross-solution value exists, partnering with Revenue Generation Marketing on integrated launches.
  • Build with AI. Design and use AI-enabled workflows, tools, and agents for research, competitive intelligence, content, enablement, and reporting. Share effective practices so the team improves speed and quality.
  • Measure and iterate. Define launch success metrics such as adoption, pipeline influence, win rate, and attach rate. Report results and adjust strategy based on performance.
  • Mentor and lead by example. Raise the bar on PMM craft and process, and share knowledge with junior PMMs.

Experience you'll bring

  • 3–5 years of product marketing experience in B2B or B2B2C environments, consistent with the PM3 level discussed for this requisition.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a multi-product portfolio or multiple product initiatives, with accountability for or measurable influence on revenue, adoption, pipeline, or win-rate outcomes.
  • An AI-native working style, supported by concrete examples of something new you built with AI, efficiencies you created, and improvements to throughput or quality.
  • Experience partnering with Product on pricing and packaging decisions; direct ownership of pricing or monetization is not required.
  • Experience influencing product strategy through customer research, competitive insight, and experimentation during discovery.
  • Experience launching and growing data-centric or AI-enabled platforms, including post-launch measurement.
  • Strong sales enablement experience in complex or regulated selling environments.
  • Ability to synthesize customer insight, regulatory guidance, and market dynamics into clear positioning and strategy.
  • Comfort with data, including the ability to pull and interpret performance and usage data to guide decisions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication, with strong cross-functional influence and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships, influence without authority, prioritize competing work, and context-switch across multiple products and launches.
  • Proficiency with Google Suite, Salesforce or comparable CRM tools, and AI-driven marketing tools.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in healthcare, employee benefits, fintech, or another compliance-heavy industry. Direct benefits experience is valued but is not a non-negotiable.
  • Familiarity with CDH products such as HSA/FSA, COBRA, benefits administration, or Medicare.
  • Hands-on experience with ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude, Cursor, and market-team.ai.
  • Pragmatic Institute product management certification or active participation in the Product Marketing Alliance.
  • A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, marketing, or a related field. Equivalent experience will be considered.

Why This Role Matters

Product Marketing at WEX is a strategic partner with visibility into product direction from the earliest stages of discovery. You will help shape how products are built, launched, and adopted while working closely with Product, Commercial, RevOps, and Marketing. The role offers exposure to senior stakeholders, a chance to help advance an AI-enabled way of working, and opportunities for continued career growth across Product Marketing and the broader organization.

The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. Join our Team!

Werde Teil unseres Teams als Senior Fullstack-Entwickler Java/TypeScript Opus::L (m/w/d) in Essen, Kölnoder Remote bei Dedalus Labor GmbH, einem der weltweit führenden Unternehmen im Bereich Gesundheitstechnologie, und leiste an unserem Standort die beste Arbeit deiner Karriere. Trage dazu bei, die Gesundheitsversorgung zu verbessern und unseren Planeten gesünder zu machen.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Selbstständige Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung von Softwarelösungen für unser Produkt Opus::L
  • Modernisierung der Systemarchitektur durch die Integration und Weiterentwicklung zentraler Systemkomponenten, die Ablösung von JavaFX und bestehenden CORBA-Strukturen sowie die Implementierung moderner REST-Dienste und eines modernen Angular-Web-Frontends
  • Anforderungsanalyse in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktmanagement
  • Implementierung und Test neuer Funktionen im Frontend und Backend mit Fokus auf Qualität, Leistung und Benutzerfreundlichkeit
  • Fehleranalyse, Debugging und Wartung bestehender Softwarekomponenten

Du bringst folgendes mit:

  • Ein Abschluss in Informatik oder eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum IT-Fachmann (oder gleichwertige Qualifikation)
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Full-Stack-Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Frontend- und Backend-Komponenten
  • Hervorragende Kenntnisse in Java und TypeScript; fundierte Erfahrung mit modernen Java-Frameworks, insbesondere Spring Boot, sowie Web-UI-Frameworks wie Angular

Unsere Vorteile für Dich:

  • Unbefristeter Anstellungsvertrag mit attraktivem Gehalt für eine langfristige Perspektive
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Arbeitszeitmodelle inkl. arbeiten von zu Hause mit moderner Hardwareausstattung

Werde Teil unserer Innovationskraft und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft!

Schwerbehinderte Bewerber:innen werden bei gleicher Eignung besonders berücksichtigt.

Dedalus hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, ein motivierendes und lohnendes Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, das die Leidenschaft widerspiegelt, mit der unsere Mitarbeiter sich für unsere Mission einsetzen, Ärzten und Pflegekräften dabei zu helfen, die Versorgung der von ihnen betreuten Menschen zu verbessern.
Unser Unternehmen fördert eine Kultur, in der Mitarbeiter dazu ermutigt werden, zu lernen und innovativ zu sein, um die klinische Zusammenarbeit und Prozesse zu verbessern und gleichzeitig für Millionen von Menschen auf der ganzen Welt einen bedeutenden Unterschied zu machen. Jeder Mensch ist Ausgangs- und Zielpunkt unserer Aktivitäten – und letztlich der wichtigste Profiteur. Aus diesem Grund sind wir so stolz darauf, jeden Tag unsere ganz besonderen Aufgaben zu erfüllen.

Unser Unternehmen wird durch eine vielfältige Belegschaft von 7.600 Mitarbeitern in mehr als 40 Ländern bereichert, die gemeinsam daran arbeiten, Innovationen zu entwickeln und bessere Gesundheitsversorgungsoptionen für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt voranzutreiben. Als Unternehmen, das sich an seinen Grundwerten orientiert, wissen wir, dass Vielfalt und Inklusion entscheidende Faktoren für unseren Erfolg und unser Wachstum sind. raw.title: Senior Product Manager, Merchant Products
raw.excerpt: About the Role:WEX is transforming how businesses manage spend and fleets—with a vision beyond traditional fueling through a growing set of payment, discounting, and platform capabilities built on shared platform investments.
raw.description:
About the Role:

WEX is transforming how businesses manage spend and fleets—with a vision beyond traditional fueling through a growing set of payment, discounting, and platform capabilities built on shared platform investments.

We are looking for an experienced, strategic, and execution-driven Senior Product Manager (Level 4) to own and scale our next generation of Merchant Product solutions. Sitting within the North American Mobility (NAM) Product Team, you will act as an emerging strategic leader and trusted influencer owning a significant set of initiatives aligned to our core merchant systems—including discount networks (such as the EDGE Savings Network), pricing programs, and merchant-to-fleet communication channels.

In this role, you will drive the full product lifecycle from ideation to market delivery, connecting deep customer insights to broader company strategy, and owning customer adoption, usage, and financial value. You will work closely with senior product leaders, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to create capabilities that communicate dynamic pricing and discount programs to fleets, driving mutual value across our merchant and fleet ecosystems.


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop Bold Vision and Product Strategy: Act as an emerging strategic leader to develop a bold vision and clear priorities for WEX’s merchant product ecosystem. Shape product strategy across our portfolio of discounting solutions, identify market gaps, and serve as a strategic partner to senior leadership.
  • Own Product and Financial Outcomes: Drive the execution of complex merchant initiatives, owning customer and business outcomes. Proactively define input and output metrics, utilizing rigorous business modeling and OKRs to tell the performance story of your product and drive customer and financial outcomes.
  • Lead Deep Customer and Partner Discovery: Dive deep into user behaviors and establish ongoing relationships with key merchants and fleets. Integrate qualitative and quantitative insights to pinpoint top partner problems and guide core product trade-offs.
  • Drive Multi-Channel Experiences & Portal Enhancements: Own and optimize customer journeys as they utilize our discounting programs across digital portals and platforms. Streamline onboarding workflows, automate administrative operations, and represent merchant product priorities within broader platform initiatives to reduce friction.
  • Design & Execute Iterative Experiments: Formulate hypotheses and design test-and-learn experiments to improve system administration, portal usability, and customer workflows, driving measurable adoption and delivering on key OKRs.
  • Partner & Influence Cross-Functionally: Build trust and facilitate alignment across Digital, Technology, Commercial, Risk, and Operations teams to ensure technical, operational, and financial systems are fully aligned and revenue is secure.
  • Manage Full Business & System Lifecycle: Oversee the evolution of merchant capabilities from initial ideation to a scalable, repeatable model. Detail how data flows through core systems and merchant-specific platforms, ensuring operational readiness at every stage.

Merchant Product Specifics:

  • Collaborate Across Customer-Facing Product Teams: Partner closely with adjacent WEX product owners who manage mobile apps, web portals, and communication channels to ensure they understand, align on, and prioritize the necessary features and configurations required to support seamless driver and fleet manager discounting and incentive use cases.
  • Align Go-to-Market & Value Communications: Coordinate across marketing, product marketing, customer service, and commercial teams to ensure consistent external communications that clearly articulate the value of WEX discounting programs to fleets.
  • Expand Platform & Merchant Communication Capabilities: Drive enhancements to our core pricing, discounting, and merchant platforms to enable partners to configure, manage, and effectively communicate dynamic, self-set discounts directly to participating fleets.
  • Design & Execute Fuel-Saving Behavioral Experiments: Formulate hypotheses and run test-and-learn experiments to understand when, where, and how drivers and fleet managers utilize pricing and discount information, optimizing their decision-making for maximum fuel savings.

What You Bring:

  • Minimum of 5+ years: of professional Product Management experience (or 8+ years of professional experience with significant tenure in product leadership), ideally within payment platforms, fintech, merchant services, or B2B platforms.
  • Strategic Leadership: Proven experience owning and strategically leading a significant set of initiatives aligned to a major product area or platform capability.
  • Technical Domain Expertise: Strong expertise in systems thinking and platform strategy, with a background in payment platform products, merchant ecosystems, APIs, and partner integrations.
  • Metrics & Outcomes Focus: Proven track record of defining and leveraging metrics/OKRs to tell a product's performance story, justify strategic priorities, and deliver customer and financial outcomes.
  • Roadmapping & Scaling: Strong strategic planning and roadmapping capabilities, with the ability to define repeatable patterns from one-off integrations and establish clear development phases.
  • Collaborative Influence: Excellent collaborative influence and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to build trust, facilitate difficult conversations, and align stakeholders.
  • Data-Driven Insights: Insights-proficient and highly comfortable utilizing qualitative and quantitative data and interactive tools to drill down and make informed product decisions.
  • Mentorship: Proven leadership and mentorship skills, with the ability to guide and role-model discovery methods and strategic thinking for junior PMs.

Nice to Have:

  • Direct experience with core pricing, discounting, or ledger systems.
  • Fluency running GTM experiments, channel testing, or behavioral A/B tests.
  • Master’s Degree in business, technology, or a related field.

Why This Role Matters:

WEX is expanding its merchant systems and platform capabilities, unlocking critical growth opportunities through our discounting and pricing ecosystems. This role will help shape how we:

  • Deepen Relationships: Deepen connections between merchants and fleets by facilitating seamless, dynamic value exchange and direct communications.
  • Simplify Savings: Simplify and optimize how fleets discover, utilize, and maximize savings programs.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Drive cross-functional alignment across digital interfaces, core processing layers, commercial, and risk teams to scale unified solutions.
  • Empower Partners: Ensure that merchants have comprehensive, flexible tools to configure discounts and attract fleet volumes, establishing repeatable platform patterns.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Strategic Roadmapping: You define and drive the strategic roadmap for a portion of WEX Merchant Products, translating a bold vision into market-ready features and platform capabilities.
  • Cross-Functional Trusted Partnership: You foster close, collaborative relationships with cross-functional partners, ensuring operational, technical, and risk readiness for new discounting schemes and merchant configurations.
  • Behavioral Experiments: You leverage qualitative and quantitative insights to design experiments that increase merchant-to-fleet communication effectiveness and optimize driver savings.
  • Mentorship and Alignment: You act as a trusted leader and influencer, mentoring junior product managers and driving alignment across tech, commercial, and customer-facing product teams.
The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section.Pay Range: $125,300.00 - $154,100.00

We are on the front line of recruitment, enabling organizations to hire smarter and onboard faster. At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members.

Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

About First Advantage

First Advantage (NASDAQ: FA) is a leading provider of global software and data in the HR technology industry. Enabled by proprietary technology and AI, First Advantage’s platforms, data, and APIs power comprehensive employment background screening, identity solutions, and verification services.

Headquartered in Atlanta, GA, we have an internationally distributed workforce of about 10,000 employees spanning 17 countries. With a strong emphasis on innovation, automation, and customer success, First Advantage empowers 80,000 organizations to modernize their hiring and onboarding processes on a global scale.


What You'll Do:

The Assistant Manager Concierge oversees a team of healthcare concierge members, guiding them to become experts in drug and healthcare services. This role involves managing daily operations, including coaching, monitoring productivity, and addressing escalated concerns. The team lead ensures exceptional service to clients by coordinating drug and occupational health programs, supporting candidates, and tracking key performance indicators related to productivity, quality, and team morale. Effective communication with internal and external teams is essential to maintaining a smooth client experience.


This is a fully remote position (Work from Home), must be based and authorized to work in the United States.

Support Hours: Some time between 10:30am - 8:00pm ET


Responsibilities:

  • Provide ongoing training and support to the Concierge Team on work processes and SOPs.
  • Continuously monitor team productivity and quality to ensure client satisfaction.
  • Address team inquiries and offer guidance, coaching, and feedback as needed.
  • Escalate issues or concerns to the Concierge Operations Manager for resolution.
  • Regularly update and refine procedures and protocols to improve efficiency.
  • Onboard and integrate new team members, ensuring they understand team processes and expectations.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service, ensuring a seamless experience for clients.
  • Foster a positive team environment by leading with integrity and setting a strong example.
  • Track and manage team performance, ensuring goals and KPIs are consistently met.

What You Will Need to be Successful:

  • Associate Degree or equivalent work experience; Bachelor’s Degree preferred
  • Proven experience in supervising and motivating a team to achieve performance goals.
  • Familiarity with healthcare services and understanding of client needs.
  • Experience in customer service or call-center environments is a plus.
  • Comfortable with technology; proficient in navigating operating systems, internet, Excel, and software applications.
  • Strong customer-focused mentality with excellent attention to detail to ensure accuracy and quality.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, internet searches, and database lookups.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively with strong organizational skills and attention to deadlines.
  • Capable of following company and customer-specific directions while working autonomously.
  • Energetic, self-motivated, and detail-oriented with a strong work ethic.
  • Collaborative team player, comfortable working with diverse teams, both locally and remotely.
  • Willingness to work overtime as needed to meet team and client needs.
  • Experience providing exceptional client support and service.
  • Proficient in reading, writing, and speaking English.
  • Punctual and dependable, with a strong commitment to meeting job expectations.

Why Join Us at First Advantage?

At First Advantage, team members are united around a noble purpose: helping organizations to safeguard their workplaces and manage risk. The company’s culture is shaped by its core values — Authenticity, Curiosity, Integrity, Teamwork, Customer-Inspired — empowering team members to bring their best ideas forward, collaborate across departments, and make a real impact.

First Advantage offers a variety of culture programs and benefits designed to enhance employee experience and development.

  • Employee Impact Groups
  • FA Cares volunteer opportunities
  • Mentorship Advantage Program
  • SOAR, award-winning manager development program

Additional benefits offered include:

  • Ability to work remotely
  • Medical, Vision, Dental, and supplementary benefit plans, including paid Parental Leave and Bereavement.
  • 401k with an employer match and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).
  • Competitive and flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and 9 paid company holidays.
  • Volunteer Time Off Policy (VTOP) up to 8 hours a year.

What Are You Waiting For? Apply Today!
You have learned a little about us today – we want to learn about you! If you think this position and our company are a great fit for your areas of interest and expertise, tell us about you by applying now!


The salary range for this position is approximately $50-56K annually. This range reflects our good faith estimate to pay fairly as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on the selected candidate’s experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process.

We have great people here and are looking for more. Come join us!

raw.description:
About Us:

Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. Enabling our teams with leading technology allows analytics to guide our solutions and keeps us accountable achieving goals.

We build long-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Patient Communications Representative is responsible for performing customer service activities to service and collect patient accounts receivables for medical accounts. Patient Communications Representative will locate and communicate with patients via the telephone, email, chat, text, etc. to obtain repayment in full or to establish acceptable payment arrangements. Additionally, Patient Communications Representative will resolve issues of a non-routine nature as necessary as well as answer patient’s questions and research account changes when necessary and contract observance functions to ensure compliance of all company, client, and federal and state regulations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Note: The essential duties and responsibilities below are intended to describe the general duties and responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member’s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member’s immediate Leadership Team Member.

This position is 100% remote. Must reside in the United States.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Communicate with patients regarding the repayment of their medical debt.

  • Achieve assigned goals (resolutions, call quality, productivity standards – specified by line of business)
  • Provide customer service to patients resolving medical account balances.
  • Profile patients and obtain financial information. Update demographic and financial information on each call.
  • Negotiate the best possible arrangements.
  • Proficiency with company telephone system while placing outbound calls and accepting inbound calls.

Perform account research and route accounts through appropriate client workflows

  • Use job aids and crosswalks to answer patient questions and resolve accounts in an efficient manner.
  • Perform account research and document findings.
  • Effectively communicate with patients and client to obtain necessary account information.
  • Ensure strong communication skills to convey intricate account information.

Ensure all accounts are worked within client standards and Federal Regulations.

  • Maintain high quality account handling per client standards.
  • Work within FDCPA, state regulations, department/division & all Compliance Policies.
  • Maintain clear, concise, and accurate documentation of all attempts and/or contacts made and received for

accounts in accordance with company and client specifications.

Maintain continuing education, training in industry career development

  • Maintain current knowledge of and comply with all federal and state rules and regulations governing phone calls, patient contacts, and collections including HIPAA, FDCPA, Privacy Act, FCRA, etc.
  • Attend training sessions as directed by management.
  • Integrate information obtained through training sessions and policy changes immediately into daily routine.

EDUCATION: High School or Equivalent

EXPERIENCE – Must have 1 year of healthcare work experience. Minimum of six months’ work experience in a call center environment. One year preferred.

  • PC experience in a windows environment
  • Basic keyboarding skills
  • Previous sales or customer service experience

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS and ABILITIES -

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong listening skills, ability to follow written and/or verbal instructions
  • Good mathematical skills including calculator skills
  • Goal Oriented, and seeks to consistently meet daily, weekly, and monthly production and quality goals
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to meet tight deadlines
  • Negotiation, counseling, and problem-solving skills

Corporate Travel Consultant - Warwick Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 8 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

Have questions about this opportunity? Reach out to our recruitment team at

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85 plus commission/incentive earnings based on achievable targets. On target earnings average range between $60,000 - $67,000. The annual salary range listed represents the total compensation package, excluding benefits.

For this position, you may earn between 2-29% in marginal commission rates based on qualified sales achieved during each month.

Before applying to any internal position you must have been with the company or your current role for a minimum of 6 - 12 months and notify your leader prior to applying.

Our number one philosophy? Our people. Flight Center Travel Group USA’s promise is to provide an environment with equality of respect, dignity and opportunity for all our employees. We value an inclusive and supportive workplace which truly reflects the diversity of our society.

We are an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer committed to providing a barrier-free pathway throughout our recruitment process. We welcome accommodation requests to help make our hiring and onboarding experience as accessible as possible. Please advise us about accommodation needs at any point by contacting our Recruitment Team at

🌟 GBTA WINiT Top 50 Award Recipients (2018–2025)
💫 CHHR: 5-Star DE&I Employer (2023, 2024)

Quality Assurance Lead, US Remote Based


Join Fortrea and make an impact on quality across our clinical research operations. With the support of a collaborative team, the Quality Assurance Lead helps progress quality issues, support CAPA activities, and leverage QMS data and trends to help strengthen consistent, effective quality processes.


Location: Remote, United States


Key / Core Responsibilities

  • Serve as a quality partner to operational teams by providing guidance on quality issue management, quality risk identification, escalation requirements, and continuous improvement opportunities.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to facilitate the progression and resolution of quality issues within the Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Monitor and drive timely progression of quality issues while identifying and escalating risks that may impact compliance, quality, or client commitments.
  • Collaborate with functional teams to develop, implement, and monitor Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) to support sustainable issue resolution.
  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of quality systems, processes, and regulatory requirements to support effective quality issue management.

  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals

raw.description:
About the Role:
WEX is transforming how businesses manage spend and fleets—with a vision beyond traditional fueling through a growing set of electric vehicle (EV) charging, payment, and connected fleet capabilities built on shared platform investments.

We are looking for an execution-driven, collaborative Product Manager (PM3) to own and scale key digital capabilities within our mixed energy and connected fleet ecosystem. Sitting within the North American Mobility (NAM) Product Team, you will focus on merchant network integrations, third-party partner connections, and user experience enhancements across our mobile app and online web portals.

In this role, you will work hands-on with cross-functional partners—including engineering, design, operations, marketing, and commercial teams—to deliver practical, friction-free solutions that fleet managers and drivers rely on every day. You will also benefit from working alongside a Senior PM who will mentor and guide you as you ramp up on WEX’s ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive Tactical Product Execution: Own features end-to-end across our mobile app and customer portal, translating user needs and technical requirements into actionable user stories and sprint priorities.
  • Optimize Multi-Channel User Journeys: Improve usability and streamline digital onboarding workflows for fleet managers and drivers to reduce friction and drop-offs.
  • Conduct Field Research & Customer Discovery: Participate in customer call sessions, talk directly with fleet managers, and analyze operational feedback to ensure user pain points guide daily product trade-offs.
  • Execute Test-and-Learn Scenarios: Formulate hypotheses, evaluate behavioral data/dashboards, and test workflow improvements to measure adoption and deliver on team OKRs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, UX design, operations, and merchant partners to keep product delivery aligned and stakeholders updated on roadmap progress.
  • Design & AI Prototyping: Collaborate with UX design teams to create prototypes and test concepts quickly before engineering build-out.

EV & Connected Fleet Specifics:

  • Expand Partner & Network Integrations: Support standard third-party partner and network integrations to expand overall EV charging transaction coverage, real-time authorizations, and session management.
  • Support Fleet Charging Journeys: Help enable smooth onboarding, reporting, and operational support across public, private, and home charging scenarios.
  • Explore Connected Car Data: Work with vehicle data and connected car capabilities to help fleets optimize energy consumption and operational efficiency.
  • Hands-On Troubleshooting & Testing: Partner with internal operations and customers to test EV solutions in real-world scenarios, ensuring friction-free execution.

What You Bring:

  • 3–5 years of Product Management experience, with a track record of owning features or product capabilities through the full development lifecycle.
  • Tactical Execution Focus: Strong ability to write user stories, define acceptance criteria, prioritize backlogs, and deliver value iteratively in an agile environment.
  • Frictionless User Experience: Conduct customer discovery and field research with fleet managers and drivers to optimize onboarding, reduce workflow friction, and enhance daily operational usability. Comfortable reviewing behavioral data/dashboards and speaking directly with users/operations teams to inform trade-offs.
  • Data-Driven Innovation: Leverage vehicle data to build tools that help fleets optimize energy consumption, monitor operational efficiency, and transition smoothly to EV models.
  • Prototyping & UX Comfort: Familiarity collaborating with product designers and leveraging AI/design tools for quick workflow prototyping.
  • Strong Stakeholder Communication: Ability to communicate clearly across engineering, business, and operational teams.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience or background in Electric Vehicle (EV) charging networks, connected fleet data, payments, or API-based partner integrations.
  • Hands-on experience working with fleet management systems or B2B platforms.
  • Ability to drive cross-functional delivery using AI tools like Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, as a first-pass baseline to scale operational capacity.

Why This Role Matters:
WEX is expanding its EV and connected fleet capabilities, unlocking a critical growth opportunity in fleet electrification. This role will help shape how we:

  • Simplify and reimagine digital fleet experiences from the customer perspective.
  • Seamlessly connect drivers and fleet operators to widespread, real-time charging networks.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across technology, merchant, and commercial teams to scale unified solutions.
  • Ensure that fleets have comprehensive and easy-to-use solutions that optimize operations as they add electric and connected vehicles to their fleet.
The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section.Pay Range: $89,800.00 - $120,400.00

raw.description:
Full-Service Travel Agent | Work From Home


Turn your passion for travel into a rewarding career!

Do you have a passion for travel and a talent for creating memorable experiences? AAA Club Alliance is seeking an experienced Full-Service Travel Agent with both domestic and international travel booking expertise to join our remote Travel Contact Center team.


In this work-from-home position, you’ll help Members and non-Members plan and book personalized vacations—from weekend getaways to complex international itineraries. You’ll build lasting client relationships, provide exceptional service, and have the opportunity to earn monthly performance incentives.


Who Can Apply?

To be considered, candidates must reside in one of the following locations:

Connecticut, Delaware, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Maryland, New Jersey, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Dakota, Virginia, Washington, DC, or West Virginia.

Why You’ll Love Working at AAA

  • 100% Remote: Work from the comfort of your home.
  • Competitive Pay: $18.00–$24.00 per hour, based on experience and geographic location, plus monthly performance incentives for sales and bookings.
  • Paid Virtual Training: Receive paid training with all required equipment provided.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy a competitive benefits package.
  • Work-Life Balance: Accrue more than three weeks of PTO during your first year.

Work Schedule

All hours are Eastern Time.

  • Sunday: 10:00 AM–4:00 PM
  • Monday: 9:30 AM–6:00 PM
  • Tuesday: 9:30 AM–6:00 PM
  • Wednesday: 10:00 AM–6:00 PM
  • Thursday: Off
  • Friday: 9:30 AM–6:00 PM
  • Saturday: Off

What You’ll Do

As a Remote Full-Service Travel Agent, you will:

  • Plan and book domestic and international vacations, including customized FIT (Fully Independent Travel) itineraries.
  • Assist Members and non-Members through phone, email, and web chat.
  • Recommend destinations, travel products, and exclusive AAA benefits based on each traveler’s needs.
  • Build and maintain long-term client relationships that generate repeat business.
  • Stay informed about travel promotions, destinations, and industry trends.
  • Process travel reservations in compliance with ARC regulations and AAA policies.
  • Identify opportunities to upsell and cross-sell travel products that enhance the overall customer experience.
  • Meet established sales and performance goals while delivering exceptional customer service.
  • Resolve travel-related issues and assist with itinerary changes.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to fellow Travel Contact Center Associates when needed.

Minimum Qualifications:

Successful candidates must have:

  • A high school diploma or equivalent. Travel school graduates are encouraged to apply.
  • At least 2 years of recent leisure travel industry sales experience.
  • Experience with airline reservation systems, ticketing platforms, GDS, and online booking tools.
  • Strong knowledge of domestic and international travel planning.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, sales, and problem-solving skills.
  • Extensive knowledge of worldwide geography.
  • The ability to succeed in a fast-paced, high-volume contact center environment.
  • Ticket void and basic exchange experience is a plus.

Training & Schedule Requirements

Successful candidates must:

  • Attend all required paid virtual training, Monday through Friday, from 9:00 AM–5:30 PM EST.
  • Successfully complete training before beginning the regular work schedule.
  • Work a set schedule that includes one weekend day each week, along with one weekday and one weekend day off.

Join a Team That Helps People Explore the World!

At AAA Club Alliance, you’ll combine your travel expertise with exceptional customer service to help travelers create unforgettable experiences while building your career.

If you’re passionate about travel, enjoy connecting with customers, and are looking for a rewarding remote opportunity with competitive pay, incentives, and excellent benefits, we’d love to hear from you.


Apply today and start helping people explore the world!


#US

Full time Associates are offered a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision plan options
  • Up to 2 weeks Paid parental leave
  • 401k plan with company match up to 7%
  • 2+ weeks of PTO within your first year
  • Paid company holidays
  • Company provided volunteer opportunities + 1 volunteer day per year
  • Free AAA Membership
  • Continual learning reimbursement up to $5,250 per year
  • And MORE! Check out our Benefits Page for more information

ACA is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment practices laws. At ACA, we are committed to cultivating a welcoming and inclusive workplace of team members with diverse backgrounds and experiences to enable us to meet our goals and support our values while serving our Members and customers. We strive to attract and retain candidates with a passion for their work and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. It is ACA’s policy to employ the best qualified individuals available for all positions. Hiring decisions are based upon ACA’s operating needs, and applicant qualifications including, but not limited to, experience, skills, ability, availability, cooperation, and job performance.

The Lead AI Automation Engineer will provide hands-on technical leadership for the design, engineering, and productionization of AI-enabled automation across the Data Governance organization. This role is focused on building reliable automation products and agentic workflows—not training foundational models or serving as a traditional data scientist. The engineer will combine generative AI, workflow orchestration, APIs, enterprise integrations, low-code automation where appropriate, and production engineering practices to automate complex governance processes. The role will lead technical design, establish reusable engineering patterns, mentor other engineers, and take high-value automation opportunities from concept through secure, scalable production deployment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical design and hands-on development of AI-enabled automations, agentic workflows, and intelligent process orchestration for enterprise Data Governance use cases.
  • Build solutions that combine large language models, deterministic business logic, workflow engines, APIs, enterprise data, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Design reusable automation frameworks, services, connectors, prompts, tools, and patterns that accelerate delivery across multiple governance workflows.
  • Integrate AI automation with metadata management, data catalog, data quality, lineage, policy, ticketing, collaboration, and enterprise data platform capabilities.
  • Engineer APIs and services that allow agents and automations to safely retrieve context, execute approved actions, and interact with enterprise systems.
  • Use Power Platform and other low-code automation technologies where they are the appropriate engineering choice, while applying software engineering discipline to maintainability, security, testing, and lifecycle management.
  • Establish patterns for agent orchestration, tool use, state management, exception handling, observability, auditability, human approval, and failure recovery.
  • Define and implement evaluation, testing, monitoring, and quality controls for AI automations, including accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and operational performance.
  • Partner with architects, security, AI/data science teams, product owners, governance leaders, and application teams to translate business processes into secure and scalable automation solutions.
  • Lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, improve engineering standards, and provide technical direction without becoming removed from hands-on delivery.
  • Identify processes that are strong candidates for automation and challenge unnecessary manual steps, handoffs, and duplicated workflows.
  • Own production readiness and operational support, including CI/CD, release management, telemetry, incident troubleshooting, continuous improvement, and responsible AI controls.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field; or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, application development, automation engineering, platform engineering, or enterprise systems integration.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience developing AI/ML, generative AI, intelligent automation, or advanced automation solutions, with demonstrated recent experience building LLM-enabled or agentic solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience taking complex automation or AI-enabled solutions from concept/prototype through production deployment and operational support.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership—such as leading solution design, establishing engineering patterns, conducting technical/code reviews, mentoring engineers, or serving as the technical lead for complex initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related discipline.
  • 7+ years of overall engineering experience, including experience designing enterprise-scale automation, integration, or AI solutions.
  • Strong preference for a Mathematics, Statistics, or related quantitative background
  • Experience leading AI automation, generative AI, agentic AI, or intelligent process automation initiatives in a large enterprise.
  • Experience working in a regulated enterprise environment where security, privacy, auditability, governance, and responsible AI controls are material design requirements.
  • Relevant cloud, AI, automation, or software engineering certifications.

Position Summary

The Benefits Underwriter is responsible for quoting, rating and issuance of new business, quotes, renewals, and endorsements. The role will work closely with Specialty Sales, Claims and Operations, Finance, Legal, Risk and Compliance to help achieve strategic initiatives, which will assure the long-term growth of profits for Health.

What will your job entail?

Job Responsibilities:•Case underwriting of Health coverage for both renewals and new business (manual rating and experience rating)•Analyze, select, evaluate price risks, articulate underwriting analyses and identify corrective actions, if any, to sales team and broker contacts.•Deliver timely and accurate quotes/binder by determining premiums and calculate premiums based on the level of risk and the type of coverage requested.•Evaluate the risk associated with insuring applicants using underwriting software and guidelines.•Achieve new business premium targets, premium retention targets and loss ratio targets for assigned territory.•Servicing of assigned accounts and brokers, in conjunction with other Underwriting and Sales team members within assigned territory.•Prepare (where applicable) review and approval of case referrals.•Analyzing applicant information by reviewing medical histories, financial data, and other relevant information•Work closely with other functional areas: Claims; Actuarial; Operations; Finance; Legal and Compliance.•Liaise with internal stakeholders to ensure awareness of underwriting activities that require support and service.•Adherence to all internal and external compliance standards, including implementation of new standards.•Assist in achieving overall Ryan Specialty goal in collaboration with Distribution. Work closely and share responsibility for overall revenue goal through new business and retention targets.•Engage in ongoing education to stay current with industry trends, regulations, and best practices.•Quarterly self-audit process to assure 100% and timely compliance and take necessary actions on audit recommendations and findings.•Training to ensure compliance to underwriting authority and sales practice.•Strategize with other members of assigned territory team to identify target market segments and to develop broker distribution relationships.Work Experience and Education:•Bachelor’s degree in fields such as business, finance, economics, or a related field.•5 years of Health Insurance Underwriting or 3 years of experience with a master’s degree. Licenses & Certifications: •State Accident and Health Insurance license a plus. •Charter Healthcare Consultant (ChHC) or Registered Health Underwriter (RHU) is plus.

raw.description:
🚀 Epiconcept is recruiting an epidemiologist W/M

(French version below)

About Epiconcept:

Epiconceptis a small-medium enterprise of approximately 110 people with a wide expertise in

epidemiology and in the development of information and communication tools for public health.

Employees are based in France, Spain, Portugal and the United Kingdom.

Epiconceptis a:

  • Certified research organisation ;

  • Certified data centre for hosting personal and medical data ;

  • Certified training company.

Our current partners are institutions and organisations in charge of Public Health programmes: WHO, ECDC, European Commission, Ministries of Health, NGOs, Foundations, etc.

The Epidemiology Department is a diverse and dynamic multi-disciplinary international team of approximately 20 individuals working mostly in infectious diseases with specialism in vaccination and vaccine policies, the development of guidance at national and international levels, and development and delivery of training courses. The epidemiology team has a wide expertise in different study methodologies (e.g. systematic literature reviews, case-control and cohort studies as well as cross- sectional surveys) and different applications to field epidemiology (e.g. vaccine effectiveness studies, outbreak investigation and pandemic response).

📄 More information available at: epiconcept.fr/carriere


Post overview:

The successful candidate will provide high quality epidemiological research and data management support in all aspects of establishing, conducting, analysing and reporting on studies and projects.

The successful candidate will collaborate with senior epidemiologists who coordinate a variety of projects being led by the Epidemiology Department at Epiconcept.

The successful candidate will work on European multi-country projects (funded by international and European organisations).

The post-holder will:

  • draft of documents (e.g. protocols, statistical analysis plans etc) to support the on-going implementation of studies and projects ;

  • help manage, analyse and interpret epidemiological data, ensuring data are appropriately managed and analysed in a reliable and timely way ;

  • develop and maintain R scripts for data management, data checking, data analysis, data visualisation and automatisation of the project data and output in compliance with good data management rules ;

  • conduct analyses, prepare results and contribute, including as lead author, to peer-reviewed publications and other outputs (e.g. reports, conference abstracts) for wider dissemination ;

  • use evidence generated from project results and other research to identify current and future public health priorities and needs ;

  • establish a strong working relation with the senior epidemiologist to jointly ensure timely deliverables and to ensure that projects are managed in an effective way ;

  • support project management and maintain good scientific collaboration with key partners through regular interactions with participating and client representatives ;

  • prepare training material and provide training, as and when needed, including training of epidemiological concepts, analysis and software (R) ;

  • handle any other activities commensurate with the post.

There is also the possibility to participate in projects in other disease areas or activities such as training, applied research projects locally and overseas and related project management.

Pay will be commensurate with skills and experience. The contract duration for the post is a long-term contract.

The postholder will be expected to work from their own premises or from Epiconcept offices based in Paris.

The postholder may need to travel to attend or present at international conferences, to provide training or site visits relating to the multi-country project.

Competency/skills:

Essential skills and experience

  • Postgraduate degree: MSc in biostatistics, epidemiology, data science or another related subject ;

  • Relevant experience in a similar position, working in surveillance, observational or other epidemiological research studies ;

  • Proficient R user, with demonstrable experience in data management and visualisation (e.g. dplyr, ggplot2), reproducible reporting (e.g. R Markdown, Quarto), and collaborative coding using Git and GitHub/Gitlab ;

  • Strong knowledge and experience of statistics as applied to epidemiological studies ;

  • Strong knowledge of epidemiological studies and methods ;

  • Excellent English level (minimum C1).

Desirable skills and experience

  • Postgraduate research degree: PhD in biostatistics, epidemiology, data science or another related subject ;

  • Experience of working with R Shiny to create interactive dashboards ;

  • Experience using other languages, such as Python or SQL, for data management and/or analysis ;

  • Experience of working on multicentre studies ;

  • Experience of working on European public health projects ;

  • Experience of using scientific evidence to inform and develop public health programmes ;

  • Experience of vaccine effectiveness, evaluation of surveillance systems, burden of disease or vaccination impact studies ;

  • Experience of using generative AI tools, including familiarity with the use of AI coding assistants like Claude code ;

  • Good knowledge of French ;

Essential abilities:

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills ;

  • Attention to detail ;

  • Work proactively and independently with a remote management ;

  • Strong interpersonal skills able to collaborate within a team and with partners from different countries ;

  • Work in time-sensitive environment without compromising the quality of work ;

  • Work on different projects at the same time.

Application and selection process

Candidates are invited to apply directly through our careers site by submitting an up-to-date CV and a cover letter in English. Applications close on Monday, 23 November 2026 at 10:00 CET.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to participate in tests to assess their abilities in the use of R software and scientific writing skills. Those successfully completing the test will be asked to interview on-line.

We firmly believe that diversity in backgrounds and profiles is an asset, and we are committed to equal opportunities and non-discrimination. All our vacancies are open to people with disabilities, and our recruitment process can be adapted to suit their needs.

🚀 Epiconcept recrute un épidémiologiste

A propos d'Epiconcept:

Epiconceptest une petite et moyenne entreprise comptant environ 110 collaborateurs et disposant d’une vaste expertise en épidémiologie et dans le développement d’outils d’information et de communication pour la santé publique.

Ses collaborateurs sont basés en France, en Espagne, au Portugal et au Royaume-Uni.

Epiconcept est :

  • un organisme de recherche certifié ;

  • un centre de données certifié pour l’hébergement de données personnelles et médicales ;

  • un organisme de formation certifié.

Nos partenaires actuels sont des institutions et des organisations en charge de programmes de santé publique : l’OMS, l’ECDC, la Commission européenne, les ministères de la Santé, des ONG, des fondations, etc.

Le département d’épidémiologie est une équipe internationale multidisciplinaire, diversifiée et dynamique, composée d’environ 20 personnes travaillant principalement dans le domaine des maladies infectieuses, avec une spécialisation dans la vaccination et les politiques vaccinales, l’élaboration de recommandations aux niveaux national et international, ainsi que la conception et la mise en œuvre de formations. L’équipe d’épidémiologie dispose d’une vaste expertise dans différentes méthodologies d’étude (par exemple, les revues systématiques de la littérature, les études cas-témoins et de cohorte, ainsi que les enquêtes transversales) et dans différentes applications de l’épidémiologie de terrain (par exemple, les études d’efficacité des vaccins, les enquêtes sur les épidémies et la réponse aux pandémies).

📄 Pour plus d'informations, consultez le site: epiconcept.fr/carriere


A propos du poste:

Le candidat retenu apportera un soutien de haute qualité en matière de recherche épidémiologique et de gestion des données dans tous les aspects liés à la mise en place, à la conduite, à l'analyse et à la présentation des résultats d'études et de projets.

Le candidat retenu collaborera avec des épidémiologistes expérimentés chargés de coordonner divers projets menés par le département d'épidémiologie d'Epiconcept.

Le candidat retenu travaillera sur des projets européens impliquant plusieurs pays (financés par des organisations internationales et européennes).

Le futur épidémiologiste devra:

  • rédiger des documents (par exemple, des protocoles, des plans d’analyse statistique, etc.) afin de soutenir la mise en œuvre des études et des projets en cours ;

  • contribuer à la gestion, à l’analyse et à l’interprétation des données épidémiologiques, en veillant à ce que celles-ci soient gérées et analysées de manière appropriée, fiable et en temps opportun ;

  • développer et maintenir des scripts R pour la gestion, la vérification, l’analyse et la visualisation des données, ainsi que pour l’automatisation des données et des résultats du projet, dans le respect des règles de bonne gestion des données ;

  • mener des analyses, préparer les résultats et contribuer, y compris en tant qu’auteur principal, à des publications évaluées par des pairs et à d’autres productions (par exemple, rapports, résumés de conférences) en vue d’une diffusion plus large ;

  • utiliser les données issues des résultats du projet et d’autres recherches pour identifier les priorités et les besoins actuels et futurs en matière de santé publique ;

  • établir une relation de travail solide avec l’épidémiologiste principal afin de garantir conjointement la livraison des livrables dans les délais et de veiller à ce que les projets soient gérés de manière efficace ;

  • soutenir la gestion des projets et entretenir une bonne collaboration scientifique avec les partenaires clés grâce à des interactions régulières avec les représentants des participants et des clients ;

  • préparer du matériel de formation et dispenser des formations, selon les besoins, notamment sur les concepts épidémiologiques, l’analyse et le logiciel (R) ;

  • assurer toute autre activité correspondant au poste.

Il est également possible de participer à des projets dans d’autres domaines thérapeutiques ou à des activités telles que la formation, des projets de recherche appliquée en France et à l’étranger, ainsi que la gestion de ces projets.

La rémunération sera déterminée en fonction des compétences et de l'expérience. Il s'agit d'un contrat à long terme.

Le titulaire du poste sera amené à travailler depuis son domicile ou depuis les bureaux d'Epiconcept situés à Paris.

Le titulaire du poste pourra être amené à se déplacer pour assister ou intervenir lors de conférences internationales, dispenser des formations ou effectuer des visites sur site dans le cadre du projet multinational.

Compétences/aptitudes:

Compétences et expérience indispensable

  • Diplôme de troisième cycle : master en biostatistique, épidémiologie, science des données ou dans une autre discipline connexe ;

  • Expérience pertinente à un poste similaire, dans le domaine de la surveillance, des études observationnelles ou d’autres recherches épidémiologiques ;

  • Maîtrise du langage R, avec une expérience avérée en gestion et visualisation des données (par exemple, dplyr, ggplot2), en création de rapports reproductibles (par exemple, R Markdown, Quarto) et en codage collaboratif à l’aide de Git et GitHub/GitLab ;

  • Solides connaissances et expérience en statistiques appliquées aux études épidémiologiques ;

  • Solides connaissances des études et méthodes épidémiologiques ;

  • Excellent niveau d'anglais (minimum C1).

Compétences et expérience souhaitée

  • Diplôme de recherche de troisième cycle : doctorat en biostatistique, épidémiologie, science des données ou dans une autre discipline connexe ;

  • Expérience de l’utilisation de R Shiny pour la création de tableaux de bord interactifs ;

  • Expérience de l’utilisation d’autres langages, tels que Python ou SQL, pour la gestion et/ou l’analyse des données ;

  • Expérience de travail sur des études multicentriques ;

  • Expérience de travail sur des projets européens de santé publique ;

  • Expérience dans l’utilisation de données scientifiques pour éclairer et développer des programmes de santé publique ;

  • Expérience dans le domaine de l’efficacité des vaccins, de l’évaluation des systèmes de surveillance, de la charge de morbidité ou des études d’impact de la vaccination ;

  • Expérience dans l’utilisation d’outils d’IA générative, y compris une bonne maîtrise des assistants de codage basés sur l’IA tels que Claude Code ;

  • Bonne maîtrise du français ;

Autres compétences essentielles:

  • Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale ;

  • Sens du détail ;

  • Capacité à travailler de manière proactive et autonome avec un encadrement distanciel ;

  • Solides compétences relationnelles permettant de collaborer au sein d'une équipe et avec des partenaires de différents pays ;

  • Capacité à travailler dans un environnement où les délais sont serrés, sans compromettre la qualité du travail ;

  • Capacité à mener de front plusieurs projets simultanément

Processus de candidature et de sélection

Les candidats sont invités à postuler directement via notre site Carrières en envoyant un CV à jour et une lettre de motivation en anglais. La date limite de dépôt des candidatures est fixée au lundi 23 novembre 2026 à 10 h 00 (CET).

Les candidats présélectionnés seront invités à passer des tests visant à évaluer leurs compétences dans l'utilisation du logiciel R et leurs aptitudes à la rédaction scientifique. Les candidats ayant réussi ces tests seront invités à un entretien en visio.

Convaincus que la diversité des parcours et des profils est une richesse, nous nous engageons en faveur de l’égalité des chances et de la non-discrimination. Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap et notre processus de recrutement est adaptable.

The Senior Full Stack Engineer Is involved in all stages of software development, including front-end development, back-end development, database integrations, network and hosting management, user interface, user experience, and back-end server management.
